dab brgya dang bdun pa' dkar chagatshad ma/ 〈stsu (2༷6)3go7 de kho na nyid bsnyus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ 3dang po/ rang bzhin brtag pa/ 3gnyis pa/ dbang phyug brtag pa/ 7gsum pa/ gnyis ka brtag pa/ 11bzhi pa/ 'gro ba rang bzhin du smra ba brtag pa/ 13lnga pa/ sgra'i tshangs pa brtag pa/ 15drug pa/ skyes bu brtag pa/ 17bdun pa/ rigs pa can dang bye brag pas kun tu brtags pa'i skyes bu brtag pa/ 19brgyad pa/ dpyod pa pas brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa/ 23dgu pa/ ser skya pas kun du brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa/ 29bcu pa/ nam mkha'i gos can gyis kun tu brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa/ 311

bcu gcig pa/ u pa ni sha kas brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa/ 33bcu gnyis pa/ gnas ma'i bus brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa/ na4bcu gsum pa/ brtan pa'i dngos po brtag pa/ 36bcu bzhi pa/ las dang 'bras bu'i 'byel pa brtag pa/ gyebaco lnga pa/ rdzas kyi tshig gi don brtag pa/ 53bcu drug pa/ yon tan gyi tshig gi don brtag pa/ 61bcu bdun pa/ las kyi tshig gi don brtag pa/ 66bco brgyad pa/ spyi dang bye brag gi tshig gi don brtag pa/ 67bcu dgu pa/ 'du ba'i tshig gi don brtag pa/ 773) 〈bye nga / spro/:re ma/zug ngasaste/ba/ nga / 81nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid brtag pa/ 111nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rjes su dpag pa brtag pa/ 124nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ tshad ma gzhan brtag pa/ ༷ 135sgra las byung ba rnam par dpyad pa/ 135nye bar 'jal ba rnam par dbe+ed pa/ 138don gyis go ba rnam par dpyad pa/ 143dngos po med pa rnam par dpyad pa/ 148rigs pa gzhan de yod na yod pa dang mi dmigs pa rnam par dpyad pa/ 152nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ 'gyur bar smra ba brtag pa/ 154nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ dus gsum brtag pa/ 161nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ 'jig rten rgyang pan pa'i brtag pa/ 167nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ phyi rol gyi don brtag pa/ 177nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ thos pa brtag pa/ 187nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ rang las tshad ma brtag pa/ 251sum cu pa/ gzhan gyi dbang po las 'das pa'i don mthong ba can gyi 2

/gatheg sdom /bache/bka nga // ༷ ༷ 278slob dpon zhi ba 'ad+ku zhal snga nas kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal gu 7 ka ra shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po dpal lha btsan po shākya'i dge slong lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi zhal snga nas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(326) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(352)3go8 de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i dka' 'grel/ 353dang po/ rang bzhin brtag pa/ 353gnyis pa/ dbang phyug brtag pa/ 436ga/thuskyab pa/ gnyi ga brtag pa/ 468bzhi pa/ 'gro ba rang bzhin du smra ba brtag pa/ 473lnga pa/ sgra'i tshangs pa brtag pa/ 'an2drug pa/ rtestes bu brtag pa/ zhen6bdun pa/ rigs pa can dang bye brag pas kun du brtags pa'i skyes bu /bachesacan /ba/ ga nga rtenabargyad pa/ dpyod pa pas kun du brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa/ 528dgu pa/ ser skya bas kun du brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa/ 553bcu pa/ nam mkha'i gos can gyis kun du brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa/ 56nabacu gcig pa/ gsang ba ba'i bdag brtag pa/ ༷ ༷571bcu gnyis pa/ gnas ma'i bu pa'i bdag brtag pa/ 576bcu gsum pa/ brtan pa'i dngos po brtag pa/ 586

bcu bzhi pa/ las dang 'bras bu'i 'grel pa brtag pa/ 640bco lnga pa/ rdzas kyi tshig gi don brtag pa/ 668bcu drug pa/ yon tan gyi don brtag pa/ 709bcu bdun pa/ las kyi tshogs kyi don brtag pa/ 746bco brgyad pa/ spyi'i tshig gi don brtag pa/ 754bcu dgu pa/ bye brag gi tshig gi don brtag pa/ 792nyi shu pa/ 'du ba'i tshig gi don brtag pa/ 795nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ sgra'i don brtag pa/ 808bsdur mchan/(941)tshad ma/ 9sgo (2༷7)3go8 de kho na nyid bsnyus pa'i dka' 'grel/ 991nyi shu gnyis pa/ mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid brtag pa/ 991nyi shu gsum pa/ rjes su dpag pa'i mtshan nyid brtag pa/ 1046nyi shu bzhi pa/ tshad ma gzhan brtag pa/ 1087sgra las byung ba rnam par dpyad pa/ 1087nye bar 'jal ba rnam par dbe+ed pa/ 1103don gyis go ba rnam par dpyad pa/ 1118dngos po med pa rnam par dpyad pa/ 1136rigs pa gzhan de yod na yod pa dang mi dmigs pa rnam par dpyad pa/ 1155nyi shu lnga pa/ 'byung ba brtag pa/ 1160

nyi shu drug pa/ dus gsum brtag pa/ 1184nyi shu bdun pa/ 'jig rten rgyang pan pa brtag pa/ 1208nyi shu brgyad pa/ phyi rol gyi don brtag pa/ 1256nyi sdospyo tshonasdo/ pa/ 11sa pa brtab/ nga / ༷ 1306sum cu pa/ tshad ma nye bar brtag pa/ ༷ ༷༷ ༷༷ ༷ 1522sum cu gcig pa/ gzhan gyi dbang po las 'das pa'i don mthong ba can gyi /skyernam (zu thabachesacan tshon/ 1( rten0slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī las mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po de ben dra bha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong grags 'byor shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1800) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1863)tshe dkar chag gi zur mchan/ chos tshan (3go7)pa dang (3go8)pa gnyis rtsa ba dang 'grel par song yang /brtag pa'i grangs la mang nyung yod pa ni/ rtsa bar spyi dang bye brag gnyis brtag pa gcig tu bstan pa dang / 'grel par de gnyis so sor byas te bstan yod pas/ 'dir dkar chag tu yang gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi go rim ltar bsgrigs yod/
༷two rdo rdosdu da rdo — da — — —— sna di : ཿ /

sngag /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ tatwa saṃ gra ha kā ri kā/ bod skad du/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin dbang ldan gnyis ka dang / /bdag sogs byed dang bral g.yo ba/ /las dang de 'bras 'byel pa dag /rnam par gzhag byel sogs pa'i rten/ /yon tan rdzas dang bya ba dang / /rigs dang 'du sogs khyad par gyis/ /stong dang sgo btags rnam can ni/ /sgra dang shes pa'i spyod yul can/ /mtshan nyid gsal dang ldan pa yi/ /tshad ma gnyis kyis gtan la dbab/ /cha shas shin tu phra bas kyang / /'dres pa gzhan gyi bdag nyid min/ /mi 'pho thog mtha' med pa can/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs dag dang 'dra/ /spros pa kun gyi tshogs dang bral/ /gzhan gyis ①rtogs pa ma yin dang / /rang dbang thob ④la mi brten pa/ /'gro la phan pa 107—3

mdzad bzhed pasashe/ /bskal pa grangs med mi nyung bas/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag gyur pa/ /rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba ni/ /gang gis gsungs pa smra ba'i mchog /kun mkhyen de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nyid rnams ni bsnyu bar bya/ /nus pa ma lus dang ldan pa'i/ /gtso bo nyid ni 'ba' zhig las/ /'bras bu'i khyad par rab skye ste/ /de dngos can nyid yang dag par/ /gal te rgyu yi bdag nyid la/ /nus pa 'bras bu don yod min/ /de ni bya bar mi nus te/ /ngo bo med phyir mkha' pad bzhin/ /med par mtshungs na ci yi phyir//sā lu'i 2sa bon la sogs pa'i/ /bye brag phyir na nges pa yi/ /nyer 1len len byed gzhan ma yin/ /skye ba'i chos can thams cad kyang / /dngos po kun la skye 'gyur te/ /'di kun la ni de bdag cenyid/ /khyad par khyad par me+ed phyir ro/ /'di yi nus pa nges pa'i phyir/ /de lta min zhes lan mi rung / /gang phyir nus pa'i rgyu dag gis/ /nus par 'os pa'i 'bras nyid byed/ /khyad par byar rnged gang yin pa/ /dngos po med dang 'gyur ba med/ /gyur na bdag nyid nyams gyur phyir/ /de dag gis de ji ltar byed/ /de ltar 'bras nyid mi rung phyir/ /ci zhig byed pas rgyu ru 'gyur/ /de pyephyir sa bon la sogs pa/ /rgyu yi dngos por yang mi 'gyur/ /gsal ba 'di ni bde sogs kyi//rdzas 'gro'i bar ni gsal bar snang / /rab tu gdung dang btang snyoms sogs/ /'bras bu 'di la dmigs phyir ro/ /de phyir de bdag can las byung / /de rigs rjes 'gro mthong phyir te/ /bum sogs bye brag bzhin gtso bo/ /de yang yin zhes ser skya smra/ /'di la blo bzang rnams 'chad 67pa/ /yod pa la yang klan ka mtshungs/ /de la khyed kyi lan gang yin/ /blo bzang rnams kyi'ang de 107—4

dang 'dra/ /gal te zho sogs 'o ma sogs/ /bdag nyid la ni rnam kun yod/ /rgyu la sogs dang 'dra bdag nyid/ /yod pa de dag ci zhig skye/ /'bras bu de rgyus bskyed bya min/ /yod phyir rgyu dang rig pa bzhin/ /de phyir mngon 'dod rgyu min te/ /bsgrub bya med phyir bdag mchog bzhin/ /gal te gsal sogs mtshan nyid can/ /khyad par gyur pa 'ga' zhig la/ /'di ni rgyu rnams kyis byed na/ /tha snyad du ni 'gyur ba min/ /gal te snga na de yod na/ /de ltar ci yang lan ma thebs/ /'on te de med de dag las/ /med par ji ltar skye bar 'gyur/ /de phyir bsgrub bya med pas na/ /nyer len yongs su 'dzin pa med / /nges pa las kyang skye ba med/ /nus pa med cing bya ba'ang med/ /bdag nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /'di ni 'bras bu ci yang med/ /de phyir rgyu yi tha snyad kyang / /'thad pa nyid ni ma yin no/ /sgrub byed zhugs pa thams cad ni/ /phyin ci log ni bzlog pa dang / /nges pa skyed byed de lta bur/ /'di ni rigs pas 'thad ma yin/ /the tshom dang ni phyin ci log /rtag tu gnas phyir bzlog 1tu med/ /nges pa skye ba'ang yod ma yin/ /de nyid phyir na kun don med/ /yang na nges pa med pa ni/ /sgrub byed las ni skye 'gyur na/ /yang dag ma yin skye zhe na/ /de nyid kyis na 'di dag kun/ /'khrul pa can gyur 67ma yin nam/ /gal te mi gsal de dag las/ /gsal rten zhe na de gsal gang / /ngo bo khyad par skye min te/ /dbyer med phyir dang ma 'byel phyir—/ /yul de rigs pa'ang ma yin la/ /dmigs pa'i sgrib pa zad pa'ang min / /rtag pa'i phyir dang dmigs pa ni/ /gnyis pa yang ni mi srid phyir/ /yon tan gsum ldan dbyer med kyang / /thams cad kun gyi ①byed po min/ /107—5

gang 'dra med pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /thams cad byed po kun min na/ / ltos sam byem grub pa yi phyir/ /khyod ni nus pa nges pa med/ /yod na de yi nges pa ni / /ltos bye bcas rigs zhupa ma yin nam/ /de min de dag ma skyes na/ /de lta'i sgra ni med du zad/ /khyad par kun gyis dbe+en pa yi/ /dngos bo'i ngo bo nyams pa med/ /ming rgyani dngos po'i ngo bo min/ /gang phyir brjod dang rnam rtog ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dbyer med la/ /ji ltar goms pa bzhin du 'jug /skye ba'i dngos po'i dngos de ni/ /med dang de bzhin yod pa dang / /'byel pa med de rnam rtog blos/ /med dang sbrel ba kho nar zad/ /gal te dngos po'i ngo bo 'dithu/ /gcig gi rjes la mthong ba dang / /sngar med zhes pa de sa bon/ /sngar yod pa la 'di med do/ /'o ma sogs la zho la sogs/ /nus pa'i ngo bo ༄ bye'adod pa gang / /de la nus gang gal te zho/ /'o ma bzhin du snang bar 'gyur/ /gal te gzhan yin gzhan yod na/ /ji ltar dngos kun gzhan zhes bya/ /snying stobs yod pa sdug bsngal dang / /gti mug yod pa ma yin no/ /gsal ba snying stobs sogs rjes 'gro/ /nges la ji ltar yang ma grub//bde sogs nang gi yin pa'i phyir/ /de ni rang rig gsal phyir ro/ /sgra sogs gcig pu kho na yang / /gom ⑦dang rig pa'i bye brag las/ /chags pa la sogs nges pa ni/ /skye ba dag tu gsal bar snang / /dngos gcig rjes su 'brangs nas ni/ /rig 3pa sna tshogs thal bar 'gyur/ /gal te ma mthong sogs dbang gis/ /dngos po'i rjes su 'brang mi 'gyur/ /dngos bo ngo bo rnam gsum pa/ /de yi rig pa rnam gcig can/ /de dang mi mthun de dag ni//de la yang dag ji ltar rigs/ /skyes bu gcig la rnal 'byor pa'i/ /bde 107—6

dang skyo dang btang snyoms skye'i/ /pha rol rnams kyi skyes bu ni/ /de yi ngo bor 'dod ma yin/ /gsal ba yon tan gsum can du/ /grub kyang gtso bo rab ma grub/ /de rgyu gcig dang rtag nyid min/ /de ni rigs gcig dang ldan min/ /gsal ba thams cad lcags kyi ni/ /thur ma dang 'dra rim pa dang / /'byel pa'i lus can dag tu snang / /rtog dang 'dres pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de bzhin 'jim pa'i 1'gyur la sogs/ /khyad par rigs gcig ldan min dang / /rgyu gcig min par yang 'grub ste/ /'jim gong la sogs tha dad phyir/ /skyes bu rnams la sems yod sogs/ /rjes 'gro na yang rgyu gcig ni/ /sngon 'gror mi 'dod dngos min zhes/ /gal te dngos su min zhe zhu/ na/ /'di la ni yang cis mi mtshungs/ /de phyir gtso bo'i rgyu med na/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs thams cad nus pa yi/ /khyad par las ni rung bar 'gyur/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las rang bzhin brtag rngu pa ste dang po'o// //gzhan dag skye ldan kun gyi ni/ /rgyu ni dbang phyug yin zhes zer/ /shes pa med pa'i bdag nyid ni/ /rang gi 'bras bu rtsom mi byed/ /rab rtsom byed pa'i yan lag gi/ /dbyibs ④ kyi khyad par dang ldan gang / /de ni blo ldan rgyus bskyed bya/ /bum pa sogs bzhin dbang po ni/ /gnyis kyis bzung ldudang bzung ba min/ /rtsod pa'i gzhi dang 'di 'dra bar/ /des na blo ldan sngon 'gro bar/ /chos mi mthun pa rdul du 'dod/ /de bzhin lus sogs 0pa yi rgyu/ /shes pa yod pas byin brlabs te/ /gzugs sogs ldan phyir rgyu spun 107—7

sogs / /rang gi 'bras bu byed mthong bzhin/ /chos dang chos min rdul phran kunatsho7/ /sems dang ldan pas byin brlabs te/ /rang gi 'bras bu byed sdod de/ /'jug phyir tshig pa rgyu spun bzhin/ /skyes bu skye ba'i dang po yi②/ /tha snyad gzhan gyis bstan las 'byung /bye// /rab sad rnams kyi 5nges pa'i phyir/ /byis pa yi no tha snyad bzhin/ /'byung ba che byesogs gsal ba ni/ /sems dang ldan pas byin brlabs na/ /'jig rten kun gyi bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal rgyu mtshan nyid du 'gyur/ /shes pa med trenyid 'bras nyid dang / / 'jigs nyid la 3sogs rgyu yi phyir/ /ste'u sogs bzhin de yi phyir/ /de ni yod par gsal bar shes/ /kun gyi byed po nyid grub pa blu/ /de ni sgrib med kun shes nyid / /grub ste 'di ltar byed pos ni/ /'bras bu'i ngo bo sogs rig lku byed/ /rtsod pa'i rten gyi rngudangos po ni/ /'ga' la shārtemangon sum du ni gsal/ /dngos po yod sogs gtan tshigs phyir/ /bde sogs ngo bo 8bye brag gi/ /sgrub pa dang po de la ni/ /gtan tshigs ma grub gang gi phyir/ /bkod pa spyor tso2ba zhes bya dang / /de bzhin yan lag can ma grub/ /bltar rung nyid du khas blangs pa/ /gnyis ka mi dmigs pa yi phyir/ /de yi phyir ni dpe 'di yang / /sgrub pa skyedang ldan skyem yin no/ /mig dang reg pa'i rnam shes ni/ /tha dad snang ba nye bar skye/ /de dag dmigs pa gcig nyid med/ /dri la sogs pa'i sa bon bzhiname/ /de dag gis ni mthu byung ba⑫/ /rtog dang 'byel pa'i bdag nyid can/ /nying mtshams sbyor ba'i shes pa yisaṅku/ /bsdus la zhen par byed pa yin/ /de phyir chu dang me sogs 'di/ /dbang po gnyis kyis ⑪gzung bya med/ /ji skad bshad pa'i chos can ni/ /ma grub phyir na gzhi ma 107—8

grub / /lha khang la sogs la bkod pa/ /khyad par can nyid ci 'dra ba/ /byed pa po ni mi dmigs na/ /gang mthong ba kyeni blo ldan rtogs/ /lus dang ri sogs chos can la/ /gal te de 'dra nyid snang na/ /sgrub pa 'di las ji lta bur / /'dod pa grub gyepa de rigs so/ /rjes su 'gro dang ldog pa yis/ /gang gi 1'bras bur gang nges pa/ /de mthong ba na de nges pa/ /zhes byar rigs 9pas gnas pa yin/ /dbyibs kyi khyad par de lta bu/ /lus dang shing la sogs pa'i dbyibs/ /khyad par 'di dag la med de/ /de 'dra ba ni rab brjod pa'i/ /sgra tsam 'ba' zhig kho na yis/ /ldog na the tshom za bar ni/ /sgrub par 'grub ste grog rngumakhar dag /rdza mkhan gyis ni byas pa bzhin/ /chos kyi khyad par rnam rtog phyir/ /'di ni ltag chod pya ma yin nam/ /'bras bu la sogs spyi nyid ni/ /sgrub pa yin pa'i mubastan ce na/ /de dngos po min las log pa'i/ /'bras bu tsam zhig mi rtag nyid/ /sgrub par byed de bdag phyir ro/ /sgrub byed de la de tshul med/ /me la 'khrul pa med par ni/ /du ba'i bdag nyid skya bo mthong / /skya bor brjod pa tsam nyid kyis/ /kha ba las kyang de rtogs kyemed/ /spyir 'brel ba la shā3gang gi tshe/ /khyad par dag la brten pa yi/ /klan ka de la tshol byed na/ /ltag chod yin par yang dag brjod / /gal te tshul 'dir mi brten par/ /gzhan du go sgra'i brjod pa tsam—/ /nyid kyis rdo rje la sogs la/ /rwa can nyid ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /gal te 'di la 'byel pa ni/ /tshad ma yis ni sgrub byed na/ /de phyir rig pas grub 'di la⑪/ /rtsod pa 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /'on kyang rtag gcig kun shes pa'i/ /blo rtag pa yi rten yin par/ /'grub par mi 'gyur khyab med phyir//107—9

bsgrub bya med pa nyid phyir ro/ /'di ltar khang ①skya them skas dang / /khang bzangs ⑤tshong dus la sogs pa/ /rnam shes du ma mi rtag pas/ /sngon du 'gro ba can du nges/ /de nyid phyir na 'dod pa la/ /gnod par byed par yang 'dod de1/ /rnam shes du ma mi rtag pa/ /sngon 'gro can nyid sgrub phyir ro/ /rgyu ni blo dang ldan tsam la/ /khyod kyis 'byel pa brjod pas na/ /gnyis pa la ni kho bo yis/ /rnam pa gsal ba brjod pa yin/ /rtag rnams rim dang rim min pa/ /'gal phyir bya ba byed ma yin/ /yul rnams rim can nyid kyi phyir/ /de shes rnams la'ang rim pa yod/ /shes bya rim can dang 'byel phyir/ /dbang phyug shes pa rim pas 'byung / /lha sbyin sogs kyi rnam par shes/ /'bar sogs spyod yul can bzhin no/ /kho bos bum pa la sogs pa/ /rdul phran tshogs can yin par 'dod/ /de yi byed po rdza mkhan sogs/ /rdul phran kho na'i byed por 'dod/ /de phyir chos mi mthun pa'i dpe/ /rdul phran rab tu bstan 'di las/ /bsgrub bya nyid du mngon 'dod pa'i/ /chos 'di log pa ma yin no/ /gal te spyir na blo ldan zhig /sngon du 'gro ba can 'dod na/ /de la rtsod chepa yong med do/ /ngo bo sna tshogs las skyes pa/ /rtag blo rngu gcig can sngon 'gro bar/ /bsgrub na bsgrub byas stong pa nyid/ /mang po rnams kyis khang skya sogs/ /byas par mthong phyir 'khrul ba yin/ /skyon 'di nyid ni ci rigs par / /gtan tshigs lhag ma dag la yang / /sbyar bar bya ste gzhan yang ni/ /cung zad tsam zhig rab bstan te/ /skad cig 'jig phyir rdul phran sogs/ /gdod nas 'jug par ma grub po/ /de yang rim dang ldan 'jug phyir/ /de nyid kyis na 'khrul ba'ang yin/ /kho bo 'jig tshe skyes bu rnams/ /rnam shes 107—10

dran pa 'jig mi 'dod/ /'od gsal lha sogs skye phyir dang / /de nyid nas ni 'dir ①skye phyir/ /kha med lung 'bogs 1 byed pa po/ /gal te dang bas rtogs 'gyur gyi①/ /lus 'bras nyid phyir kha med de/ /chos dang chos min med phyir ro/ /sgrub byed kun la khyab pa ni/ /rjes su dpag dang 'gal ba'ang yin/ /'gal ba'i chos kyi gtan tshigs ni/ /khyab par rung ba ma yin no / /skye ba med phyir dbang phyug ni/ /skye ba can gye rgyu ma yin/ /nam mkha' yi ni pad+ma bzhin/ /gzhan du thams cad cig car 'byung / /gang dag rim gyis 'byung ba ④yang / /de dag dbang phyug rgyu can min/ /ji skad bshad pa'i sgrub pa las/ /blun po yid ches bskyed ldu pa bzhin/ /de dag kyang de las byung na/ /sgrub pa brjod pa don med do/ /rtag phyir gso byed min pa la/ /de ni lhan cig byed ma yin/ /gang dag yod na 'byung mthong la/ /med na nam yang ma yin pa/ /de yi rgyu gzhan nyid rtog na/ /khyed la ji ltar thug med min—/ /byed pa po nyid bkag pa'i phyir/ /kun shes nyid kyang gsal 'ubar ni/ /rtogs bya de yi stobs nyid kyis/ /kun shes nyid du 'thad phyir ro/ /ji skad bshad pa'i nyes pa yis3/ /sgrub rnams sun phyung ma gyur kyang / /'on kyang 'khrul pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /byed pa po gcig ma grub na/ /thams cad shes nyid ci la ④brten/ /de sgrub phyir ni sgrub smras pa/ /rgyal dpog pa rnams la mdzes so/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las dbang phyug brtag pa ste gnyis pa'o// //de ltar rang bzhin dbang phyug dag /so sor rgyu nyid bkag pa'i phyir/ /107—11

gnyis ka lhan cig pa 'di yang / /skye ba can gyi byed po min/ /de dag lhan cig byed nyid du/ /brtags pa gang yin pa de yang / /khyad par skyed par byed phyir ram/ /don gcig byed pa'i phyir yin grang / /rtog pa dang po rigs min te/ /de dag 'gyur ba med phyir ro/ /gnyis pa'ang ma yin 'bras bu rnams/ /cig car thal bar 'gyur phyir ro/ /ci ste gtso bo'i ngo bo ni/ /tshul gsum nyid du rnam par gnas/ /de la dbang phyug 'di rdul dang / /ldan na 'byin pa'i rgyu yin no/ /snying stobs shas rmyecher 'jug pa la/ /gang tshe rten par byed pa na/ /de tshe 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan nyid du 'gyur/ /gang tshe mun pa'i nus pa ni/ /shas chen po dang sbyor ba na/ /de tshe 'di ni 'gro ba kun/ /'jigs 3 par byed pa yin zhes gragarngu /de ltar rdul dang snying stobs sogs/ /dngos /5rnams 'di yi lhan cig byed/ /rim pa kho nar 'byung 'gyur te/ /de phyir 'bras bu rim med yin/ /'dir brjod bya ste 'di dag ni/ /gcig byed tshe na srid dam gcig /sgrub pa'i mthu ste yod dam med/ /gal te yod na 'byin tshe gzhan/ /gnyis pa yang ni yod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan zhig yod na yang / /gnyis pa gzhan du thal bar 'gyur/ /de yi ngo bo ga/zhan gyis ni/ /gzhan gyi phyobyed po ma yin pas/ /'di yi rang bzhin 'di nyid ni/ /de yi bye brag ga la yod/ /de yi nus pa dang bral na/ /gzhan tshe de yi skyed pa por/ /mi 'gyur nus pas stong pa'i phyir//nam mkha' yi ni rnge tog bzhin/ /nus pa shas chen ngo bo yang / /gal te de tsam gyi rgyu na/ /rgyu yi ngo bo rtag nyi'i skyephyir/ /dus kun du ni de yod 'gyur/ /gzhan dag gis gzhan mi 'dod pa/ /de phyir gzhan las kyang de min/ /res 107—12

'ga' 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir/ /de ni rang dbang can yang yin/ /rang las byung na rgyu nyid min/ /rang la byed pa 'gal phyir ro/ /dngos po rnams ni ltos pa yis/ /res 'ga' ba nyid srid pa yin/ /'di ltar rang gi bdag nyid la/ /rang dngos bya ba 'jug mi 'dod/ /bdag nyid grub par gyur pa yang / /gnas skabs 'di la grub phyir ro/ /bdag gi de nyid ma grub pa/ /'ga' la byed pa 'gal nyid medakhye/ /nus pa kun dang bral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i pad+ma la sogs bzhin/ /de kho na nyid bsnyus pa'i rab tu byed pa las gnyis ka brtag pa ste gsum pa'o// //rang bzhin smra ba rnams kyis ni/ /dngos po rnams kyi skye ba 'di/ /rgyu kun la ni ltos med smra/ /de dag rang yang rgyur mi smra/ /pad+ma'i ge sar la sogs pa'i—/ /sna tshogs gang gis byed 'gyur ba'am/ /rma bya'i mdongs la sogs pa yis/ /sna tshogs pa ni ghu gang gis sprul/ /dper na tsher ma la sogs pa'i/ / rno sogs /3rgyu med can nyid de/ /res 'ga' 'byung phyir de bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal la sogs rgyu med nyid/ /rjes su 'gro ldog ldan pa yi/ /mtsho skyes ge sar la sogs pa/ /gnas skabs khyad par ldan pa yi/ /sa bon 'dam dang chu sogs can/ /mngon sum mi dmigs pa dag gi/ /rgyu ni nges pa nyid yin na/ /gang tshe 'di dag gi rgyun ni/ /gzhan gang yin zhes 'dri bar byed/ /yul dang dus kyi nges pa dag /ji ltar dngos po rnams la yod/ /gal te 'di yi de rgyu min/ /de dag kun du kun 'byung tshe/ /gang du gang tshe 'ga' zhig la/ /de las gzhan pa spangs nas ni/ /nges pa nyid du 'byung 'gyur ba/ /107—13

de dag de la ltos pa yin/ /de ltos de ltar 'byung ba yin/ /ltos pa 'bras bu nyid du brjod/ /mngon sum gyis kyang de ltar 'byung / /des na ①'di la rgyu dag 'grub/ /yang na de la zhes byar sbyar/ /de phyir rang bzhin smra ba 'di/ /mngon sum gyis ni rab gnod 'gyur/ /mngon sum dang ni mi dmigs pas/ /rgyu yi ngo bo nges phyir ro/ /rgyu yod par ni sgrub don du②/ /tshad ma yod nyid ma gyur mod/ /de lta na yang tshad med pas/ /don med nyid du nges pa min①/ /gang phyir don ni yod pa yi/ /tshad ma khyab byed dang rgyu min/ /tha dad par ni yod phyir dang / /'khrul phyir de las byung phyir ro/ /dngos gang de lta'i rnam pa min/ /de nyid dang ni ldog pa las/ /gzhan ldog par ni nges pa ru/ /mi rtogs je'abyel ba med phyir ro/ /kun kyis ma mthong the tshom dang / /rang gis ⑤ma mthong 'khrul pa ste/ /'bigs byed ri phug ngur pa sogs/ /ma mthong bar yang yod phyir ro/ /gal te rgyu med can nyid du/ /bsgrub phyir gtan tshigs mi sbyor na/ /tshad ma med par mi 'grub ste/ /de yi phyir na phyogs mi 'grub/ /gal te de grub phyir gtan tshigs/ /rab tu sbyor ba de lta na'ang / /grub pa de rgyus bskyed nyid phyir/ /khyed kyi phyogs kyi 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de ltar shes byed gtan tshigs dang / /de gsal byed pa'i yang de ni/ /grub pa'i rgyu mtshan nyid gyur pa/ /bsgrub bya'i shes byed yin par bshad/ /de phyir byed po ⑥'di nyid ni/ /shes par byed pa'i ⑦rgyur 'dod do/ /bsgrub 1 bya'i skyed byed ma yin phyir/ /byed pa por ni mi brjod do/ /de phyir dngos po gzhan dag kyang / /rgyu bcas nges las skyed phyir ro/ /khyed kyi bsgrub bya'i don yul can/ /shes pa bzhin du sgrub ⑨'byung phyir/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las 107—14

'gro ba rang bzhin du smra ba brtag pa ste bzhi pa'o// //skye 'jig med par yang dag ldan/ /sgra yi rang bzhin tshangs pa mchog /gang de yongs su gyur pa ni/ /dngos po'i grong nyid rab shes bya/ /de ltar gang dag brjod pa la'ang / /de la brjod bya ba 'di ni/ /rang gi sgra yi ngo bo ni—/ /btang nas sngo sogs nyid thob bam/ /de lta min na gang gi tshe/ /dang po'i phyogs rten de yi tshe/ /yi ge nyid dang bral 'gyur te/ /sngar yod dag ni 'jig phyir ro/ /ji ltar de ma thag pa'i phyogs/ /de la snga ngh+rusogs pyong ba'i tshe/ /'on pa la yang gsal por ni/ /sgra yi bdag nyid myong bar 'gyur / /gang gis gtso bor 'jug pa yis/ /thams cad sgra yi ngo bor gnas / /sgra yi ngo bo ma btang na/ /yongs su 'gyur bar brjod phyir ro/ /sngon po la sogs gcig nyid du/ /phal pa min par rnam gnas na/ /de rig du pa yi dus su ni/ /ji ltar 'di rig yod ma yin/ /'di rig med na sngo sogs kyang / /rab tu myong bar mi 'gyur te/ /gcig bdag nyid phyir tha dad chos/ /shin tu tha dad thal bar 'gyur/ /'gal ba'i chos dang 'byel pa yi/ /dngos rnams tha dad mtshan nyid yin/ /gzhan du gsal ba'i tha dad la'ang / /rtog pa 'di ni med par 'gyur/ /gal te dngos po so so yang / /sgra gcig bdag nyid dbyer med 'dod/ /thams cad yul gcig nyid dang ni/ /rnam pa gcig tu rig par 'gyur/ /'di gsal so so tha dad na/ /tshangs pa du mar thal 'gyur ①te/ /tha dad du ma dngos po'i bdag /ngo bo nyid phyir gsal byed ④bzhin/ /sgra yi rang bzhin rtag nyid na⑤/ /dngos rnams kyang ni rtag 107—15

nyid de/ /de dag cig car grub pa'i phyir/ /yo ngas su grub na ①mi rigs so/ /ngo bo gcig ni mi gsal zhing bye/ /ngo bo gzhan ni 'byung 'gyur na/ /'ji sogs bzhin du 'grub 'gyur ba/ /rim med la ni yongs gyur med/ /gzhan yang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ni/ /'gro ba'i sgra tshangs rang bzhin na/ /de lta na yang 'gyur med phyir/ /de las rim par zhu'abyung ba med/ /rang bzhin gcig po de nyid las/ /gzhan gzhan ngo bor 'byung min na/ /don gyi ngo bor yongs gyur par/ /de la ji ltar brjod par bya/ /de yi ngo bo min las ldog /'ji ba'i ngo bo nyid dmigs phyir/ /kham bum la sogs khyad par la/ /'ji ba'i bdag nyid gcig tu rtog /sngo dang ser sogs khyad par la/ /sgra bdag min las ldog pa ni/ /de nyid la ni mi dmigs te/ /de phyir rtog pa'ang sa bon med/ /ci ste tshangs pa'i de nyid 'di/ /rtag tu cha med nyid gnas pa/ /ma rig gis babe+ed 'jig rten gyis④/ /sna tshogs nyid du mngon par sems/ /de la'ang ma rig pas 'khrul ba'i/ /skye bo rnams kyis gzugs rtogs 'gyur/ /gang zhig sngo sogs rnam trepa ru/ /blang dang dor ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /de yi ngo bo las ldog hūṃpa'i/ /tshangs pa'i ngo bor shes pa med/ /ji ltar sdang ④ba'i sems rnams kyis/ /yod pa nyid du shes mi 'gyur/ /de ni mngon sum gyis 'grub min/ /cha med snang ba med phyir ro/ /rtag las skye ba rigs min pas/ /de las 'bras bu'i rtags kyang med/ /chos can yod nyid ma grub phyir/ /rang bzhin sgrub rju byed ma yin no/ /de dag las ni ma rtogs ⑨pa'i / /yod par sgrub 3pa'i rtags med do/ /shes bya yi ⑪ni go rims las/ /shes kun go rims can du grub/ /gzhan du cig car nyid du ni/ /de 'bras 107—16

rnam shes thal bar 'gyur/ /'di ni shes pa tsam la yang / /nus pa'i dngos med de las ①gzhan/ /yin na 'di na mo gsham gyi/ /bu dang mtshungs par thal bar 'gyur/ /rnam dag ye shes rgyu can gyi/ /rnal 'byor pas kyang tshangs pa'i dngos/ /de mi shes te de yi phyir/ /shes la bya ba 'byel med phyir/ /gtso bo yongs su 'gyur ba 1dang / /tshangs pa'i lta ba mtshungs pa'ang min/ /tshangs pa'i mthong ba gtso bo yi/ /yongs su 'gyur ba dang yang mtshungs/ /de yi sun 'byin rjes 'brangs nas/ /'di la sun 'byin rtogs par bya/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las sgra'i tshangs pa brtag pa ste lnga pa'o// //nyes par bshad pa'i grub mtha' yi/ /rjes 'jug blo can gzhan dag 1ni//dbang phyug chos mtshungs skyes bus thu ni/ /'jig rten rgyur ni rtogs snyepar byed/ /dngos po ma lus 'jig na yang / /shes pa nus ldan 'jig pa med/ /ba rgya rnams kyis kyeb bzhin du/ /de ni skye ldan rgyu ru grag 3 /dbang phyug bzhin du 'di la yang / /sun 'byin thams cad brjod par bya8/ /'di yi bya ba 'di 'dra 'di/ /ci yi phyir na byed pa yin/ /gal te gzhan gyis rab sbyar phyir/ /'di ni rang dbang nyid 'gyur min/ /'on te brtse bas byed 'gyur na/ /'gro ba gcig tu bde bar 'gyur/ /nad dang dbul dang mya ngan sogs/ /sdug bsngal du mas gzir ba yi/ /skye ba 'byin par byed pa de'i/ /rjes su brtse ba ji ltar shes/ /'byin pa'i snga na snying rje'i yul/ /med na rjes brtse 'thad ma yin / /gang dang 'byel par gyur pa las/ /'di ni 'byen pa por rtog byed//rtag tu bde dang ldan rnams kyikye / /'jig pa 'di yis byed mi 'gyur/ /de 107—17

yis ma mthong la ltos na/ /rang dbang nyid ni nyams par 'gyur/ /ma mthong sbug bsngal gyis rgyu la/ /ci phyir de ni ltos par byed/ /'di ni brtse dang ldan yin na/ /de la btang stoms bya bar rigs/ /gal te de 'jug rtsed mo'i don//rtsed mo la ni gtso bo min/ /rtsed mo'i thabs ni sna tshogs pa①/ /ltos pa'i phyir na gzhon nu bzhin/ /rtsed mo bsgrub bya'i dga' gang dang / /de yi sgrub ⑤byed gang yin des gru/ /gal te de byed nus ldan na/ /de kun cig car byed par 'gyur/ /dang por de nus ldan min na/ /rim rngugazhan du yang nus med 'gyur / /dngos po dbye ba med pa la/ /nus dang mi nus mi rigs so/ /'on te rang bzhin nyid las 'di/ /'jug pa la sogs la brjod de/ /dper na me sogs rang bzhin gyis/ /sreg pa la sogs las la bzhin/ /gal te de ltar 1yin de las/ /dngos po ma lus cig car 'byung / /de dag skyed pa'i nus pa dang / /ldan pa'i rgyu ni nye phyir ro/ /me la sogs pa'i dngos rnams la/ /nges pa nyid kyi thunus pa dag /dus kun du ni 'byung min te/ /rang gi rgyu stobs las byung dz+waphyir/ /gzhan du gal te ngag gi 'am/ /nges 'di khas mi len na ni/ /'bras bu thams cad cig car ni/ /yang dag 'byung ba nyid du 'gyur / /ba rgya ba lang 3rang bzhin kyi/ /snal ma'i rgyur ni rngumi 'dod de/ /gang phyir srog chags za 'dod las/ /kha chu yi ni dra ba byed/ /gal te ci ⑪ zhig ltar 'jug na/ /'di yi 'byung ldan ci 'dra zhig /gang gi phyir na nya pa yang / /ma dpyad las la 'jug mi 'gyur/ /dpa' bo'i bu dang bdag skyes sogasaṅge4 / /rnam pa de dag nyid kyis ni/ /byed pa por yongs brtags pa yang / /yongs su'ang de dag sun phyung 'gyur/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i 107—18

rab tu byed pa las skyes bu brtag pa ste drug pa'o// //gzhan dag kyang ni 'dir bdag nyid/ /'dod la sogs pa'i rten gyur pa//de bzhin rtag dang kun 'jug can/ /rang nyid sems med ngo bor 'dod/ /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams kyi/ /byed pa po dang de 'bras kyi/ /za ba po yin sems 'byel phyir/ /sems yin rang bzhin ①ngo bos min/ /shes dang rtsom sogs dang 'byel ba/ /de la byed pa po nyid brjod/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sogs rig pa'i/ /'du byeb las ni za ba po/ /de yi ③ris mthun khyad par dang / /blo rnams dang ni tshor ba ni/ /sngar med rnams dang 'byel pa yis—/ /de la skye bar bya mngon par brjod/ /sngar blangs pa dang bral ba ni/ /'chi ba yin te 'tsho ba yang / /chos dang chos min 'dus byas pa'i/ /lus babs yid dang 'byel pa'o rgya / /lus dang mig sogs gnod pa'i phyir/ /'di la 'tshe bar rnam par brtag /'di ltar skyes bu rtag pa la'ang / /tha snyad bye 'di ni dri med 'dod/ /nga shes bya ba'i nus pa dang / /lus la sogs ni tha dad pa'i/ /rig par byed pas ④ rig yin te/ /shes phyir de las gzhan pa bzhin/ /'dod pa la sogs thams cad kyang / /de dag 'ga' zhig la brten nyid/ /dngos nyid yin pas 'bras nyid phyir/ /gzugs bzhin nyid kyi skyes bu de/ /dngos nyid smos pa'i 3 phyir na 'di/ /'jig la ⑨ 'khrul ldan ma yin te/ /'jig pa rgyu can nyid na yang / /gang phyir dngos nyid ma yin no/ /gzugs sogs shes pa thams cad kyang / /gcig dang du ma'i mtshan nyid can/ /nga shes ⑩bya ba'i shes pa dang / /de dag mtshams ni sbyor nyid phyir/ /gar 107—19

mkhan smin khyugs tūgayo ba la/ /mang po dag gis shes pa bzhin/ /rnam pa gzhan du 1mtshams sbyor ba/ /rgyu med par ni skye mi 'gyur/ /bdag ces bya ba'i tshig 'di ni/ /blo dang dbang sogs tshogs pa las/ /tha dad par ni rjod byed yin1/ /rab grags mi las tha dad na/ /gang phyir tshig gcig nyid 'dod phyir/ /gang yang de ltar nges gyur pa/ /ji skad bshad pa'i chos dang ni//der 'byel bum pa'i sgra bzhin no/ /gson pa yi ni lus 'di ni/ /srog sogs dang yang bral 'gyur te/ /bdag nyid phyir na bum pa bzhin/ /de phyir 'di la bdag med med/ /rnam shes phyi ma thams cad ni/ /skyes ma thag pa'i thog ma yi/ /shes pa'i rig byed kyis rig ste/ /shes phyir de yi rang so bzhin//thag ring yul na gnas gyur pa'i/ /bdag dang ldan pa nyid yin te/ /lus can sogs phyir bdag lus bzhinathu/ /de ltar bdag ni yod dang rtag /khyab byed dag tu nges yin na/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med pa/ /zhes byar gnas pa ma yin no/ /de lta byebu 'dir re zhig ni/ /sgrub byed dang po grub pa sgrub / /gang phyir khyod kyi shes pa ni/ /kun mkhyen sogs kyi shes byar 'dod//gsal byed la ni ltos med par/ /rang rig ngo bor skye 'gyur ba/ /de ltar gzhan gyi rnam shes kyang / /dpe ni bsgrub byas stong pa yin/ /de yi rnam par nyer bsgyur ba'i/ /gzhan gyis rab tu shes par 'gyur/ /de dpe nyid du brjod na yang / /gzhan gyi sgo nas the tshom 'gyur/ /gal te 'dod pa la sogs kyi/ /'ga' zhig rten du rab bsgrub khyen/ /gal te de la rgyu tsam nyid/ /rten du yongs su rtog na ni/ /'dod pa sgrub dze+eyin gal te yang / /de bzhin ①rten du khyod 'dod na/ /de tshe'ang rgyu bas stong pa yi⑨/ /rten du rtog pa don 107—20

med yin/ / rgya shug ①'bras bu sogs kyi gzhi/ /mkhar gzhong la sogs bcad pa yin1 / /thong ba'i bgegs dag khyebyed phyir ram/ /khyad par dag ni skyed phyir ro/ /'jig ④pa dngos po med pa yang / /'bras bu nyid du rigs ldan min/ /de phyir gzhan gyi gtan tshigs 'dir/ /khyad par smras pa'i don med do/ /ma rig pa yis bslad pa las/ /nga yis zhes dang mtshalas sbyar ④'di/ /dngos po skad cig ma dag la'ang / /byed po gcig tu zhen par 'jug /log pa'i rnam par rtog 'di las/ /de nyid gnas pa'i rigs gyem yin/ /nus lhag ⑦khyad par las byedad kyang / /gcig gi rgyu mtshan byed par 'gyur/ /gzugs dang sgra sogs sems dag ni/ /rjes 'khor gcig gi rngu'abras nyid na/ /snga phyi dag ni 'gal 'gyur te/ /nus pa'i rgyu ni nye phyir ro/ /rnam shes de ma thag gcig las/ /rnam shes drug po 'byung ba ni/ /gsal bar cig car rig 'gyur te/ /de phyir 'dod pa'i sgrub byed yin/ /rim pa can la rgyu gcig nyid//med ces de ma thag tu bstan/ /de phyir 'di yi khyab pa hūṃl/ /rjes dpag gis gnon shā1gsal por mthong / /gar mkhan smin khyugs g.yo ba ni/ /don dam par ni gcig nyid min/ /rdul phran du ma'i tshogs nyid phyir/ /de la gcig tu rtogs 8pa'i phyir/ /'bras bu gcig la nye spyor phyir/ /sgra gcig gi ni spyod yul yin/ /bsgrub bya'ang 1rternam pa de lta bur/ /gal te 'dod na grub pa sgrub/ /blo dang sems la sogs pa'i sgra/ /kho bo cag gi rnam grangs dag /tshig gcig yin yang tha dad pa'i/ /rjod par byed pa nyid ma yin/ /de phyir gtan tshigs ma nges pa'o/ /de yi khyad par smras min rngunam/ /de nyid ma grub par smras na/ /sems rnams ⑫grangs su gnas shes bya/ /nga rgyal gyi ⑫ni 107—21

rten nyid kyis/ /sems la bdag ces brjod pa ni/ /kun rdzob tu yin don dam par/ /'di yi yul ni yod ma yin/ /mkha' dkyil pad+ma sogs pad+ma/ /byed pa po la sogs pa'i tshig /gcig gi ①rnam par sbyor byed na/ /des ni 'khrul pa dag kyang mthong / /brda tsam las ni byung ba yi/ /tshig dag gang du'ang bhu'abrel pa med/ /bdag la sogs pa'i tshig dag la'ang / /rang bzhin kyis rngu don gsal byed med/ /gang tshe bdag dang lhan cig tu/ /srog sogs 'byel pa 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de tshe thal ba 'di rigs kyi/ /rnam pa gzhan du mi rigs so/ /mo gsham bu yis rngu stong nyid ni/ /gson lus srog sogs dang bral bar3 / /thal bar mi 'gyur de bzhin du/ /khyod kyi thal 'gyur 'di nyid yin/ /re zhig 'di la de bdag med/ /de dag tha dad khas len phyir/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid kyang min/ /cig car thal bar 'gyur phyir ro / /de yi phyir na nyid ldog pa/ /de dang 'byel pa med pa yi/ /dbugs kyi 'byung rngub sogs 'di dag /ci phyir lus las ldog par 'gyur/ /de ltar sgrub byed thams cad kyis/ /bdag yod /bye ma grub pa yi phyir/ /rtag dang khyab pa nyid dag gi/ /dpe ni bsgrub ⑦byas stong par bstan/ /gzhan dag gis bdag mngon sum gyis/ /grub pa nyid du yongs su brtags/ /gang phyir 'ong zhes rang rig ste/ /yul ni bdag yin par 'dod do/ /de ni mi rigs nga zhes la/ /de yi ngo bor mi snang phyiradze+e/ /gang phyir de la rtag pa dang / /khyab sogs snang ba shes pa med/ /'di ni kha dog dkar sogs su/ /snang ba gsal bar rig 'gyur na/ /de yi rang bzhin bdag mi 'dod/ /de phyir de yi yul can 'di⑨/ /gal te skyes bu yang dag par/ /mngon sum gyis ni shes 107—22

gyur na/ /de bas ci phyir rtsod pa 'di/ /de yod sogs la 'jug par 'gyur/ /'di ltar nges par bya ba 'di/ /nges pa'i bdag nyid du 'jug cing / /nges pa dang ni sgo 'dogs blo/ /gnod bya gnod byed nyid du gnas/ /de phyir 'dod sogs thams cad ni/ /bdag dang 'du ba ma yin nyid/ /rim byis ①skye ba nyid kyi phyir/ /sa bon myu gu'i lcug ①sogs bzhin/ /yang ni ①nang gi bdag nyid kun/ /bdag med nyid kyis lus can te④/ /dngos dang yid sogs gtan tshigs phyir/ /dper na phyi rol bum sogs bzhin/ /bdag bcas nyid na ⑤de rgyu bcas du/ /rtag pa nyid du thal bar 'gyur/ /rtag rnams kyang don byed nus min/ /de phyir yod nyid la sogs srid/ /bum sogs la mtshungs bdag med pa/ /gzhan dag gis ni gson lus la/ /bkag pa gang yin de yang ni 3/ /kho bo cag gis 'dir bsgrub bya/ /de ltar bdag ni ma grub na'ang / /de la rnam gzhag ṣ+pebyas pa gang / /de kun gnas med nyid yin te/ /mo gsham la ni rnam gzhag yin rmye / /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las rigs pa can dang bye brag pas kun tu brtags pa'i skyes bu brtag pa ste bdun pa'o// //gzhan dag bdag ni ldog pa dang / /rjes 'gro bdag nyid can gyi ni/ /sems pa'i ngo bo nyid du 'dod/ /sems pa'i blo yi mtshan nyid can/ /dper na sbrul 'khyil gnas skabs na/ /ldog cing de ma thag tu ni/ /drang po'i gnas skabs byung na yang / /sbrul nyid du ni rjes 'jug 'gyur/ /de bzhin bdag ni rtag tu ni/ /sems pa'i rang bzhin can yin yang / /ngo bo ma lus 107—23

ldog pa dang / /kun kyi rjes su 'jug pa'ang min/ /'on kyang 'di yi bde snyug sogs/ /mtshan nyid gnas skabs ldog 'gyur zhing / /de dag ldog cing skye 'gyur yang / /sems nyid rjes su 'jug par 'gyur/ /gtan du 'jig na byas chud zos/ /ma byas phrad pa dag du ①'gyur/ /dngos gcig can sdela'ang sdug bsngal dang ༷ —/ /bde sogs longs spyod med par 'gyur/ /byed po nyid dang za bo dag /skyes bu'i gnas la de mi brten/ /de phyir skal ldan nyid kyi ④phyir / /byed rgyapo nyid kyis de 'u'abras thob/ /rnam pa de lta'i skyes bu 'di/ /ngo shes pa ni yod pa'i phyir/ /rtogs ④par 'gyur te 'di nyid kyis/ /bdag med pa la rab tu gnod/ /bdag rigs blubyed do zhes bdag blos/ /shes pa po ni rtogs byed na/ /gal te de ni 'ga' yin nam/ /gcig tu 'jig pa'i shes pa yin/ /gcig tu mi rtag nyid du 'gyur/ /gal te de yul bdag yin na / /de tshe ma lus 'tsham par 'gyur/ /skad cig ma yi shes phyogs la/ /thams cad shin tu 'byel par dka'/ /'di ltar sngon ni nga nyid kyis/ /shes gyur sh+yid ltar du yang ni 6/ /nga nyid rig par byed ces pa'i/ /blo gang skye bar 'gyur ba ste/ /'on te de yi //nyeyul shes pa'i/ /skad cig ma ni gang yin brtag /'das pa 'am ni da ltar ci/ /gnyis ka 'am ni 'on te rgyun/ /de la dang po'i shes pa'i yul/ /shes par gyur zhes bya bar rigs/ /shes par byed ces de mi rigs/ /gang phyir da ltar de rig ⑫med/ /da ltar ba ni yul nyid na/ /rigs ⑫ pa 'thad par byed do zhes/ /shes gyur ⑫ zhes bya brdzun yin te/ /de nyid phyir na 6de yi ni/ /gnyis ka bzung brtag de mi bya⑩/ /gang phyir gnyis ka shes gyur dang / /da ltar gnyis ka shes byed min/ /rgyun 107—24

yang de mtshungs bya min te/ /gnyis ka yang ni med phyir ro/ /'di ni shes par gyur min zhing / /da ltar kyang min dngos med phyir/ /de phyir bshad pa las gzhan pa'i/ /spyod yul gang la nga 'di snyam/ /'jug phyir rtag ①pa'i dngos ldan phyir/ /bdag 'di 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /nga zhes pas bzung 'das pa yi/ /shes byed da ltar yang 'jug ste/ /nga yis bushes pas rtogs ④bya'i phyir/ / da ltar ④ rig par byed po bzhin/ /shes byed byade yang khar ⑥ rtsang yod/ /shes byed phyir dang de nyid phyir/ /khar ④rtsang shes pa po bzhin no/ /shes pa de dag bsgrub bya nyid/ /rgyud gcig dang 'byel ldushes pa po'i / /nga shes shes pa nyid kyi phyir/ /khar du/rtsang de ring yod pa kun/ /don mtshungs can yin blo gcig bzhin/ /de lta bu 'dir dpyad bya ste/ /gal te sems ni rtag gcig pur/ /'dod pa de ltar yin blo yang / /de yi rang bzhin nyid thob 'gyur/ /blo dag dang ni skyes bu ni/ /nged hūṃkyi sems kyi rang bzhin phyir/ /rtag nyid dang ni gcig nyid 'dod/ /gal te tha dad yul rten can—/ /dper na me ni rang bzhin gyis/ /rtag tu sreg par byed las can/ /bsreg skyebya'i don nye gyur pa sreg /gzhan du min gzhan gyi tshe na'ang / /dper na gsal ba'i me long ⑫ dang / /ji ltar shing gi rdo dang ni/ /gang zhig kho na nyer gyur pa/ /de yi rnam pa der thob byed/ /de bzhin rtag pa'i sems nyid kyi/ /skyes bu lus la gnas pa rnams/ /dbang pos blangs pa'i gzugs ⑫la sogs/ /'dzin byed 'di ni kho bo'i 6blo/ /nye phyir nye bar 'thob byed pa'i—/ /byed pa 'jig phyir blo 'jig can/ /ji ltar bsreg bya nye med phyir/ /me ni rtag tu sreg byed min/ /de la rtogs 6 pa'i blo bdag nyid/ /blo ni ngo 107—25

shes par byed de/ /bum pa glang po la sogs blo/ /de tha dad phyir 'jig rten 'dod / /tha dad don rjes 'brang ①rnams kyis/ /blo de nyid ces brjod mi bya/ /don tha dad la mi rten dhin/ /ngo shes med pa ma yin no/ /'o na glang po sogs stong pa'i/ /sa la sgro 'dogs byed pa yi/ /shes pa gang dag rab 'jug pa/ /der ni tha dad ci la brten/ /gal te yul gzhan sogs yod pa'i/ /gsal ba rnams ni rgyu mtshan yin/ /gang phyir yul dus gzhan gyi bdag /thams cad du ni dmigs pa yin/ /'o na yul de dang 'byel ba/ /de ltar de dag la med nyid/ /de phyir der yang rang bzhin des/ /ci phyir de ltar snang bar byed//khyod kyi gzhung gis dublo rnams ni/ /blo min phyi rol du rjod byed/ /brjod par 'dod pa'i yul der ④yang / /glang po rta ⑤sogs gnas pa med/ /gal te don kun rig/ pa yin 3/ /ngo bor blo ni rtag gnas na/ /thams cad tshe na kun rig paraghu/ /des na ci phyir rig ma yin/ /sgra yi khyad par can blo gang //de nyid ro gzugs sogs yul can/ /'dir 3 yin phyir ro gal te min/ /tha dad rang gi tshig gis bstan/ /bsreg bya'i dngos po ma lus pa/ /me yang rtag tu sreg ⑪byed pa'i/ /bdag nyid can min gzhan du na/ /ma lus thal bar byed par 'gyur/ /bsreg bya'i don nyid nye ba na/ /de ni de sreg ⑫ bdag nyid rigs/ /de lta na ni don rnams kun/ /cig car nyid sreg thal mi 'gyur//ut+pal sngo sogs 'byel pa las/ /gre long dang ni shel la sogs/ /de gzugs brnyan du 'khrul bskyed pa'i/ /rgyu yin skad cig gis 'jig can/ /gzhan du khyad par bcas pa dang / /cig shos gnas skabs gcig nyid phyir/ /rtag tu de yi rnam ⑪pa 'am/ /de dang bral bar snang bar 'gyur/ /brtan nyid ⑫phyir 107—26

dang gting med phyir/ /lus can lhan cig mi gnas phyir/ /me long dbus kyi gzugs brnyan ni/ /nam yang 'dzin par byed ma yin/ /logs ⑫ gnyis gnas pa dag gis kyang / /shel rdo bzhin du dkar po ru/ /mthong 'gyur 'di yi phyir 'dis kyang / /gzugs brnyan thob par 'gyur ba min/ /gal te de yi gzugs brnyan thob/ /de la don dam par yod na/ /khyad par so sos shel ④sogs ni/ /tha dad par ni thal bar 'gyur/ /de phyir sna tshogs bsam mi khyab/ /nus can de dag la 'di 'khrul/ /blo la 'khrul pa'i dngos po yang /mi rigs tha dad bral phyir ro/ /ma rtogs ngo bo las ldog pa/ /blo kun dag la mtshungs pa yin/ /sgo 'dogs zupa yi gcig shes nyid/ /sna tshogs nyid la'ang 'jug par 'gyur/ /gnas skabs rnams kyi tha dad kyis ④ / /tha dad pas stong des gnas pas rgya / /brtan pa'i rang bzhin can bdag la/ /gang gzhan gyis ni kun brtags 'di sne/ /kho bo'i skyes bus sdug bsngal sogs/ /gnas skabs thob par byed na yang / /shel dang rdzas yod nyid sogs kyis/ /ngo bo 'dod par ⑦ mi byed nyid/ /gnas skabs gzhan ni skye 'gyur tshe/ /snga ma shin tu 'jig mi 'gyur/ /phyi ma'i rjes mthun don du na/ /spyi bdag nyid la thim par 'gyur/ /rang gi ngo bos gnas skabs dag /phan tshun du ni 'gal ba nyidadzu / /spyi yi bdag ni thams cad du/ /'gal med par ni shes par bya/ /de la gal te skyes bu las/ /gnas skabs gcig tu tha dad min/ /de dag skye 'jig yod pa na/ /'di la'ang de dag de bzhin 'gyur/ /'gal ba'i chos dang 'brel 'gyur na/ /gcig tu tha dad nyid 'gyur te/ /ji ltar spyod kyis ⑨skyes bu rnams/ /rang bdag so sor nges pa bzhin/ /gal te khyed kyi gnas 107—27

skabs rnams/ /rang gi ngo bos skyes bu la/ /zhi ⑨thim 'gyur sogs 'byung ba'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal sogs de'ang myong bar 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi ngo bo 'pho 'gyur na3sna/ /gzhan 'pho bar yang mi 'dod cing / /de yi bdag nyid 'pho 'gyur na'ang / /de phyir bdag ni skye ldan 'gyur/ /gal te byed po za bo dag /gnas skabs la brten ma yin na/ /de phyir skabs ldan de nyid 'gyurazhu/ /byed po sogs nyid yod mi 'gyur/ /de phyir rtag sgras ④brjod bya nyid/ /bdag la bzlog par bya ba min skye/ /rang gi ngo bo'i 'gyur ldan phyir/ /de ni chad par 'gyur ba yin/ /sbrul yang skad cig 'jig nyid phyir/ /'khyog pa la sogs thob 'gyur gye/ /rten dngos yin na skyes bu bzhin/ /gnas skabs gzhan khudang 'brel pa med/ /nga'o snyam pa'i shes pa 'di/ /dmigs pa med pa nyid du ni/ /thog med sems can du blta 3ba'i/ /sa bon stobs las 'gar nyid 'jug /gang phyir 'du byed 'ga' zhig nyid/ /de yi rang gi ngo bor zhen/ /bdag po nyid ni thob byed de2/ /de phyir kun du 'jug mi 'gyur//gzhan du khyed kyi skyes bu la'ang / /brgal zhing brtag pa mtshungs pa yin/ /de phyir tha dad nus yod pas/ /thams cad rtsod pa med par 'gyur/ /rtag pa dmigs pa'i phyogs la ni17/ /de bas nga 'o snyam pa kun/ /cig car nyid du skye 'gyur te/ /nus rgyu rnam par gnas phyir ro/ /mi rtag dmigs pa nyid la yang / /gsal bar snang 'gyur de yi phyir/ /gzhan dag dmigs don yod pa ru/ /brgal zhing brtag ṅkupa don med do/ /shes pa po la ngo shes ni//bag chags kyis ni byed rigs kyi/ /de ma yin la de shes pa'i/ /shes min 'di ni 'khrul rgyu min/ /de phyir nga snyam shes 'khrul pa/ /mi 'dod gnod 107—28

med phyir zhe na/ /ma yin bshad ma thag pa yi/ /rigs pas de la gnod mthong phyir/ /dbang phyug sogs la dad rnams kyi/ /de rgyu sogs su 'khrul pa ni/ /bag chags tsam gyi ngo bo las/ /ji ltar sna tshogs skye bar 'gyur / /de ltar gang tshe nga'o snyam/ /dmigs med nyid du gnas pa yin//de phyir nga shes kyis bzung 1ba'i/ /shes byed 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /de phyir tshad ma thams cad la/ /dpe ni 'ga' yang thuyod ma yin/ /gtan tshigs rnams kyang gzhi ma grub/ /bstan pa rnams la ci rigs byesbyar/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las dpyod byepa pas brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa ste brgyad pa'o// //gzhan ni shes pa'i blo yi ni/ /rang dngos khyad par yin par sems/ /de dag sems la bdag nyid kyi/ /rang gi ngo bor rtogs thupar byed/ /gtso bos bstabs pa'i 'bras bu la/ /de ni longs spyod 'ba' bye snazhig byed/ /de la byed pa nyid yod min/ /rang bzhin kho na der 'dod do/ /de la'ang gal te sems gcig 'dod/ /gzugs dang sgra sogs sems 3dag gi/ /rang bzhin tha dad dang ldan par/ /shin tu gsal bar ru7ji ltar rigs/ /sems ni rang bzhin gcig pa can/ /dus kun du ni gnas pa la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs don rnams kyi/ /longs spyod por ni ji ltar 'thad/ /lta 'dod la sogs tha dad rnams / /de yi longs spyod rgyu mtshan du/ /'byung min de ltar 'byung yin na//skyes bu skye ba dang ldan 'gyur/ /gang phyir sems las tha dad pa'i/ /lta 'dod la sogs de mi 'gyur/ /de la skye dang 'jig thob na/ /skyes bu la yang 107—29

'di bzlog ka1 /gal te dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /las ni bdag gis byas nyid min/ /de phyir 'di yi longs spyod kyi/ /tha dad pa ni gang snelas skye/ /gal te 'dod dang rjes mthun pa①/ /rang bzhin gyes rab ster byed de/ /de dag gi ni 'byel pa 'di/ /zha bo long ba bzhin du gnas/ /gal te de ltar 'dod pa la/ /sred pa yod kyang ci yi phyir/ /'grub par mi byed rang bzhin ni / /gzhan la cung zad ltos mi 'gyur/ /don las ④longs spyod dus su yang / /gal te 'di la 'gyur med na/ /'di ni za po nyid min zhing / /rang bzhin yang ni phan byed min/ /rnam par 'gyur ba yod gyur na/ /rtag pa nyid ni nyams par 'gyur khya / /rnam 'gyur rnam pa gzhan nyid na/ /gnas skabs na yang de ji ltar/ /yul gyi rnam pa can blo ni/ /thog mar rab tu 'jug byed cing / /de yis nges par byas pa'i don/ /skyes bu yis ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /de ltar 'di yi za po nyid/ /gzugs brnyan skye ba'i sgo can te/ /skyes hūṃbu 'di yi rang ngo bo/ /nam yang 'dor med min snyam na/ /brjod par bya ste gzugs brnyan ni/ /de yi bdag nyid du skye 'gyur/ /skye ldan du nyid du 'gyur zhing / /tha dad yin ④ na za po med/ /sems nyid bdag nyid can gtso bo/ /sna tshogs sgrub kyepa'i khyad par la/ /lta 'dod sogs kyi rjes mthun par / /ji ltar yang dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gtso bos tshad ma la sogs pa//byed pa shes pa rnam shes dang / /bza' bar mi shes zhes bya bar/ /'di las mi rigs bye/gzhan ci yod/ /gtso bor blo dang ldan nyid phyir/ /'di la kun 'gal ⑪med ce na/ /'o na blo ldan nyid yin na/ /skyes bu bzhin du sems nyid thob/ /blo dang rnam zhen pa ⑪dang ni/ /de bzhin rig dang rig byed dang / /707—30

sems dang nyams myong zhes bya ba/ /thams cad sems kyi rjod ①byed yin/ /skye ldan 'jig pa'i rtag dag gi①/ /sgra dri ro sogs bzhin du ni/ /blo ni sems pa med pa yi/ /bdag nyid can du 'dod ce na/ /sgrub byed rang rgyud nyid 'dod na/ /gtan tshigs 'di dag gnyis ka la/ /ma grub thal 'gyur brjod 'dod na/ /bzlog pa la ni gnod pa med/ /sems pa nyid la'ang bdag gi rngusgrar/ /zhen na'ang nga la gnod pa med/ /gal te rtag nyid bsgrub dka' ste/ /mig sogs 'bras bcas nyid phyir ro/ /gal te sems pa nyid rtag na/ /mig dang don sogs 'bras med 'gyur/ /gal te me ni rtag gyur na//bud shing don med 'gyur ba yin/ /mal cha dang ni stan ④bzhin du/ /'dus pa'i gtan tshigs de nyid kyis/ /mig la sogs pa rnams la ni/ /gzhan don nyid gang rab bstan nas/ /gal te khyad par byar rung gi/ /de nyid de dag la bsgrub phyen/ /'dod sgrub bye gang phyir de dag ni/ /'jig pa'i shes la me phan byed 'dod/ /'gyur med phan la phan byed nyid/ /sgrub na dpe ni bsgrub bya yiblu/ /stong pa yin te de dag kyang / /g.yo ba nyid la phan byed rigs/ /gal te phyir ni gzhan don du/ /de dag la ni rab bsgrub shesnapa/ /de lta na yang sgrub don med/ /sems la phan byed sgrub hūṃphyir ro/ /phan byed nyunyedu ma smos pa'i phyir/ /chogs ⑫pa nyid 'dir brjod pa yin/ /bya ba yi ni yul nyid na/ /gzhan gyi don ni sgrub byed min/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las ser skya pas kun du brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa ste dgu pa'o// //rgyal dpog pa bzhin rgyal ba pa/ /rdzas dang rnam grangs ngo bo yis⑫ /707—31

sdog dang rjes 'gro bdag nyid can/ /skyes bu shes pa'i mtshan nyid smra/ /de la'ang rdzas ni rnam grangs dang / /gal te 'byel du gyur med na/ /de la khyad par med pa'i phyir/ /de ni 'gyur ba can mi 'gyur/ /yul dang dus dang rang bzhin dag /tha dad med phyir gcig tu brjod/ /grangs dang mtshan nyid ming dang don/ /tha dad phyir na tha dad brjod1/ /gzugs sogs rnams dang bum pa zhes/ /grangs dang ming gi rnam dbye dang / /'bras bu dang ni rjes pya'ajug ldog /mtshan nyid dang ni don rnams ①dbye/ /rdzas dang rnam grangs dag gi yin/ /de ltar gcig tu khyad med can/ /dzas min rnam grangs tha dad kyis/ /bdag nyid khyad par 'gyur zhe na/ /nges par khyad par ldan pa yi/ /rang bzhin dbyer med gcig nyid de/ /de lta yin na tha dad nyid / /ji jeltar yang ni bsgrub 3 dka' ste/ /rnam grangs sogs kyi dngos dag bzhin/ /de ltar rdzas dang rnam grangs dang / /dngos kun gcig nyid du gnas na/ /rdzas ni sdog byudang ldan gyur te/ /rnam grangs dag gi 2rang dngos bzhin/ /gal te rnam grangs de kun yang / /rdzas bzhin rjes 'gro'i bdag nyid ni/ /thob 'gyur bye de dag rdzas dang ni/ /bdag nyid gcig tu gnas phyir ro/ /de yi phyir na rnam grangs las/ /tha dad med phyir bdag sogs rdzas/ /gnas pa cung zad yod min te/ /rnam grangs rang gi ngo bo bzhin / /skye dang 'jig par gnas pa yi/ /rnam grangs rnams kyang cung zad med/ /rdzas las tha dad med pa'i phyir/ /rdzas de nges pa'i bdag nyid bzhin / /de phyir rjes 'gro med gcig spupa'am/ /thams cad rtag pa nyid 'dod kyis/ /gcig bdag nyid las ldog pa dang / /rjes 'gro 'di dag med 107—32

pa nyid/ /dmigs su rung ba'i rang bzhin can/ /rnam grangs la rjes 'gro bdag nyid/ /rdzas ni so sor snang ba mosarmye/ /de phyir mkha' ①pad bzhin du med/ /sna tshogs don byed rung ba dang / /mchungs ①sogs shes pa'i rgyur gyur dag /de ④lta'i rnam pa'i don gyis phyobarda/ /sgra dang shes pa'i spyod yul dag /skye dang 'jig pa'i chos can gyi/ /rnam grangs kho na 'ba' zhig dag /yang dag yod 'gyur de yi phyir/ /bdag med gsal snang dri ma med/ /'on te rdzas dang rnam grangs kyi/ /ngo bo yang dag 'dre bar kyeganas/ /dngos nyid can de dbyer med pa/ /'dod de mi yi seng ge bzhin/ /dngos nyid can zhes bstan 3pa 'di/ /sna tshogs don gye rgyu mtshan can/ /yin te dngos po'i sgra yang ni/ /rang bzhin rjod par byed phyir ro/ /mi yi seng ge'ang gcig pu ni/ /gnyis bdag can du 'thad min te/ /gang phyir rdul phran du ma yidzu/ /'dus bdag can de de ltar shes//de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las nam mkha'i gos can gyis kun tu brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa ste bcu pa'o// //sa dang me chu la sogs par/ /de shes rtag thupa'i 'jug pa 'di/ /de bdag can nyid bdag yin zhes/ /gzhan dag kyang ni rjod par byed/ /gzung ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i/ /'di ni cung zad yod min te/ /de phyir 'di dag thams cad ni/ /rnam shes 'gyur bar yang dag gnas/ /de dag gi ni lta ba dang / /de gzhung rtag nyid brjod pa'i phyir/ /nyes pa chung ldan rtag brjod phyir/ /de dag nyes pa chung ldan te/ /gzugs sgra la sogs 107—33

shes pa rnams/ /tha dad nyer mtshon gsal ba yin/ /shes pa'i bdag nyid gcig nyid ni/ /gzugs dang sgra dang ro sogs rnams/ /cig car rtog par thal bar 'gyur/ /rtag la'ang gnas skabs gzhan med do/ /gzugs sogs rnams kyi rig pa las/ /tha dad shes pa dmigs pa med/ /de ni skad cig tha dad na/ /tha mi dad du gnas pa ci/ /phyin ci log dang ①ma log pa'i/ /shes pa tha dad yod min na/ /skyes bu shes nyid bdag nyid la du/ /de phyir 'ching grol byeji ltar yin/ /rnal 'byor goms pas rnal 'byor pa/ /ci zhig bzlog cing ci zhig sgrub/ /gang phyir de bdag ④phyin ci log /spang bar nus pa ma yin no/ /de bdag phyonyid du rtag gnas phyir/ /de nyid shes pa'ang bskyed hūṃbya min/ /de phyir khyed kyi rnal 'byor ni/ /goms pa 'di kun 'bras med 'gyur/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las u pa ni sha 3 kas brtags pa'i bdag brtag pa ste bcu gcig pa'o// //bde gshegs par sems 'ga' zhig kyang / /gang zag tha snyad sgo nas ni//de nyid gzhan yin sogs bral ba/ /bdag tu rab tu rjod 3par byed/ /mu stegs lta bar thal 'gyur phyir/ /gang zag phung po las ⑨gzhan min/ /du ma sogs 'gyur phyir de nyid/ /ma yin de phyir brjod med legs/ /de dag la smra gang zag ni/ /don dam par med de nyid dang / /gzhan nyid sogs par brjod med phyir/ /nam mkha'i pad+ma la sogs bzhin/ /dngos po dngos po las gzhan nam/ /gzhan min par yang mi 'da' nyid/ /de phyir brjod du med pa gang / /dngos po med par rtogs ⑫pa la/ /tha dad tha dad med 107—34

rnams rtogs/ /dngos la brten pa yin pa'i phyir/ /de nyid gzhan sogs brjod med pa/ /rang bzhin med rnams la rigs ①kyi/ /dngos po la ni yod min zhes/ /de lta bu yis bkag pa gang / /de ni dngos po gzhan bzhin du/ /de las gzhan du gsal bar brjod/ /de nyid min pa bkag pas kyang / /de nyid du ni rjod par byed/ /de phyir dngos de dngos po ni/ /de nyid gzhan 'ga' mi byed na/ /gang zag phung po las gzhan min bu/ /zhes pas 'di ni gzhan min brjod/ /phung po gang zag min zhes pas/ /de ni gzhan 'di yin par gsal/ /'gal ba'i chos dang 'byel pa ni/ /dngos po tha dad par brjod do/ /phung po gang zag dag la yang / /de bzhin ci phyir tha dad med/ /'di ltar tshor ba la sogs las/ /gang zag brjod du med par brjod/ /de las gzugs dang 'du shes sogs/ /de nyid gzhan nyid du brjod 1bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po dag ④ /mi rtag nyid du brjod byar 'dod/ /de ltar gang zag min phyir yang / /de las gzhan du gsal nyid yin/ /don byed par ni nus pa yang / /yod pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid de/ /skad cig ma nyid la rngunges yin/ /de ldan brjod med dngos nyid yin/ /lung dang 'gal ba dag la ni/ /bdag nyid chen pos brtson par byas/ /med pa pa ni dgag pa'i phyir/ /brtse ldan gsung ni sna tshogs yin/ /tshogs pa la sogs thugs kyis ⑥ni/ /khur khyen la sogs ston mdzad pa/ /khyad par sgo nas bkag pa ni//lta ba de yod rnams la mdzes/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las gnas ma'i bus brtags pa'i ④bdag brtag khrupa ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //107—35

yang na gang phyir skad cig ma/ /'jig pa rab tu grub nyid kyis①/ /rang bzhin la sogs sun phyung bas/ /gnas med nyid la 'bad 'di byed/ /bshad dang 'chad par 'gyur ba yikhye/ /rigs sogs khyad par med pa ni/ /dgag rngupa'i don du de yi phyir/ /skad cig 'jig ④pa gsal bsgrub bya/ /byas dang ma byas nyid sgo nas/ /'ga' zhig phung po gnyis su 'dod/ /skad cig skad cig ma yin pas/ /gzhan gyis skye dngos rnams la 'dod 'di/ /de la byas pa'i dngos po gang / /de kun skad cig mar 'jig can/ /thams cad dag ni 'jig pa la/ /ltos med nyid du gnas phyir ro/ /gang zhig dngos gang yin pa la/ /rgyu gzhan la ltos med nyid de/ /de ltar rang rgyud las skye phyir/ /de ni de las nges zhes bya/ /dper na rang 'bras skye ba la/ /gegs byed med pa'i tshogs pa bzhin/ /skye ba can ni thams cad kyang / /'jig pa la ni ltos pa med/ /gal te 'di ltos med yin na'ang / /yul dang dus gzhan la 'gyur na/ /de dag la ni ltos nyid phyir/ /ltos med thal ba nyid 'gyur na/ /skye ba can kun 'jig pa la/ /thams cad du ni ltos pa med//'jig pa'i rgyu rnams rnam kun du/ /de la cung zad byed med phyir/ /'di ltar 'jig par byed pa'i rgyu/ /dngos la tha dad med pa yi/ /'jig pa'i byed por mi rigs tedu / /dngos po rang rgyu las skye phyir/ /'di la sgrib 3 sogs kyang mi rig /'jig pa lduzhes bya'i ⑨dngos po yi/ /dngos po'i 'jig byed ces bya 6brdzun/ /gzhan nyid la sogs rnam rtog dag /don de la yang 'jug phyir ro/ /dngos po'i ngo bo med bdag nyid/ /'jig pa zhes bya'i meng ⑪gzhan can/ /'jig byed ce na de la yang / /byed pa rig ⑫pa ldan ma yin/ /707—36

med pa yang ni 'bras nyid na/ /myu gu sogs bzhin dngos nyid du/ /thal 'gyur bskyed bya'i ngo bo ni/ /rgyu yi lkunus pas skyed ④phyir ro/ /de ltar dngos med sgrub sgo nas/ /byas yin ma yin dgag rten phyir/ /gang yin de la tha dad sogs/ /slar yang rnam rtog 'jug par 'gyur/ /'on te bya ba bkag pa dzu 'di / /dngos nyid byed pa ma yin nyid/ /de lta na yang rgyu med grub/ /byed po min na rgyu nyams phyir/ /'o na dngos po yod dus su/ /'jig pa 'di yod ma yin nyid/ /sngon min yun ring phyis ④kyang min/ /dngos po'i de ma thag tu 'di/ /de lta na yang dus nges phyir/ /'di ni rgyu ldan regs 2pa yin/ /ltos med pa la res 'ga' dang / /'byel ba sun khyeni phyung ba yin/ /dngos po'i de ma thag tu ni/ /'byung ba'i phyir dang ma byung las/ /'byung phyir 'di ni rgyu ldan rigs/ /dper na skad cig gzhan bzhin 'dod/ /mo gsham gyi ni bu bzhin du/ /rgyu med phyir 'di cung zad med/ /yang na mkha' bzhin rtag gyur spyote/ /gang phyir rnam pa gzhan med do/ /me+ed pa yin na 'jig med phyir//dngos po thams cad rtag par 'gyur/ /'dus byas thams cad 'jig pa yi/ /shes pa'ang rgyu mtshan med pa can/ /rtag pa nyid na'ang 'jig pa med/ /lhan cig gnas 'gyur 'gal med phyir/ /skye ba me+ed la'ang 'jig bshad pa/ /rigs ④pa'i rjes 'brangs nyid ma yin/ /de lta bu la gzhan dag gis/ /ji lta bu zhig 'jig par rtog /skad cig mar gnas chos rnams kyi/ /dngos nyid min nam 'on te na/ /dngos po'i ngo bo ldog gyur pash+yi/ /zhig myong can la de ltar brjod/ /de 'dir 'jig pa'i rang bzhin gang / /chos rnams skad cig mar gnas pa'i/ /dngos med de ltar brjod dam ci/ /gzhan la brgal zhing 707—37

brtag ①pa mtshungs/ /'on te dngos po'i rang ngo bo/ /ldog pa 'jig pa'i ming yin na/ /snga ma la ni rtag byed pa④/ /'gal ba cung zad med pa nyid/ /skad cig mar gnas dngos gang la/ /'jig pa zhes ni rjod byed na/ /de ni rgyu dang rnam par 'dod/ /gzhan dngos med phyir rgyu sped can/ /dngos po'i de ma thag 'byung nyid/ /de 'dra de la yod min te/ /g.yo ba dngos po'i rang ngo bo/ /dngos dang lhan cig skye phyir ro/ /de phyir 'jig pa yod pa'i phyir/ /'dus byas thams cad rtag pa min/ /'jig pa zhes pa'i blo dag kyang / /rgyu mtshan med par thal mi 'gyur/ /zhig pa nyid ni bdag med phyir/ /de ma thag 'byung yod pa min/ /ma byung byung ba ldan pa yang / /nam mkha'i pad+ma la sogs bzhin/ /zhig 'gyur zhes bya de ltar 'dir/ /dngos por ma gyur zhes bya yi/ /don 'di rtogs par byed yin byi/ /bsgrub pa 'ga' yang mi 'dod do/ /mi 'ga' zhig la bong bu zhes/ /de ltar ming tsam byas pa na/ /bong bu'i chos rnams thams cad ni/ /'di las thob she'agyur ma yin no/ /zhig pa zhes bya'i dngos po ni/ /dngos po bcom pa zhes bya ba/ /sgrub pa na yang dngos 'di la/ /cung zad kyang ni skye med phyir/ /'di ni ji ltar ldog par 'gyur/ /'jig pa dngos po zhig bdag nyid/ /ji ltar dngos po'i ngo bo dang / /bral phyir med pa nyid 'dod kyi/ /dngos po ngo bo min phyir min/ /'di la ldog pa'i dngos nyid kyang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas rjod mi byed/ /dngos po yi ni rjes 'jug pa/ /skad cig las phyis ④'gegs par byed/ /de phyir 'di yi rnam gzhag gi/ /ngo bo sgrub pa cung zad med/ /de phyir 'di la rtag rgya pa yi/ /rnam rtog byed pa gnas med do/ /nam mkha' la sogs dngos gang 107—38

dang ①/ /ma byas par ni yang dag 'dod/ /dngos po 'jug pa yod min te/ /de dag yod nus bral phyir ro/ /skad cig skad cig min sogs rtog1 /de tshe de la gnas med do/ /gang gis dngos nyid skad cig ma'am/ /gal te rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur/ /skad cig gnas pa'i rang bzhin gang / /dngos po skad cig ma ru brjod/ /brten pa'i ngo bor gnas pa yi/ /dngos nyid skad cig pa ma yin/ /skyes ma thag tu mi gnas pa'i/ /dngos po'i ngo bo gang yin pa①/ /skad cig tu brjod de gang la/ /yod pa skad cig mar 'dod do/ /don la tha dad med na yang / /de 'di la 'di zhes ④gnod med/ /'dod pas sbyar ba'i brda tsam kyi/ /dngos po rjod ⑤par byed pa yin/ /byung ma thag tu mi gnas pa'i / /dngos la de ltar brjod 'dod pa/ /de la sgra ni rkyen bcas pa'am /rkyen med rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur/ /gal te nam mkha' dus la sogs/ /de dag yod 'gyur de ltar na/ /de dag kyang ni pyabyas bzhin du/ /skad cig 'jig 'di las mi 'da'/ /'di ltar gang zag ④yod ces pas/ /de kun skad cig 'jig can de/ /dper na 'dus byas dngos po dag /de ltar de ma thag grub bzhin/ /nam mkha' dus dang dbang phyug sogs/ /'di yang khyod kyi yod par 'dod/ /de dag skad cig ma nyid dang / /bral na med par thal bar 'gyur/ /gang phyir brtan pa'i dngos po rnams/ /rim kyis sam ni cig car du'ang / /don gyi bya ba byed min pa/ /de phyir de dag med par 'dod/ /rgyu ni nye ba med pa'i phyir/ /'bras bu rnams ni sdod par byedablu / /nus pa'i rgyu ni yod gyur na/ /de dag sdod par ⑨gang gis byas/ /'on te'ang rtag la ⑫rim can gye/ /lhan cig byed rnams yod gyur rmyen/ /'di ni gang dag la ni 107—39

ltos / /'bras bu'i tshogs rim rten par byed/ /'di legs 'on kyang de la ni / /lhan cig byed de rnams cho yod pa/ /rung ba'i ngo bo'i rgyu nyid phyir/ /don gcig byed pas yin nam ci/ /rung ba'i ngo bo'i rgyu nyid na/ /dngos de dag gi bye byas 'gyur na/ /de yang bya bar mi nus phyir/ /de rang bzhin du rtag gnas pa/ /'di yi rang bzhin byas na yang / /'di yi rtag pa nyams par 'gyur/ /de las khyad par tha dad ni1/ /'di ni byed por ji ltar 'gyur//de yod na ni 'bras bu dag /skyed pa'i phyir dang de med na/ /mi skyed phyir te de ltar na/ /de nyid rgyu nyid rnam par gnas/ /'on te de dang 'brel pa'i phyir / /de la'ang rgyu nyid yod pa na/ /de dag las ④'byel gang yin 'dod/ /tha dad phyir na de bdag min/ /de ni de las 'byung ba'ang min/ /cig car bar du thal phyir ro/ /de las kyang ni 'bras bu rnams/ /cig car nyid du skyed par 'gyur/ /de la'ang gzhan la ltos pa naphye/ /thug pa med par thal bar 'gyur/ /de las 'bras bu dus gcig na'ang / /'byel pa med phyir brtag mi bya/ /gal te 'byel pa 'du ba yin/ /de la'ang 'dir ni dpyad bya ste / /de ni de la 'gyur ba'am/ /de lta ma yin zhes bya ba/ /'du ba can du 'dod dam ci/ /gal te rtog pa dang po 'dzin/ /de las byung ba de nyid thob//de yang de ma thag gsal gyezin/ /gal te na ni de la 'di/ /phan mi byed par 'dod gyur na/ /dngos gzhan kun kyang de bzhin du/ /'du ba can 'gyur khyad par med/ /tha dad tha dad med rnam rtog /so so dag tu bkag pa'i phyir//ngo bo gnyis 3 can khyad par ni/ /dngos po de la bsal ba yin/ /gang zag la sogs rtags 3rnams su/ /phung po gnyis ni bstan pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo 107—40

gnyis can khyad par med/ /gnyis med bdag nyid can yang med/ /'on te lhan cig byed pa yi/ /rkyen las khya'ajug pa mi ltos pa du/ /de lta na yang de bral 'di/ /byed pa ma yin mtha' rgyu bzhin/ /de yi bdag gi rang bzhin 'di//de dag nyid ni nye ba na/ /byed po nyid yin de phyir de/ /yod na'ang kun tshe 'bras bu min/ /de lta yin na 'on kyang ni/ /tshogs pa na de 1rang bzhin 'dod / /gang de ma tshogs na 'dod na/ /der 'byel rang bzhin yod na ni//de dag kyang ni 'di gnas phyir/ /bral ba'i ngo bo'i gzhan yin na/ /gcig pa nyid ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de phyir de ltar ltos pas kyang / /'bras bu rnams ni rim skye'am ④min/ /cig car mi 'dod nyid dang ni/ /de 'bras rim gyis mthong phyir ro/ /gal te 'bras bu ma lus rnams/ /cig car byas nas nus pa yi/ /bdag nyid don de ldog 'gyur na/ /'di ni skad cig 'jig can grub/ /de dngos can ni rjes 'jug na/ /slar yang 'bras bu skye bar 'gyur/ /cung zad mi byed ngo bo ni/ /ji ltar yang ni nyid du 'dod/ /nus pa kun gyis stong nyid phyir/ /rgyu skar lam gye pad+ma bzhin/ /skad cig yin par thams cad med/ /gang phyir nus pa 5 dngos mtshan nyid/ /nus pa'i mtshan nyid dngos nyid 'di/ /ci ⑥ste khas len mi byed na/ /gal te de ltar gzhan dag gis/ /dngos po'i mtshan nyid gzhan ston gyis④/ /gal te dngos po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /yod nyid dang 'brel 'dod de min/ /'du sogs ma grub phyir dang ni/ /ji ltar gzhan ni ldugazhan mtshan nyid/ /don byed don du gnyer byed pa/ /g.yeng ba med pa'i blo can gyi/ /don la dpyod sogs bya ba kun⑨/ /rigs kyi sbyon pa nyid kyis min/ /stsos par gyur pas 107—41

kyang ma yin/ /de la gang dag 'ga' zhig la①/ /la lar dus 'gar ji ltar yang / /nye bar mkho snegyur de nyid la/ /yod nyid rnam ①gzhag rig dupa yin//de yi dngos can don nyid la/ /skad cig ma nyid rab sgrub byed/ /thams cad sdud phyir khyad par ni/ /de nyid la ni brjod par bya/ /mo gsham gyi ni bu lta bu'i④/ /nus pa ma lus stong pa gang ④/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs kyi yang / /nam yang rgyu nyid ma yin pa/ /de la mkhas pas yod nyid kyi④/ /rnam gzhag 'di ni yod mi bya/ /rgyu med phyir ro 'bras bu dang / /ngo bo 'bras sogs ma mthong phyir/ /de la skad cig ma nyid du/ /bsgrubs ④pas don ni cung zad med/ /de la brgal zhing brtag ④/pa yang / /byed pa'ang 'bras bu med pa yin⑩/ /'on te nam mkha'i pad+ma sogs/ /rang gis shes pa'i rgyur gyur phyir/ /don gyi bya ba byed nus kyang / /de dag dngos por yod ma yin/ /nam mkha'i chu skyes pad sogs la/ /der rtogs bag chags tsam las ni/ /'byung ba dmigs pa med nyid ni/ /shes pa 'di ni rab tu ⑪byed/ /med pa rgyu nyid yin na ni/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu khyad par med nyid phyir/ /dngos med ltos pa ci yang med/ /skad cig pa yi dngos rnams kyang / /ji ltar don byed pa nyid yod/ /thog ma'i lhan cig byed rnams ni/ /phan tshun khyad par byed min te/ /skyes na bdag kun grub phyir dang / /ma skyes rang bzhin med phyir ro/ /khyad par med las khyad par ni / /'byung na ⑫ 'bras bu cis mi 'byung / /gzhan la ⑫ khyad par can de min/ /brgal zhing brtag ⑫pa mtshungs phyir ro/ /khyed la lhan cig byed pa'i tshogs/ /thug pa med par yang 'gyur ro/ /de ltar gang phyir de dag ni/ /rim dang 107—42

cig car don bya med/ /mi 'gyur de phyir de dag ni/ /skad cig ma nyid rten don med/ /de ltar lhan cig byed byas pasasti/ /gang tshe la lar khyad med na/ /de tshe de phyir dus kun du/ /rgyun yang byekhyad par med pa nyid/ /de tshe de phyir rgyun la yang / /gal te 'jig pa rgyu med ni/ /'di ni thog ma nyid du 'gyur/ /gal te thog ma 'di med na/ /mtha' yang de ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /gal te dngos po 'jig pa la/ /rang gi rgyu las rgyu gzhan ni/ /mi 'dod na ni de dag la / /'ga' zhig tu ni ji ltar lags/ /smras pa thog ma'i gnas skabs rnams / /phan tshun phan pa byed nyid na/ /de dag don cig byed nyid kyis/ /lhan cig byed rnams su 'gyur te/ /phan tshun phan byed min na yang / /'di dag khyad par yod gang phyir/ /rang gi nyer len stobs las byung / /skye tsubyed tshogs pa'i tha dad yin/ /de ④las brtsams nas gang skyes pa'i/ /khyad par de dag des byas pa'ophye/ /de la dgongs pa de dag ni/ /dngos de'i rang bzhin can yin phyir/ /dngos rnams skad cig so sor ni/ /nus pa nges pa hūṃbasam mi khyab/ /'byung ba brtag par bya min te/ /me tsul sreg par byed nyid bzhin / /rgyun chad ngo bo gang yin pa'i/ /'jig pa rgyu dang ldan pa min/ /de 3ni mthar yang 'byung yod min/ /de ltar skye ba bkag pa yin/ /gyo mo la sogs mi 'dra ba'i/ /skye ba rgyu dang bcas pa stekye/ /de yang thog mar skyes min nyid/ /de tshe rgyu ni med phyir ro/ /dngos po skad cig ma rnams ni/ /rnam gnyis kha cig 'grib pa'i rgyu/ /grang ba sogs kyis ⑩ me sogs bzhin/ /gzhan dag de lta min pa yi/ /thog mar smras pa rgyu 'bras bu/ /yin na'ang ⑪de nyid ma mthong ba'i/ /'jig rten pa yis 'gal ba ni/ /rnam pa du mar 707—43

mngon par zhen/ /dngos po rnams la gnod bya dang / /gnod byed dngos po ⑨don dam par/ /yod min de nyid phyir na yang / /'gal ba rtogs ①pa zhes bshad do/ /'o na dbang po bya ba ni/ /yod na mi g.yo gnod med can/ /de nyid 'di yin zhes bya ba'i/ /ngo shes pa ni nye bar skye/ /de phyir skad cig gis 'jig pararngu/ /bsgrub phyir bkod pa'i gtan tshigs ni/ /kun la mngon sum gyis gnod 'di/ /bzlog dka' bar ni thal bar 'gyur/ /ngo shes par ni dugyur na ni/ /mngon sum yin par mi 'thad de/ /gang phyir de ni rnam rtog bcas—/ /dngos po'i ngo bo bstan bya min/ /ngo shes pa ni 'khrul pa ste/ /mngon sum mtshan nyid de las gzhan/ /tha dad min pa'i zhen pa yis/ /tha dad dngos la'ang 'jug phyir ro/ /mngon sum de las gzhan pa yin/ /gal te 'di ni sngar rtogs pa'i/ /rnam pa'i spyod yul can 'gyur na/ /'di ni sngar nyid skye 'gyur te/ /de don can phyir sngon blo bzhin/ /de ltar ma yin des na 'di/ /don de 'dzin byed 'dod min te/ /de shes dus su mi skye ⑤phyir/ /yul gzhan gyi ni du blo bzhin no/ /tha dad min pa'i zhen pa yis/ /tha dad dngos la'ang 'jug phyir ro/ /sgong gi 'khrul pa'i shes pa bzhin/ /'di ni 'khrul par ⑦ gnas pa yin/ /bya ba bsgrub pa'i don la yang / /'jug pa'i phyir dran sogs bzhin te/ /byed pa'i don ni rnam nyams phyir/ /'di ni tshad mar rigs du ma yin/ /da ltar dus su yod pa nyid/ /snga ma'i blo yis shes pa nyid / /de phyir dran pa la med gang / /khyad par 'di la yod min te/ /gang phyir sngar ni shes tsam la/ /de yin zhes ⑨byas dran pa skye/ /de nyid 'di zhes bya ba yi⑫/ /ngo shes par ni khyad par can/ /the tshom phyin ci log gang 107—44

dang / /de dag spangs nas ngo shes pa/ /tshad ma nyid ni thob par byed/ /shes par gyur la med phyir ro/ /cig shos kyis ni rtogs don yod①/ /mngon sum gyis ①ni bcad pa la/ /cig shos skye ba srid pa min/ /tshad ma gtso bo brtan pa yis①/ /nges par bzung ④ba'i don nyid la/ /cig shos stobs chung dag gis phyis⑤/ /bzlog par su zhig zhen par byed/ /'o na da lta yod de nyid/ /gang tshe khyod kyis tha dad 'dod/ /de tshe sngar yod dngos po las du / /tha dad khyod nyid kyis ④bstan to/ /yod pa gzhan nyid ma yin na'ang / /ji ltar sngar ④blos shes pa min⑨/ /de shes min na dngos po nyid/ /ma dmigs par ⑫ni thal bar 'gyur/ /rjes dpag ⑪la sogs kyi spyod yul/ /mngon sum gyis ni gnod pa na/ /rjes dpag la sogs tshad ma med⑫/ /gnod phyir rab rib can sogs bzhin/ /don la mi slu 8 ba nyid du/ /mtshungs na 'di cis ④gtso bo yin/ /de yod min na rjes dpag sogs/ /tshad mar 'gyur ba ④ma yin nyid—/ /'o na gtan tshigs thams cad kyi/ /thams cad nye bsus khyab pa la//rjes su dpag pa 'dis gnod ⑫cing / /dam bca'i don la gnod pa yang /brjod 'dod nyi zla sogs pa yi/ /yul can shes pa gang yin gzhan/ /de dus dang 'brel nyi ⑩sogs kyi/ /yul can du ni 'jug byed de/ /sa las byung yul can min pa/ /de shes nyid du brjod pa'i phyir/ /dper na dang po'i shes pa ni/ /rang dus nyi ⑫sogs yul can bzhin/ /gzugs nyid sogs pa rten kun dang / /de dag gi ⑪ni rten gang pya dang / /de rnams gang la yang dag rten⑫/ /'ga' zhig de yi yul gang yin/ /'ga' zhig de ltar skye 'gyur ba—/ /de dag skyes ma thag tu ni/ /'jig la rten pa nyid min te/ /gzhal 107—45

bya nyid dang brjod bya nyid/ /gtan tshigs phyir ni mkha' pad bzhin/ /rnam par rtsod ①pa'i yul gyur pa'i/ /shes pa rim gyis 'byung gang dag /de rnams thams cad yul gcig can/ /yin no zhes ni brjod bya ste/ /gnod med rten gcig can nyid na / /brjod pa mthun 1par sbyor ba'i phyir/ /dper na da lta'i skad cig ma④/ /gcig la du ma'i blo rnams bzhin/ /re zhig gtan tshigs dang po la/ / dper na bsgrub ⑤byas stong pa ste/ /yul nyid rgyud hūṃnyid yin pa'i phyir/ /shes pa'i rang gi dus can min/ /gang tshe nyi ma sogs pa'i sgra⑦/ /'dod pa tsam gyis 'byung dag rnams/ /mar me sogs la sbyar bya ba/ /de shel dag gis 'khrul pa nyid/ /rigs sogs rang bzhin med pa'i phyir1 / /skad cig gis 'dod can 'dod min/ /de med par ni bsgrub rngupa'i phyir/ /sgrub byed bstan ⑪pa don med yin/ /sgra mtshungs pa yis brjod bya nyid/ /mar me la sogs shes pa la'ang / /'jug pa de phyir de yis ⑫ni / /gtan tshigs 'di ni 'khrul par 'gyur/ /de dag la ni gzhi mthun nyid / /gnod 'gyur du ni rtog ce 8na/ /brjod par 'dod pa'ang gnod pa 'di / /gsal bar ci yi phyir ma mthong / /rtsod pa'i gnas su gyur pa yi/ /blo rnams don zhig yul can min/ /rim gyis 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir/ /glog dang mar me sogs blo bzhin/ /don gcig las byung ⑫shes rnams la/ /rim gyis kyi'abyung ba 'gal ba yin/ /gzhan gyis tha dad bya min pa/ /de la ltos pa 'gal phyir ro/ /gtan tshigs de rnams thams cad la/ /ldog la the tshom za nyid de/ /mi mthun phyogs la zhugs ⑫pa la/ /gnod byed bstan pa med phyir ro/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed ⑩pa las brtan ⑩pa'i dngos po 107—46

brtag pa ste bcu gsum pa'o// //dngos po thams cad skad cig ma'i/ /mi rtag nyid dang 'byel de'i phyir/ /las dang de yi 'byel pa dang / /rgyu dang 4'bras sogs ji ltar 'grub5/ /dge rnams dag la skad cig gang / /byed po nyid du brtag byed pa/ /'di ni 'bras bu byung dus su/ /rjes su 'jug pa nyid ma yin/ /'bras bu 'byung tshe skad cig gang / /longs spyod por ni brjod bya ba/ /de ni las byas nyid min te / /de ni sngar mi srid phyir ro/ /las dang de yi 'bras bu dag /byed po gcig gis ma bzung phyir/ /byas pa chud zos ma phrad gang / /thal bar 'gyur ba shin tu 'gal/ /bdag med sgra yi phyogs la yang / /bdag med phyir ni 'bras med pa'am/ /bdag las gzhan gyir bya bar ni/ /sngar nyid du ni rtogs byed pa/ /de phyir rtog ldan 'brel 'dod pa/ /dge ba dang ni mi dge ba'i/ /bya ba rtsom la mi 'jug nyid/ /'bras bu ring du gnas pa yin/ /dngos po 'bras bu byed nus pa/ /ma 'ongs ma yin 'das pa'ang min4/ /da ltar ba yang de snyed kyi/ /dus su gnas pa ma yin no/ /dngos po bdag nyid ma thob pa/ /gzhan gyi yan lag phyir nus min/ /'gags pa ma yin de yi ni//'bras bu med nus gnas pa'ang min/ /skad cig snga ma gzhan zhig pa'ang5/ /rjes 'gro med par rten 4byed na/ /phyis byung 7skye bar 'thad min te/ /rgyu mtshan med pa nyid phyir ro/ /'jig dang skye ba dus mtshungs na'ang / /rgyu 'bras dag ni yod pa min/ /phan tshun ltos pa med phyir te/ /de yi bya ba ma bzung phyir/ /bum pa'i gzugs ni zhig pa na/ /dri la sogs pa'ang skyes pa ni//107—47

ji ltar de 'bras mi 'dod ltar/ /gzugs gzhan rnams kyang de bzhin te/ /de phyir 'bras bu 'byung ba las①/ /sngon du gang gi bya ba mthong / /de nyid de yi rgyu yin gyi/ /de ma thag pa tsam ni min/ /gal te 'di ni mdor sdebasdus na//rgyu zhig pa las 'bras 'byung na/ /zhig pa brjod du med pa'i phyir/ /'di ni rgyu med nyid du 'gyur/ /ma zhig pa las de 'byung na/ /skad cig du mar gnas pa'i phyir/ /de tshe dngos rnams skad cig nyid/ /ji ltar nyams par 'gyur ba min/ /skad cig gnas pa'i ngang tshul can/ /bum sogs mig gis ④mthong min te/ /gang phyir zhig pa rtogs pa ④yin/ /yun ring 'das pa'i dngos po bzhin/ /dngos rnams rang bzhin mi dmigs phyir/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos por yang / /mngon sum dang ni mi dmigs pas/ /mgu bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /'di mthong ba las 'di mthong la/ /'di yang mthong na ma mthong bar/ /rim ldan 'gyur ba'i mtshams sbyor ba/ /byed por rnam par gnas pa gang / /skad cig gis 'jig dngos rnams la/ /ngo shes pa yang 'byel par dka'/ /skyes bu gzhan gyis mthong ba'i don/ /gzhan gyis phyengo shes 'gyur ba min/ /sgra ⑥la sogs pa tha dad la/ /shes pa po zhig yod pa'i phyir/ /'dra ba las ni ngo shes 'gyur/ /gnyis tha dad na rgyu med can / /gal te mtshams sbyor byed pa'i rgyu/ /don zhig yod pa ma yin na/ /gzugs mthong ba na ro sogs la/ /mngon 'dod sogs de ji ltar 'gyur/ /srid pa'i btson rar chags sogs kyis/ /'ching bas bcings pa'i skad cig gzhan—/ /ma bcings gzhan ni grol 'gyur ba/ /zhes bya 'di yang rtogs ma yin / /bcings pa grol ba nam yang ni/ /mi srid gcig tu 'jug phyir ro/ /107—48

de phyir thar pa don gnyer rnams/ /ngal ba don ni med par 'gyur/ /'ching ba sogs kyis bcings gyur pa/ /grol ba thob par byed pa mthong ma bcings grol ba thob byed pa/ /zhes bya 'di 'dra mthong bas gnod/ /bcings dang grol ba 'di dag ni/ /gzhi gcig de bzhin gnas pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten pa yi de dag bzhin/ /de bzhin thams cad mdzes par gnas/ /rnam pa de dag nyid kyis ni/ /dngos rnams skad cig gis 'jig la/ /gzhi gcig pa ni med pa'i phyir/ /dran pa la sogs mi srid do/ /'di la mngon par brjod par bya1/ /bdag med rnams la rgyu 'bras nyid/ /gnas pa yin na 'di dag kun/ /gnod pa med par grub pa nyid/ /ji ltar myu gu la sogs la / /rjes 'gro can gye bdag med la/ /sa bon sogs kyi nus nges pa /de bzhin nang gi bdag nyid gnas —/ /dngos su 'am ni brgyud pa yis/ /'ga' la ri kha cig nus bcas yin/ /de phyir las 'bras sogs rnams kyi/ /'brel pa nyid ni 'thad ma yin/ /byed po nyid sogs rnam gzhag ste/ /rgyu gcig nyid du brjod 'dod pas/ /rtog pas sgo btags nyid 'dod kyi/ /yang dag gnas pa'i yang dag min/ /rjes 'gro med na rgyu 'bras nyid/ /khyad par can de mi 'thad de/ /rgyud gzhan las ni byung 4rnams dang / /gang zhig rgyu 'bras mi 'thad bzhin/ /'o na sa bon myu gu sogs/ /rgyu 'bras nges pa nyid mthong ste/ /de la rjes 'gro'i bdag nyid can/ /cha shas phra mo yod ma yin / /sa bon myu gu sogs pa la/ /zhing sogs khyad par med yin na/ /tha dad mi rigs gcig bdag phyir/ /tha dad rjes 'gro med pa grub/ /de phyir las 'bras sogs rnams kyirkye/ /yod dang med pa sgrub bye don du/ /rgyu 107—49

'bras grub dang ma grub phyir/ /gzhan gyis rab tu 'bad par bya/ /de la brjod bya skad cig ma/ /gnyis pa la ni 'bras skye zhing / /dang por rgyu ni skyes gyur pa/ /de ni de tshe zhig pa'ang min/ /de ni skad cig pa nyid phyir/ /'bras bu'i skad cig dus gnas phyir/ /gnas na'ang don med gang gi phyir/ /de la 'bras bu de 'grub rmyeyin/ /slar skyes slar yang de yis ni/ /bskyed bye par nus min skye ba — ni/ /ma byung ba las byung dngos phyir/ /gzhan du na ni gnas pa min/ /de phyir ma zhig pa yi rgyu/ /skad cig dang por byung ba las/ /de yis 4skad cig ma nyid yephyir/ /cig car thal ba yod ma yin/ /skad cig gsum la sogs pa la/ /dper na rnam par smin pa'i rgyu/ /zhig las 'bras bu brjod pa bzhin6/ /gal te dang por de 'byung na/ /cig car du yang thal 'gyur te/ /lhan cig 'byung rgyu bzhin de yang / /rigs pas 'thad min gang gi phyir/ /med pas sngar ni nus med phyir/ /nus pa'i tshe na 'bras 'byung phyir//rgyu 'bras dag ni cig car nyid/ /'gal bar gsal ba nyid yin te/ /skam pas bzung ba bzhin du ni/ /rgyu 'dis rang gi 'bras bu 'dis/ /bzung nas skyed par byed pa min/ /gang phyir cig car ba ru 'gyur/ /'dod ldan bud med la bzhin du/ /'bras bu rang bzhin la brtan par/ /'khyud nas skye ba ma yin na/ /gang gis 7de dag ci dgar 'gyur/ /cig car ba nyid 'gal ba yin / /gang phyir rgyu de rang nyid kyisasnye/ /'bras bu sos bsdoms byebazhin bzung ba / /skyes nyuX pa yin na cig car bar/ /'gyur na de ni de ltar min/5//'bras bu'ang rang bzhin de la ni/ /'dod ldan sdug bsngal 'khyud bzhin pas/ /skye ba yin na cig car bar tshi/ /'gyur na de yang de ltar min/ /rang gi rgyu 107—50

las 'byung ba ni/ /skad cig dang bor gang byung ba/ /skad cig gnyis par ①nye ba yi/ /de ma thag tu gang byung min du/ /bya ba med pa'i dngos la yang / /de ni de yi skyed byed yin/ /'dod pa tsam las byung ba yi/ /brda ni rjes su sgrub byed yin/ /skye ba las ni dus gzhan pa'i/ /bya bas 'dir ni ci zhig dgos—/ /gang phyir yod las 'bras byung bas3/ /yod pa nyid ni de'i bya'o/ /de ma thag par gang nges pa/ /de nyid ltos pa yin zhes brjod/ /rtag tu 'bras bu 'byung ba dang / /ldan pa'i rgyu yi bya ba'o/ /de yod pa na 'byung ba tsam / /bya ba zhes kyang kun tu brtags④/ /de dang ldan pas rgyu nyid de/ /de phyir de ldan de nyid mchog /gang phyir sa bon myu gu sogs/ /yod na yod par mthong nyid kyi⑤// /bya ba dngos po yod pa las/ /cung zad kyang ni mthong ma yin/ /nus pa ma mthong bzhin du yang / /rgyu nyid du ni rtog khyebyed na/ /'di dang bye brag ci yod na/ /gzhan yang ci phyir rgyur mi 'dod/ /ji ltar gzhan ni med na yang / /bya ba 'bras bu rgyur 'dod bzhin/ /gzhan yang ci phyir rgyu ma yin/ /yang na dngos bcas mthong bar ni/ /'dod na'ang 'di ni kho bo cag /mthong bar 'dod yin rgyu med na/ /de la dngos po yod pa yang /ci yi phyir na khas len byed/ /ji ltar skye ba can blo nyid/ /tshad ma nyid du nges smra ba/ /de bzhin dngos po thams cad la/ /de rgyu nyid du cis mi ⑦ 'dod//ji ltar blo ni skad cig la/ /de bzhin skye ba can gzhan yang / /bsgrubs pa de phyir 'gro ba 'di/ /de bzhin kho na bya bral ba'o/ /rgyun kyis 'jug pa'i dri la sogs—/ /phan tshun rgyur 'dod kho na ste/ /de rgyu nyid du thal 'gyur te/ /'di la gnod pa can min no/ /gang yang rung ba'i rgyu rnams kyi/ /gzhan kyi 707—51
