de ma thag 'byung ba'ang / /de bzhin nges pa la 'dod pas/ /brtan par 'dod la skyon 'di yang / /gang zhig gang la bya ba dang / /bcas te de yi rgyur 'dod na'ang / /gang la yang dag nges gang yin/ /de rgyu yin par 'dod pa ni①/ /mngon sum dang ni mi dmigs pas/ /yod na yod par grub 'di dag /gal te rnam bcas rnam shes kyis①/ /dngos rnams rig par khyod 'dod dam/ /'on te rnam med pas dngos rnams/ /rnam par rig par khyed 'dod pa/ /skad cig gis 'jig phyogs la'ang de/ /mtshungs par nye bar mtshon par bya/ /snga ma'i rang gi rgyu rnams dang / /gzugs sogs rig pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam par shes pa thams cad nyid/ /dus mnyam nyid du skye ba yin/ /gal te rnam shes rnam pa dang / /bcas na sems ni sna tshogs 'gyur—/ /rnam pas mtshan ma nyid min na'ang / /nye ba na gnas rgyu med pa'o/ /zhe na de'i lan 'dir cung zad/ /khyed kyis kyang ni smra bar gyis1/ /'di la khyed cag lan gang yin/ /de ni kho bo cag gir ④ 'gyur/ /gal te rgyu ni 'bras bu dag /skyed par mi 'dod de lta na/ /byas 'jig 'gyur na 'di min 'ate / /rgyun gyis rgyu nyid 'gyur ba yin/ /gal te rgyu ni med par yang la lar 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur na/ /ma byas pa thob par 'gyur na/ /de min nus pa des phyir ro/ /skad cig gis 'jig rnam rtog gis/ /byas pa 'jig tshogs phas rgol ba/ /des ni mi 'dod pa nyid du/ /gyur pa cung zad yod ma yin—/ /mi 'jigs yod par ④lta ba rnams/ /rgyun la gcig par mngon sems pas/ /skad cig gis phye'i rnam rtog gis/ /ji ltar yang ni 'jug mi 'gyur—/ /skad cig re re rnam 'jig pa'i/ /de kho na nyid rnam rtog ⑦shing / /107—52

rgyu yi nges par ①rig nas ni/ /dge ba'i las ni rtsom par 'gyur/ /'bras bu 'bras bu can nyid dag /nges pa'i khyad par can nyid kyi/ /sems gang yin pa'i dran pa sogs/ /kun la'ang gnod pa med pa yin/ /de la rgyu 'bras 'gyur ba ②yi/ /ma rig 1la sogs pas bcings 'dod/ /de dang bral zhing dri med pa'i/ /blo nyid thar ④ba yin par 'dod/ /thams cad skad cig pa nyid kyi / /bcings dang grol ba rab grags pa/ /gzhi gcig pa nyid yin par ni//'jig rten pa la'ang rjogrub pa min/ /bdag la bye brag thams cad du/ /med phyir byed po zab pa ④po/ /bcings sogs 'di 'dra la gnod kyi/ /gzhan du mi rtag pa nyid do/ /de kho na nyid bsnyus pa'i rab tu byed pa las las dang 'bras bu'i 'brel pa brtag pa ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //rdzas la sogs pa'i don drug ④ni/ /dam pa'i don du yod pa'i phyir/ /rig ④sogs dngos med nyid du ni/ /sngar bstan rigs pa ma yin zhes/ /rkang mig pa dang gzegs zan pa/ /lung tsam pa ni smra byed pa'i/ /rdzas la sogs pa dgag pa 'di/ /mdor bsdus pa ni brjod par bya/ /sa la sogs pas bye ba yi/ /rdzas dgu tha dad par 'dod pa'i/ /sa la sogs pa grangs bzhi ni/ /rtag dang mi ⑨rtag gis rnam gnyis/ /re zhig ⑪ sa sogs bdag nyid kyis/ /gang 'dod pa yi rdul phran rnams/ /de rnams rtag pa'o de la sogs—/ /rtsol ba gang yin de 'jig 'dod/ /de la rdul phran rnams rtag pa//yin par rig ⑪pa ma yin te/ /dngos po ma lus pa yi yul/ /skad cig gis 'jig bsgrub ⑫phyir ro/ /rtag tu gong bu ma lus pa/ /cig car skye ba kho nar 107—53

'gyur / /de rnams phrad pa la sogs pa/ /ltos min bye brag med phyir ro/ /rdul phran skyed pa por 'dod pa/ /yod pa chos su rtogs ①min te/ /don yod la dmigs tshad ma yizhu/ /yul 'gyur ①ma yin zhe na ni/ /gang gis thags mkhan sogs mthong bas/ /rdul phran rgyu ni mi 'grub min/ /gang phyir snam bu sogs thams cad/ /rdul phran bdag nyid kho na'o/ /yod 'dzin tshad ma med tsam kyis/ /med pa grub pa 5ma yin te/ /gang phyir tshad ma log pa ni/ /don med yin pa'i khyanges pa med/ /de rnams rtsom pa'i cha shas can/ /yon tan cha shas thams cad ldan/ /mthong ba min pa nyid kyis ⑥na/ /des na tshad ma can grub min/ /shel gong nye bar bsgyur ba yi/ /bsgyur ba snang ba ma yin nam/ /chu skyar sogs pa'ang de gzugs su/ /'dzin pa nyid du'ang mthong min nam/ /ral ga'i nang gi skyes bu la/ /de yi gzugs sogs mi shes kyang / /skyes bur shes pa mthong ba dang / /gos dmar blo yang yod ma yin / /gzugs sogs ut+pal la sogs las/ /gcig tu tha dad pa yin te/ /des na de ni nag pa'i las/ /rta bzhin rnam par gcod phyir ro/ /sa la sogs dang gzugs dri sogs/ /shin tu tha dad 'gyur ba ste/ /gcig dang snga ma'i tshig dbye bas/ /zla ba skar ma'i tha dad bzhin/ /byed pa ④nus sogs tha dad par/ /snal ma snam bu tha dad bzhin/ /'gal ba'i chos dag sbyor bas na//ka ba bum pa'i dngos bzhin no/ /gong bu'i don yod ma yin na/ /shing sogs mthong ba nyid mi 'gyur/ /de yi ngo bo las gzhan pa/ /gzhan gyi bdag nyid mthong min te/ /gzhan gyi rnam pa rig dupa'i blo/ /mi rigs shin tu thal 'gyur phyir/ /de bzhin dkar po la sogs par/ /rig pa yis ⑨kyang 107—54

srid par 'gyur/ /de phyir dung la ser sogs kyi/ /blo bzhin blo 'di 'khrul pa yin/ /ral ga ⑨ nang chud skyes pa 3yi/ /shes pa de rjes dpag pa ste/ /de yi gtan tshigs su gyur la/ /ral ga lkunyid ni mthong phyir jo/ /ska ④dang gur kum sogs rnam ⑤pas/ / gos kyi gzugs ni gzhan thob cing / /bugos rnams skad cig pa nyid pas/ /snga ma'i gzugs ni zhig pa yin/ /slar ④yang chu sogs ltos bcas las/ /ga/zugs de nyid las dkar po yi/ /gzugs gzhan du yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lcags sogs sngon po sogs bzhin du/ /gnas skabs de nyid kyi gzugs la/ /rang dngos rjes su 'jug phyir ro/ /drug pa'i tshig la sogs dbye ba/ /'dod pa tsam gyis 'byung ba ste/ /de phyir dngos rnams de nyid kyi/ /ngo bor rnam gnas rig ma yin/ /'di ltar drug bo las gzhan pa'i/ /yod nyid tha dad nyid mi 'dod/ /de rnams sde tshan gcig nyid do rngu/ /gzhan yang khas blangs pa min no/ /yod pa shes pa'i tshad ma yin shi/yul du de nyid 'dod pas na/ /drug po'i yod nyid yin zhe na/ /khyed la drug las gzhan thal 'gyur/ /de drug chos can du brjod de/ /chos ni de dag las gzhan par/ /'dod pa nyid yin zhe na yang / /de dang de yi 'byel 'dod gang / /rdzas ⑪sogs nges phyir phrad pa yang / /mi rigs gzhan yang 'du ba yang / /'byel pa gzhan ni khyod 'dod min/ /'byel pa mi 'thad de rnams kyi⑪/ /chos su ji ltar 'gyur ba yin/ /de las byung tsam gyis she ⑫na/ /gzhan yang de dang 'dra gyur la/ /de ⑫yang yod pa nyid yin na/ /tha dad pa can gyis dbye ba/ /thob 'gyur de la'ang gzhan yin pas/ /mtha' med par ni thal bar 'gyur/ /chos gzhan la ni 'jug pa yis/ /der ni chos can 107—55

nyid thob na/ /chode nyid kyi phyir rdzas sogs nyid/ /chos can nyid du 'dod mi 'gyur / /gal te snga rol snal ma las/ /snam bu tha dad sgrub byed na/ /sgrub par byed pa don med nyid/ /de bzhin bzlog par dka' ba yin/ /snal ma de rnams gnas skabs kyi/ /bye brag gzhan ni thob pa na/ /khyad par can don byed nus pa/ /snga ma las gzhan mtshan nyid kyi/ /bya ba gcig nyid la mkho la/ /so sor shes pa po bstan na/ /mangs dang nus med 'bras med pa'i//skyon rnams bsal bar 'dod pa yi/ /tha snyad 'dogs pa po rnams kyis/ /gang dag ma lus pa rnams la/ /tha snyad nyung ba'i bsam pa yi— / /tshig gcig gis ni brjod pa yin/ /byed po nus pa tha dad la/ /yongs su gyur sogs chos ldan phyir/ /de rnams dus gcig nyid du ni/ /snam bu nyid du 'grub pa min / /rdul phran rnams ni phan tshun du/ /bstangs pas skye ba nyid yin na/ /de rnams dbang po'i spyod yul nyid/ /min pas dbang po las 'das min/ /rdul phran sngo sogs rnam pa'i dngos/ /ngo bo nyid yin brtags pa min/ /sngon po sogs su snang ba yang / /mig sogs shes pas rig pa yin/ /gal te'ang de rnams shar nyid dang / /gzhan nyid du 'byed mtshan nyid min/ /de lta'ang sbyar ba'i btung 4ba bzhin/ /gnas la mngon sum kyis gnod min/ /dngos po 'di rnams thams cad nyid/ /kun las log pa'i rang bzhin du/ /mthong ba yin yang rang bzhin du/ /rnam pa thams cad nges pa min/ /brtags min dbang rten rtogs bya ba phyeyang / /cha shas don med rang mtshan nyid / /gang las tha dad nges pa la/ /rgyu yod na ni de 'byung 'gyur/ /ji ltar mar me 'bar ba'i rgyun/ /'dra bar 'byung la gcig par 'khrul du / /de 107—56

bzhin phra ba du ma rnams/ /rgyun mi 'chad rnams blos gcig rtogs/ /dbye ba mi rtogs de rnams la/ /mngon sum du 'dod min zhe na/ /mar me sogs de ①ji ltar mthong / /de bzhin cha shas can cis 'dod/ /'di rnams rdul du ma nges na/ /sngon po la sogs rnam ldupa'o zhes/ /de lta bur yang rtogs bya bar/ /'di ni ji ltar 'gyur ba yin/ /gang phyir de la'ang rgyu med de/ /shes pa de ni yul med min/ /gong bu yul gcig ma yin te/ /gcig dang gong bu nyid 'gal phyir/ /gong bu gcig dngos nyid yin na/ /sbrang ma'i rkang pa g.yogs tsam gyis/ /de dag thams cad g.yogs par ni/ /'gyur te dbye ba med phyir ro—/ /cha gcig tu ni dmar ba yang / /thams cad la 'gyur dmar po bzhin/ /'gal ba'i chos dag sbyor ba yang / /sna tshogs nyid du thal bar 'gyur/ /gcig gi dngos nyid ma yin na/ /thams cad sgra 'dir ci zhig bya/ /de yang du ma'i yul yin na/ /yan lag can ni du ma yin/ /gos dang lus dang ri sogs gang / /'jig rten la grub ma yin nam/ /de nyid yan lag can nyid du / /khyed cag gis ni smras pa yin/ /gos dmar kun du thams cad dang / /lhag med de bzhin ma lus pa/ /de la thams cad rab sbyor zub/ /'dod pa tsam gyis 'byung ba yin/ /de 'dra mngon par 'dod pa ni/ /kho bo cag kyang smra ba ste/ /gos kun dmar por 'gyur sogs par pya/ /smra la bar du gcod pa med / /brtags nas de brjod yin zhe na/ /tshig gzhan du ni thal 'gyur zhing / /gtso bo phal par 'dod dag gi/ /tha dad blo yang yod ma yin/ /sbyor ba kun la khyab byed pa/ /'jug pa nyid ni ma yin phyir/ /thams cad dmar por thal ba min/ /thams cad g.yogs par 'dod pa'ang min/ /707—57

rdzas ni cha shas med min nam/ /ci 1phyir ma khyab par rnam gnas/ /rang dngos de ltar gnas na ni/ /de nyid kyi phyir tha dad grub/ /yul mang la gnas pa des na/ /gnas gcig byed pa nyid ma yin/ /de phyir snam bu la sogs pa/ /du ma'i ngo bo nyid du grub/ /de nyid don ni mi shes pa'i/ /'jig rten gong bu gcig snyam sems/ /rnam rtog de la ltos nas ni/ /phra rab rdul zhes 'dir brjod pa'am/ /rgyu mtshan rnam rtog pya min par yang / /brda yi rjes 'gro ldan pa yi/ /dbul la'ang phyug bo zhes brjod yin/ /'di ni ldude 'dra'i ming du gnas/ /snal ma dang ni lag pa sogs/ /cha shas can gcig rjes 'jug min/ /dper na du ma nyid grub pa'i/ /re lde snam bu rtsig sogs bzhin/ /gal te'ang mngon par 'dod pa'i rdzas/ /gcig phyir yan lag du ma la/ /rten min rdul bzhin 'jug par ni/ /mi rigs gnod can tshad ma'o/ /gcig 'jug gnas de'ang cha shas kyi/ /rten gzhan la ni 'jug pa nije/ /dngos de nyid kyis sam gzhan kyis/ /rnam pa gzhan yod min pas so / /de la 'di ni de nyid kyis/ /gzhan la 'jug par brtag min te/ /de dbang byas pa nyid kyis ni/ /gzhan du der 'jug yod ma yin/ /dper na khu 'jo ba'i ma ma/ /gzhan gyi dbang bya'i rten 'gyur min5/ /de bzhin gcig gis dbang byas pa'i/ /dzas ni gzhan gyi rten byed min/ /gang phyir de 'byel rang bzhin no/ /de min yul la'ang 'jug pas na/ /de ni yul gcig nyid thob bam/ /gcig bdag nyid 'gyur dbyer med phyir/ /gzhan nyid bdag nyid kyis 'jug na/ /rang bzhin tha dad pa yi dngos/ /tha dad bdag nyid nyid yin pas/ /gcig ni du mar gnas 'grub min/ /de de rnams bye la 107—58

'du ba yi/ /bdag nyid kyis 'jug yin zhe na/ /skyo ba nyid kyis 'di 'gro ba① / /de yang rnam par dpyad bya yin/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid thams cad kyis/ /'jug na du ma nyid thob 'gyur/ /phyogs gcig gis na tha ④med 'gyur/ /de gcig min pa'am gang du ①min/ /rang rgyud pa 'ang thal 'gyur ba'i/ /bsgrub ④pas gang zhig 'jug pa na/ /de ni rang nyid kyis mthong ba/ /yin na 'byel par 'gyur ba yin/ /ma lus pas sam phyogs gcig gis/ /'jug pa gang du'ang ma shes nyid/ /gang gi yod pa min phyir rdzas/ /med pa 'ang ⑤gzhan du 'gyur ba'o/ /de ni la lar mthong ba na/ /rdzas la sogs pa gsal dub bzhin//de bzhin der ni ma mthong na/ /tha dad par rgol mi rigs so/ /de dag tsam gyis 'jug pa nyid/ /med par brjod 'gyur zhe na'ang de/ /mi rigs 'di na 'di zhes pa'i/ /blo yis 3mngon sum gyis grub pa'i/ /de ni mngon sum 'dod min na/ /gnod pa can 'ga' brjod pa'i rigs/ /gzhan du gzugs sogs shes pa yang / /mngon sum min pa nyid du 'gyur/ /'di la 'jug pa de med par/ /dbyer med tshul kyis sngar bstan zin/ /'di la zhes pa'i shes pa med/ /de yi ngo bo mi snang phyir/ /ma lus pa dang phyogs gcig pa'i—/ /sgra dang don 'di bshad mdzad pa'i/ /cha shas med 'di'i 'jug pa ci—/ /de ni de las gzhan du 'am/ /ji ltar snod khrul sogs bzhag pa'i/ /dpal 'bras la sogs ji bzhin pa'am/ /stan ni du ma la 'jug pa'i/ /nag pa sogs mthong lta bu yin/ /bum pa mar me la sogs bzhin/ /'jig pa la sogs gtan tshigs kyis/ /sgra rnams 'ga' zhig la brten yin/ /de ni nam mkhar 'gyur ba yin/ /nyi sogs bya ba'i rdzas rnams las/ /tha dad pa yi rgyu 107—59

mtshan ni/ /gzhan na gzhan min sogs shes pa/ /ji ltar bum sogs shes bzhin no/ /skra dkar gnyer ma lus rtsub sogs/ /gyur la sogs pa'i shes phyir 'dir/ /gang las mtshan nyid mi 'dra rgyu/ /de ni dus zhes ①bya bar 'dod / /shar dang gzhan sogs blo rnams las/ /phyogs nyid rjes su dpog pa yin/ /shes pa rim gyis skye ba las/ /yid kyang rjes su dpag par 'dod/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i shes pa ni/ /rim gyis skye phyir gzugs sogs las/ /gzhan pa'i rgyu la ltos pa ste/ /dper na shing rta sogs bzhin no/ /zin sogs 'byung ba chen po rnams/ /rgyu nyid yin par khas len na/ /sgra rnams de rnams la brten par/ /'grub phyir snga ma sgrub byed min/ / kha cig bye rtag par khyab byed pa/ /'du ba nyid du 'grub min te/ /'di rnams rjes 'gro ma tshang phyir/ /de bzhin rim 1 min sogs thob pya'agyur/ /gzhan dang gzhan min sogs shes pa'i/ /rgyu ni brda yi bye brag las/ /byung ba'i yid la byed pa rngudag /yin phyir dus dang phyogs de dag /cha shas med gcig dngos yin phyir/ /gzhan dang gzhan sogs srid pa min/ /de dang 'byel pa can dbye bas/ /zhe na de dag 'bras med 'gyur/ /mig la sogs pa la gzhan pa/ /drug po de ma thag 'byung ba'i/ /shes pa gang yin de yid du/ /kho bo cag kyang 'dod pa yin/ /yin nyid rtag na shes pa rnams / /cig car ba nyid thob par 'gyur/ /des 'dir sngar smras gtan tshigs su/ /'dod pa rnam par nyams byas du'agyur/ /sangs rgyas pa dang phyi rol pas/ /brtan dze+epa'i yid 'grub mi 'grub pa/ /gzhan gyis mdor smra ā bcas dang / /gzhan du yang ni bzlas nas so/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i 107—60

rab tu byed pa las rdzas kyi tshig gi don brtag pa ste bco lnga pa'o// //rdzas rnams bkag pa de las ni/ /de bzhin rten ① par 'dod pa yi/ /yon tan la sogs kun la nyid/ /med par 'gyur ba kho na'o/ /'byel pa can rnams ⑤bkag pa na/ /'du ba'ang gang la gang zhig yin/ /de lta na yang bye brag tu/ /dgag pa 'di ni brjod par bya/ /sngon po la sogs rags pa'i rdzas/ /gal te gcig pa nyid 'dod na/ /bu ga'i snang bas de gsal 1 bzhin—/ /gsal ba ci phyir snang ba ④min/ /yangs pa'i phyogs na gnas pa yi/ /sngon po la sogs mthong ba yang / /gsal 'gyur min pa de yi tshe/ /de las de de tha dad 'gyur/ /de min gzhan la blo log cing / /glang po sogs las tha dad pa'i/ /grangs ni snang bar khyed 'dod de/ /shes las snang ba yod nyid min—/ /'dod pas rab tu sbyar ba yi3/ /brda ni yid byed rjes 'gro ba/ /bum sogs gcig sogs rnam shes 'di/ /shes pa sogs bzhin 'jug pa ste/ /de rnams rdzas nyid min pa'i phyir/ /rnam 'byed rdzas ni gang zhig yid/ /ma 'khrul pa yi de nyid kyis/ /shes de brjod par pya rigs min nyid/ /de ni rdzas dang 'grel pa las/ /gcig nyid yin dang don gcig la/ /'du phyir yon tan la sogs la/ /rnam shes gcig tu 'dod ce ④na/ /de ltar gcig pa'i shes pa nyid/ /yin yang gnyis sogs blo gang yin/ /tshig gi don drug sogs gang la/ /de rnams la ltos rgyu gang yin/ /don gcig la ni 'du sogs kyi/ /shes pa 'di ni med par 'gyur/ /des na 'di ni 'khrul 'gyur te/ /mi la me yi blo bzhin no/ /glang po la sogs shes de las/ /gzhan pa las byung dmag 107—61

gi blo/ /mtshan nyid mi 'dra las sgrub ①pa/ /snam bu sngo sogs blo bzhin no/ /'dod pas sbyar ba'i brda dang ni/ /yid la byed sogs thabs yin na/ /blo de 'dod yin de nyid kyis②/ /blo la sogs pa'ang ①grangs su 'gyur/ /gal te blo la ltos pa las/ /grangs 'grub par ni smra ba yang / /brda la 'jug pa tsam byis ni/ /blo de ci yi phyir mi 'dod/ /che dang ring sogs dbye ba yis④/ /bong tshod gang zhig rjod byed pa'i/ /don de'ang de bzhin min dngos kyi/ /dbye ba nyid las cis ④mi 'dod/ /khang bzangs snephreng ni ring po dang / /chen por ji ltar snang ba yin/ /de la 'di 'dra'i ⑦bong tshod kyi/ /ngo bor rtog pa ma yin no/ /don gcig la ni 'du ba yis/ /de ltar bstan pa yin zhe na—/ /gang phyir phan tshun tha dad pa/ /so so bar brjod de'i yan lag /dang bral gzhan las gzhan de bzhin/ /gang dang phrad dang dbye ba yang / /gzhan la rdzas spusu nges pa dag⑨ /phrad sogs blo dag gi ni rgyud/ /brtag ⑫pa de dag don med nyid/ /phrad pa yod pa ma yin na/ /sa bon chu dang zhing la sogs / /rtag tu 'bras bu 'byin par ni/ /thal 'gyur bye brag med phyir ro//zhing dang sa bon chu sogs rnams/ /ltos dang bcas par shes byas te/ /rang 'bras rtag tu mi 'byin tsurmephyir/ /'byin pa 'khor lo'i chu bzhin no/ /de rnams gang la ltos gyur pa'i/ /dngos po phrad pa yin par 'gyur/ /de ni bye brag dngos gyur phyir/ /tha dad nyid ces shes bya ste/ /phrad par ⑫'dod pa gang dag dang / /phrad la longs spyod pa zhes brjod/ /de las gzhan pa yongs spangs nas/ /de nyid longs spyod pa 'di'o/ /dngos 'di bar chad med pa 'am/ /'di ni bar chad dang bcas zhes/ /'di 'dra'i blo yi dbye ba 107—62

dag /'di dag med gang las 'dir rig /gang 'dir bar chad bcas blo la//bar chad med pa'i blo nges dang / /bar chad med la'ang gang gzhan pa/ /'di gnyis log pa'i shes pa ste/ /log pa'i shes pa thams cad nyid① / /don gyi gtso bo'i rjes 'jug la/ /gtso bor 'dir ni brjod bya ba/ /brjod pas de dag kyang 'grub 'gyur/ /gdub 'khor can zhes blo 'di yang / /rgyu gang gis skye mi la ni/ /gdub 'khor yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ /de ni rtag tu thal bar 'gyur / /gzhan du mthong ba yod pa la/ /gzhan du dgag pa nyid rigs kyi//phrad pa gang du'ang ma mthong ba/ /de go byeji ltar dgag tu rung / /nag pa gdub 'khor med de bzhin/ /de phyir dngos rnams yod nyid yin/ /dgag dang sgrub sogs gang yin pa'i/ /rnam par dbye ba'i gnas yin zhes/ /smra la skad cig pa nyid kyis/ /chu sogs bye brag med pa ste/ /bar chad med pa sogs yod kyang / /gnas skabs gzhan la ltos bcas yin/ /gal te rgyu la sogs de rnams/ /phrad pa tsam la ltos bcas na/ /phrad pa thag nyid 'bras 'byung 'gyur/ /de min mthar yang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /bar chad med par 'byung ba las/ /gnas skabs bye brag thob pa la'ang / /gang dag 'di longs spyod mthong ba'ang / /dngos de dag kyang de bzhin 'grub/ /bar du chod kyang zu gzhan nyid bar/ /skye ba'i rgyu las bar chad dang / /bcas dang bar chad med shes pa/ /log pa'i shes pa thams cad kyang / /chos mthun la ltos min par yang / /'khrul rgyu nang ④la yod 'ga' zhig /gzhan du 'gyur ba'i sems la ni/ /zla ba gnyis sogs blo bzhin no/ /bar chad med sogs las ④byung ba/ /gtso bo rjo'adir ni yod na yang / /gnas skabs bye brag las skyes 107—63

pa—/ /gdub 'khor can zhes pa blo 'di/ /nag pa dang ni gdub 'khor bzhin / /phrad pa dang ni 'dra ba yi/ /gnas skabs khyad par can las so/ /de 'drar mthong bzhin gzhan du min/ /phrad pa nyid du mthong min las/ /nag pa gdub 'khor med sogs pa'i/ /pha rol po yi 'dod pa las/ /phrad pa'i dngos po'i blo skye min/ /phrad pa'i blo ni gang yin las/ /khang bzangs ①sogs la phrad blo 'byung / /yang na dngos po du ma nyid/ /yod la snal ma mang po la/ /sogs pa'i kyayul can blo bzhin du/ /tha dad par ①ni skye bar 'gyur—/ /bya ba yang ni ④ci rigs par/ /tshad ma gnyis kyi brngod bya ste/ /gcig ni du ma la khru'ajug pa'ang / /mi rigs gnod pa can yin no/ /pha rol pha rol min brjod sogs/ /rtog pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin pa/ /pha rol nyid dang pha rol min/ /nyid yin phyogs dus de ④rgyu min/ /dper na sngon po sogs dngos rnams/ /rim gyis 'byung dang gnas pa las/ /gzhan ma'i ⑦rgyu mtshan kyis dbe+en pa'ang / /de ltar bstan cing gzhan de bzhin/ /grangs dang phrad pa la sogs kun/ /rdzas las tha dad min pa min/ /de ni rnam dpyod byebyed nyid kyis/ /dbyeg dupa sogs bzhin 'dod ce na/ /de rnams kun rdzob tu yod par/ /smra bas 'dod pa sgrub byed yin/ /gang phyir kun rdzob tu yod par/ /de nyid gzhan nyid kyis brjod min/ /'on te brjod bya nyid min pa'i/ /tshogs la sogs pa 'gog byed pa/ /gang phyir nges pa'i chos nyid de/ /gzugs sgra dri ro sogs bzhin du⑪/ /de ni de kho na nyid du/ /dngos med nam mkha'i pad+ma bzhin/ /chos nges pa nyid mi 'grub ste/ /de rnams rtog pas ⑪sgo btags pa'o/ /gang phyir nam mkha'i pad sogs kyis/ /707—64

de skad smras nyid ma nges pa'o/ /tha dad min dang tha dad pa'ang / /dngos po nyid la rnam par gnas/ /grangs sogs rdzas las tha dad pa/ /de ltar bsgrub bya yin zhe na/ /gzhi nyid ma grub pa yi phyir/ /grangs sogs rnams ni mi 'grub bo/ /bsdus pa sogs las tha dad pa'i/ /rdzas nyid de ltar brjod bya ba//rang dngos nyid las tha dad pa/ /rnam par nyams par sgrub par 'gyur/ /byas pa'i shugs ni rnam ①gsum du/ /bstan te shugs su brjod pa dang / /goms pa brjod dang gnas 'jig pa/ /'di dag ma lus mi 'thad de/ /dngos rnams skad cig pa yin phyir/ /byas pa gang yang yod min naṭu/ /byas pa'i shugs kyi bka' can la①/ /gang gi rgyu byeni rgyur 'gyur ⑤ yin/ /goms pa brjod par bu byas pa'i shugs/ /sems kyi bag chags bdag nyid rigs/ /bdag gi yon tan nyid de ni/ /mi rigs ④de ni gsal /⑧phyir ro/ /gnas su 'jog byed dngos nyid du/ /mi rigs skad cig gis shesna'ajig phyir/ /gnas don 'byung ba nyid gyur las/ /de yi ngo bo nyid du gnas/ /rang gi rgyu hūṃ nyid las byung ba/ /skad cig gcig ni gnas pa rnams/ /snga ma snga ma'i nus mthu las / /rgyun gyis rjes su 'jug pa yin/ /de ni gzhan du 'byung min pa/ /de phyir 'di yi 'jog byed gang / /'di yi mthong ba'i rgyu nyid min/ /gzhan yang byas pa'i shugs su 'gyur/ /gos sogs skye ba 'di nyid la/ /'jog byed yon tan du 'dod na/ /de bzhin byas shugs yon tan yang / /thams cad du yang yod mi 'gyur/ /yid dang bdag tu spyor ba dag /gong du rgyas par bkag pa'i phyir/ /ma mthong ba la pha rol pos/ /smras pa mtshan nyid ldan mi rigs—/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las yon tan kyi tshig gi don 107—65

brtag pa ste bcu drug pa'o// //dngos rnams skad cig gcig gi la/ /rdeg ①pa la sogs las yod min / /skye ba'i yul du zhen pa nyid/ /de las gzhan thob yod ④ma yin/ /skye ba'i las ni gzhan pa'i dus/ /las kyi dus shes pha rol smra/ /shin tu myur bar zhig 'dod pa/ /mar me la sogs dngos la yang / /rgyab ma mdun pa'i ④yul dag las/ /phral byadang phrad pa'i 'byung dag la/ /'gro ba can nam gzhan kun yang / /las kyi gzhir ni rab brtags las/ /gar skyes nam du'ang skad cig kyang / /gnas min g.yo ba'i bdag nyid do/ /de ni rdul phran tsam gyis kyang / /yul du 'pho ba yod ma yin/ /rtag pa'i dngos po thams cad ni/ /'gro la sogs par shin tu yang / /bsgrub dka' gnas skabs thams cad du/ /'di la bye brag med nyid do/ /gal te 'gro po sogs dngos de'i/ /dngos yin rtag tu 'gro sogs 'gyur/ /skad cig gcig kyang mi g.yo bar/ /gcig tu gnas pa ma yin no/ /gang du 'gro sogs med pa yang / /'dis ni rtag tu thob 'gyur na/ /snga ma'i ngo bo mi 'dor phyir/ /'gro sogs rtsom pa'i dus bzhin no/ /'on te 'gro min sogs dngos po'i/ /dngos yin rtag tu 'gro mi 'gyur/ /skad cig gcig kyang 'gul bar ni/ /'gyur ba nyid ni ma yin no/ /gang phyir 'gro sogs yin na yang / /mi g.yo'i bdag nyid phyir yin te/ /snga ma'i ngo bo mi 'dor ⑤phyir/ /g.yo min ngo bo'i dus bzhin no/ /gal te 'gro min dus gcig tshe'ang / /gzhan du yang ni 'gyur yin na/ /phan tshun 'gal ba'i bdag nyid dang / /'dres pas tha dad 107—66

nyid du 'gyur/ /de dag shin tu tha dad pa'i/ /bdag nyid du ni nges pa ste—/ /'gal ba'i chos dag 'dre ba'i phyir/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo'i dngos bzhin no/ /mthong ba nyid du mngon 'dod pa'i/ /las ni dngos po las gzhan min/ /'di ni mthong ba nyid kyang min/ /rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs yod ma yin/ /mi brtan ①nyid dang brtan nyid dang ②/ /de lta'i 'gro sogs rnams ①yod min/ /thob dang gzhan pa'i yul dag las/ /byed dang phrad pa'i rigs ma yin/ /rgyun mi 'chad par skye ba yin/ /'dra ba dang ④ gzhan dngos rnams kyi/ /yul gzhan nye bar thob pa la 'gro bar 'khrul yin sgon ma yin/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las las kyi tshig gi don brtag pa ste khrubacu bdun pa'o// //rdzas la sogs pa bkag pa ni/ /rigs rnams kyang ni gsal rngub yin/ /de dag thams cad tshig gi don/ /gsum la gnas par kun du brtags/ /de la rigs 'di rnam gnyis su/ /pha rol pos ni khas blangs pa/ /ma lus pa la rjes 'jug pas/④ / /yod par brjod pa spyi nyid dang / /bye brag yod par mngon brjod pa'i/ /rdzas la sogs pa'i spyi nyid de/ /rang gnas rnams su rjes 'jug pa'i/ /sems kyi rgyur gyur dngos las so/ /rigs mi mthun pa thams cad dang / /rang gi gnas kyi bye brag las/ /log pa'i blo yi rgyu nyid de/ /de rnams de ltar gnas pa nyid/ /bye brag nyid ni kha cig gi/ /log pa nyid kyi ⑧rgyu rnams te/ /rtag pa'i rdzas su gang gnas rnams/ /bye brag ces ni brjod pa yin/ /gang gi stobs kyis ⑨rdul phran las/ /sogs las ⑩ rnal 'byor pa'i ⑪107—67

blo 'byung / /'di ni de dang mtshan nyid ni/ /mi 'dra bar ni so sor gnas/ /yod nyid ba lang 1nyid sogs rigs/ /mngon sum gyis kyang rab grub ste/ /dbang po'i bya ba yod pa la/ /yod sogs shes pa 'byung phyir ro/ /rjes su dpag pa'i stobs kyis kyang / /'di dag yod par shes bya ste/ /shes pa'i bye brag gang zhig gegis/ /rgyu mtshan gzhan las byung ba'o/ /ba lang glang po sogs rnams la/ /glang sogs sgra dang shes bye brag /brda dang dbyibs dang ril po sogs/ /tha dad don kyi rgyu mtshan no/ /ba lang la sogs yul nyid la'ang / /de yi sgra blo yod pa las/ /gzhan phyir dper na de nyid la'ang / /lcags kyu be'u bcas blo sgra bzhin/ /ri bong rwa sogs rnam shes kyis/ /bye brag la ni rnam 'phrul phyir/ /de yi ngo bo brjod rnams kyang / /chos mi mthun par lta bar byed/ /ba lang sogs rjes 'jug shes pa'ang / /ril po las gzhan par skye ste/ /bye brag ldan phyir sngon po las/ /sogs pa'i shes pa lta bu'o / /ba lang nyid ni ba lang las/ /don gzhan tha dad blo yul phyir/ /de bzhin gzugs dang reg sogs bzhin/ /brjod pa nag pa'i rta bzhin no/ /de kun snying po med pa ste/ /gzhung lugs tsam du smra ba rnams/ /'di las shes byed tshad ma ni/ /cung zad tsam yang ma mthong ngo / /dbang po'i ④bya ba yod pa yi/ /rjes byung yod sogs shes pa ni/ /'grub pa min te de rnams ni//brda la 'jug pa nyid phyir ro/ /dper na sna tshogs pa yi nad④/ /bsal na sgyu ru ra ⑤shing sogs/ /re re 'am ni sbyar ba'ang rung / /nus pa sna tshogs nyid du'ang rigs/ /de rnams la ni spyi zhes pa'i/ /nus ldan cung zad yod ma yin/ /yun ring myur ba'i dbye ba yis/ /nad rnams zhi bar thar phyir ro/ /107—68

zhing sogs dbye bas 'ga' zhig la'ang / /gcig gi ngo bo la rtag pa'i/ /khyad par can spyi yod spyi yi/ /sgyu ru ra'i shing sogs de yod/ /de ltar shin tu tha dad kyang / /kha cig nus pa nges pa yis/ /mtshungs par bsre ba la sogs pa'i—/ /rgyu nyid thob kyi gzhan du min/ /bya ba tsam la mkho ba yi/ /brjod par 'dod pa'i sgra de yang / /brda ru byas pa de la 'am/ /yang na ci 'dod gzhan yang ngo / /dgal dang bzho sogs ngo bo yi/ /bya ba'i dbye ba la mkho ba/ /ba lang sogs sgra'i brda ru ni/ /tha snyad 'dogs pa po rnams byed/ /de brda yin par ①byed pa la/ /yod pa la sogs pa 'di ni/ /skye bar yang ni shes bya yi / /dbang po'i bya ba'i rjes thogs min/ /rtog med rnam pa'i shes pa nyid//dang po nyid du skye 'gyur zhing / /de nas brda rnams yid byed la/ /de las de dran de rnams las/ /gzhan du son pa'i sems la ni/ /dang bye po'i gtan tshigs kyang 'bras med/ /phyogs de phyi rol la min te/ /bsgrub byas stong par ston pa yin/ /dngos su de yi rgyu min te/ /phyi yi lcags kyu be'u sogs zubazhin/ /rang gi mtshan nyid 'di la ni/ /brjod 5dang rnam rtog 'jug yod min/ /gang gis rang gi mtshan nyid ni/ /ngag kun spyod yul las 'das dngos/ /nang tsam la ni brten nas 'di/ /kun sdob nyid du dmigs byed de/ /lcags kyu la sogs phyi dngos por/ /nges pas 'jug par 'gyur ba yin/ /las dang yon tan tha snyad dag /med pa rgyur ni gang smras pa/ /med pa'i shes pas ⑤bye brag ni/ /de yang mi rigs nus pa yis⑥/ /rgyu nyid las ni dngos po nyid/ /gzhan yang yod sogs bye brag dag /med las med pa'i shes pa thob ril las tha dad blo yin pas/ /shes pa de dag rnams dang ni/ /mtshan nyid mi 107—69

'dra ba mi 'grub/ /des ni gtan tshigs mi 'grub 'gyur/ /gang phyir rjes 'jug ldan shes pas/ /sgra dang gsal bar snang bcas la/ /mdog dbyibs yi ge'i rnam pa yis/ /stong pa rigs yin zhes smras 1byed/ /spyi yang sngon po la sogs pa'i/ /dngos nyid yin na yon tan dang / /'di la dbye ba ci zhig yod—/ /sngon po sogs la gcig nyid ni/ /rjes 'jug par yang snang ba yin//snang bzhin yin yang 'di yi ni/ /dbye ba shes 'gyur min zhe na/ /de yi stobs kyis de dag ni/ /sgra blo ji bzhin gsal 'jug 'gyur/ /spyi yi shes pa pha rol po/ /nges pa'i bdag nyid nges 'u'adod pa/ /nges pa med par mi rigs te/ /mi 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'gyur/ /rgyu mtshan gzhan nyid las 'grub ldukyang / /rjes 'jug gcig pu mi brten chelas/ /tha dad spyi ni mi 'grub ste/ /rim gyis 'byung ba nyid phyir ro/ /tshig gi don sgra drug po yis/ /bdag nyid rgyu gzhan la ltos pa/ /gang yang yod pa sogs rjes 'jug /yod pa shes pa'i shes pa'o/ /chos can rgyu mtshan yin zhe na/ /de la'ang yod pa'i blo yod pas/ /chos gzhan de yi rgyu nyid de/ /thug med chos can nyid kyang thob hūṃ / /de phyir 'di rnams kyis gtan tshigs/ /'di ni 'khrul par mthong ba ste/ /nye bar sbyor ba thams cad la/ /khyab par 'di ni sgrub pa min/ /de yi 'og tu nyer bstan pa/ /'di nyid kyis ni gsal ⑥ba yin/ /thun mong du sgrub de la ni/ /'dod pa 'grub pa phyosogs par mtshungs/ /'tshed pa po la sogs pa yang / /rjes 'jug can gcig ldu min na yang / /shes pa bye brag can skye zhing / /med la med pa'i blo yang ngo / /'dod pas sbyar ba'i ngo bo dang / /zhig dang ma skyes pa rnams la/ /ji skad bstan pa de kun gyis/ /107—70

gtan tshigs ma nges pa nyid do/ /'tshed pa po sogs blo rnams kyis/ /rgyu mtshan cung zad yod ma yin/ /las yod ce ①na de bzhin du/ /gsal ①ba so sos 1phye min nam/ /phye la rjes 'jug can gye ④blo/ /rjes 'jug yod par rigs ma yin/ /de phyir gcig tu 'dod pa'i phyir/ /gsal ba kun rjes 'jug ldan 'gyur/ /rjes 'jug gis phongs las la ni/ /gal te rgyur rtog de ltar ⑤ na/ /gsal ba rnams ni de nyid la/ /ci phyir rgyu nyid du ni 'dod/ /las rnams dang ni bral ba der/ /'tshed po sogs blo med gyur pyate/ /rigs bzhi las ni dus kun du/ /gnas par pha rol po 'dod min/ /'das dang ma 'ongs las ni de'i/ /rgyu mtshan can du byas she na/ /'tshed pa po sogs blo sgra yi/ /rgyu de ma yin med pas so/ /gal te las nyid kyi rigs dang / /'byel pa'i las dang sbyor ba'i blo/ /de ni zhig pa'i las la yang nges pa'i rgyu ni mtshon phyir ro/ /'das pa'i las ni de yi tshe/ /mtshon du zin yang yod pa dang / /gzung bya min te rigs kyi ni/ /rang rten ldog ⑦pa nges pas so /dbyig pa gdub 'khor sogs rigs rnams/ /lan cig dmigs la de dang ni/ /bral yang dbyig pa la sogs blo/ /de rnams la ni 'jug pa min/ /'on te'ang 'tshed pa bo la sogs/ /rigs gzhan du ni smra byed na/ /skyes ma thag la'ang ④de sbyor bas/ /'tshed pa po 2/sogs blo ru 'gyur/ /de tshe yod sogs blo bzhin du/ /'du ba can rnams med ce na/ /phyis kyang de la de bzhin du/ /'gyur te bye brag med phyir ro/ /de dang 'byel ⑫pa'i rang bzhin no/ /yon tan ldan min de dag la/ /'du ba 'di ni de ltar ⑪na/ /phyis de'i bdag nyid ji ltar 'gyur/ /gal te gsal ba mi rtag pas/ /khyad par can gyur de 107—71

lta na'ang / /rigs kyi yon tan mi ldan pa'i/ /ngo bo nam yang 'dod mi 'gyur / /'tshed pa la sogs bya ba las①/ /gtso bo sgrub par 'dod pa yis④ /'tshed pa po sogs zhes pa de'i/ /gtso bo'i 'tshed po gzhan yod min/ /gtso bo zhes bya 'di ci zhig /rjes 'jug min phyir nus pa min/ /rdzas dang las dang yon tan sogs/ /bdag nyid nyid du de rtag min/ /de dang rigs mi 'dra ba las/ /log pa'i ngo bor nges pa tsam/ /brda yi bye brag la ltos pa/ /me la sogs pa'i blo yin no/ /brda nyid ji lta ba nyid de/ /de phyir gcig nyid rjes 'jug pa/ /med kyang sgra dang blo nyid kyi/ /dbye ba yis ni 'jug pa yin//de lta na yang med rnams la/ /med pa'i blo dang sgra dag kyang / /rjes 'jug 'gal min de dag gi/ /don med brda rjes 'jug phyir ro/ /bum pa snga na med 'di'o zhes/ /de phyir dngos po'i bye brag can/ /nyid kyi mig blor shes bya ste/ /bye brag la brten spyi dbang gis/ /de ni kun du rjes 'jug nyid/ /ce na de lta min mtshan nyid/ /min 'dra de min la brten phyir/ /bum pa zhes bya la sogs blo/ /de rnams rjes 'jug par rigs kyi/ /med pa'o med pa'o snyam blo 'di/ /mtshan nyid mi 'dra'i phyir yin no/ /yod pa'i dbang gis ①ba lang dang / /rta yi blo byar 'dod min gyi/ /thams cad spyi ni yin bsgrub phyir//gcig nyid gzhan du brtag pa'o/ /gang rnams dmag sogs blo rnams kyi/ /rgyur ni grags la sogs 'dod pa'i/ /rjes mthun par 'dod min zhe na/ /gal te de ltar yin na ni/ /'dod pas sbyar ba'i brda dbye ba/ /yid la byed pas rjes 'jug pa'i/ /blo dbye ba ni cis mi 'dod/ /bye brag shes na brdar byed pa'i/ /'dod pa de las byung ba yin/ /de byas pa las de thos pa'ang / /707—72

yid byed de las de blo 'di/ /rjes su 'gro ldog dag gis ni/ /de nyid kyi ni blo 'di yi/ /rgyu yi nges pa'i nges pa grub/ /gzhan 'dod thug pa med par 'gyur—/ /rjes su mthun pa dang 'dra bar①/ /'gyur na don gzhan du rtog na/ /mtshan nyid mi 'dra can blo rnams/ /'di nyid la brten pa ni mchog /'di la nus pa nges par ni/ /ldog pa rjes su 'gro ldog gi/ /nus pa shes pa rnams la ni—/ /rtog na de yang mchog yin no/ /spyi rnams la yang rjes 'gro bar/ /byed pa dag ni yod min te/ /rtag rnams rtag tu yod pa'i phyir/ /ldog pa nyid ni mi srid do/ /rdzas sogs min pa'i blo rnams ni/ /yon tan nyid sogs rigs pa min/ /du ma rnams ni 'du ba yang / /grangs la sogs pa'ang yod 'gyur te/ /de rnams la yang khyaspyi bzhin du/ /spyi zhes bya ba'i blo ru 'gyur/ /bum pa nyid sogs pa'i spyi yang / /bum sogs nyid la 'jug gyur ④gye/ /med rnams la 'di 'jug min phyir/ /de rnams blo ni ji lta burakhyo //rten gzhan la brten phyir gzhan du/ /blo dang sgra dang rigs min te/ /glang po sogs bzhin rta sogs la'o/ /'dir ni don gcig la brten min/ /dro dang grang dang lci ba yang / /don gcig la brten blor 'gyur gyi/ /'di la 'di yang don med nyid/ /med pa gang du'ang gnas pa min/ /bye brag bye brag can nyid kyi/ /'byel pa 'di la yod ce na/ /'di la 'byel pa gzhan yod par/ /rtog par byed pa ma yin nam/ /de dag spyor ba la brten nas/ /bye brag bye brag can rtog na/ /de med rgyu mtshan med pa nyid/ /de ni grub pa ma yin no/ /bum pa'i snga na med pa zhes/ /bya ba la sogs tshig ⑤'di yang / /rtog pa can gyis sprul pa ste/ /brtags pa'i dpa' bo nyid sogs bzhin/ /bye 107—73

brag bye brag can nyid 'di/ /gang yin dngos po la brten te/ /'brel pa gzhan zhig yod par ni/ /de la ①nges par brtag par bya/ /de la med pa med pa zhes/ /'dir ni shes pa tsam brjod pa/ /bye brag la gnas spyi yin te//rang gi rten rnams la gnas pa'o/ /de rnams rjes 'jug 'dod min gyi/ /gal te gzhan yod 'dod min na/ /tshig gi don las tha dad pas/ /med pa'i blo ni skye ba yin/ /'dod pas sbyar ba'i gzugs sogs pa'i/ /don la rigs ni yod min te/ /gsal ba med pa nyid kyi phyir/ /de ni 'khrul pa nyid du bstan/ /'das pa dang ni ma byung ba'i/ /rtag pa'i spyi yi yul can gyis②/ /shes yod ce na 'di ni byen/ /'ba' zhig mi 'dzin ma yin nam/ /'ba' zhig dmigs pa yin na ni/ /gsal ba rnams kyir 'dir mi 'gyur/ /spyi yi gsal byed de min te/ /gangs can 'baigs byed nyid bzhin no/ /'di ni de rnams bskyed pa la/ /gzhan dbang yin pas 'byel pa med/ /rtag phyir gcig pu 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /shes pa gzhan dbang nyid kyang min/ /rang rten dbang ①por sbyor ba las④/ /sogs la ltos pa med phyir ro/ /yod pa rtag tu dmigs nyid dam/ /yang na nam yang ma yin te/ /rang gi bdag nyid shes bskyed par/ /rung ba'am yang na mi rung nyid/ /gal te lan cig de lta'i dngos| /yin na rtag tu de nyid 'gyur/ /de ni rung ba'am mi rung ba'i/ /ngo bor rang bzhin gyis gang gnas/ /de rnams ⑤rtag phyir g.yo min te/ /'jug rjopar 'gyur ba gang zhig yin/ /ba lang nyid ni ba lang las/ /don gzhan tha dad blo yul phyir/ /de ni gzugs dang reg sogs bzhin/ /brjod pa nag pa'i rta bzhin no/ /zhes 'dir 'khrul pa smra ba ste/ /'tshed pa po nyid 107—74

sogs de bzhin/ /'di yi ①tshul gyis gzhan la yang / /dman pa'i gtan tshigs sun kun ston②/ /gzhan yang spyi ni du ma la/ /'jug pa nyid du gang smras pa/ /de la 'jug par 'dod 'di ci/ /gnas pa'am 'on te gsal ba nyid/ /re zhig rang dngos mi nyams pa/ /'di gnas pa yi dngos yin na/ /rten ni de byed nus min na/ /gang gis 'jog ①pa po nyid 'gyur/ /de ni ba dhi rang sogs bzhin/ /'gro ba'i bgegs kyang yod min te/ /bya ba med pa nyid kyis na/ /de phyir gzhir ni brtag pa min/ /de ni 'du bar gnas she na//de ltar rnam par dpyad min te/ /des na tha dad mi grub rnams/ /rten dang rten can bdag nyid 'dod/ /'bras sogs rnams kyi ④'gro ba la/ /gegs byed pas ni gzhir gyur na/ /'gro ba smin pa'i spyi rnams la/ /rang gi shes pa skyed ⑤rung nyid/ /yin na gsal ba'i rgyu ci yin/ /gal te nus med 'di nus dang / /ldan par gsal byed kyis byed na/ /'byung ba mi brtan 'gyur nyid de//mar me gsal bya bum sogs bzhin/ /bum sogs rigs kyi bye brag kyang / /rang gnas rnams nyid la yin na/ /thams cad la gnas rten du yang / /'gyur te dam pa'i rigs bzhin no/ /de la yul gzhan nyid du yang / /dngos po 'byung ba de la ni/ /de rnams ji ltar mthong ba 'am/ /gnas pa'i rten yin mi shes so/ /de dang lhan cig skye ba min/ /de rnams rtag phyir de la sngar / /gnas min khyab pa min pas so/ /gzhan nas 'ongs min byas med phyir| /rang gnas dbang por sbyor la sogs/ /de ni gcig pa 'dzin pa narjo/ /thams cad du yang dmigs 'gyur te/ /de yi rang dngos mi 'dor phyir/ /rtogs las tha dad min zhe na/ /de yang 'dzin par byed 'gyur ba'am/ /de 107—75

bzhin de nyid mi 'dzin par/ /'gyur ba'am tha dad nyid du 'gyur/ /pha rol pos btags ①rigs dag la/ /shing sogs shes pa 'di mi 'byung / /rim nyid dang rjes 'jug sogs phyir/ /dper na 'tsheng po sogs blo bzhin/ /rtag pa skyed pa po min pa/ /gnod pa can du shes bya zhing / /gong du phrad pa sun dbyung bar/ /brtan pa'ang gnod pa ②can yin no/ /de ltar rigs 'di tha dad pa/ /gcig tu gsal ba byas pa yin/ /rgyal dpog sogs pas smras pa yang dze+e/ /yod smra rtag par brtags par 'gyur④/ /gang yang bye brag ces bya ba/ /mthar dbyung bar brtags de dag ni/ /rtag pa'i rdzas ni bsal ba yi⑤/ /de yang mi srid mtshan nyid yin/ /rdul phran mkha' dang phyogs sogs rnams/ /gal te ma 'dres par gnas na/ /de phyir rang gi ngo bos te/ /mtshan nyid mi 'dra nye bar mtshon/ /gal te'ang de rnams bdag nyid gzhan/ /'dres par gyur pa yin na yang / /gzhan yod na yang mi 'dra ba'i/ /mtshan nyid ma 'khrul mtshon min na/ /ji ltar bye brag 'di rnams kyi/ /mtshan nyid mi 'dra mtshon pa yin/ /rang nyid kho na rjoyin zhe na/ /rdul phran sogs la ci mi 'dod/ /ji ltar khye sha la sogs pa/ /rang nyid kho nas mi gtsang gnas/ /de dang 'brel pas gzhan rnams kyang / /de bzhin gal te 'dir 'dod na/ /ji ltar mar me bum ⑦sogs 'di/ /gsal byed yin bzhin 'di yang ni⑧/ /de gsal byed pa'i bdag nyid du/ /nges par gnas bzhin 'di de bzhin/ /mi gtsang dngos 'di kun rdzob pa/ /yin gyi de nyid don min na/ /de nyid kyang ni gzhan du'ang ste/ /'di ni ji ltar 'gyur ba yin/ /'on te 'gyur ba nyid yin yang / /rang gi sha sogs dbang gis 'di/ /rtag pa skye ba med pa'i 107—76

phyir/ /mi gtsang dngos po 'thob pa min/ /sgon ma la sogs pa yi mthus/ /skad cig pa yi don bum pa/ /rgyan la sogs pa'i shes pa rnams/ /skyed byed dngos po thob 'gyur gyi/ /rtsod pa'i gnas gyur bye brag gi/ /stobs kyis ①mtshan nyid mi 'dra'i blo/ /de rnams dag ni 'byung min te/ /rim gyis 'byung phyir bde sogs bzhin/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las spyi dang bye brag gi tshig gi don brtag pa ste bco brgyad ②pa'o// //snal ma 'di rnams la snam bu/ /sbyig tshal 'di rnams la re lde/ /zhes sogs 'di yi blo 'byung bas/ /'du ba rtogs ⑧par bya ba yin/ /de med blo 'di'i rgyu mtshan du/ /'gyur ba yang ni ci zhig yin/ /rgyu mtshan gzhan ni med pa na/ / bye brag blo ni mthong ma yin/ /④bye brag 'di yi blo las kyang / /sbyor ba bzhin du tha dad min/ /'byung ba bzhin du thams cad la/ /'di ni gcig pa nyid ces bya/ /rtag pa de nyid 'byung ba bzhin/ /rgyu mtshan mi dmigs pa yang ni/ /'di la rgyu ni cung zad kyang / /tshad mas nye bar dmigs pa min/ /de ltar de yi shes pa yang / /rang gi grub mtha'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /pha rol po rnams 'jug byed kyi/ /'jig rten pa la'ang ⑤de ma mthong / /rten dang brten par gyur pa dag /sna tshogs pa nyid mtshan nyid 'gyur/ /kuṇ+ḍi dusogs gnas dpal 'bras bzhin/ /'di la 'di zhes pa blo yi| /de bzhin gang gi de rnams la/ /'di la de yi blo 'byung ba/ /snal ma snam bu sogs rnams la/ /sna tshogs nyid mtshon yod ma yin/ /dngos po rnams la rang 'dod kyi/ /sbyor bas 'di 'o zhes rtogs pa/ /'di ni rgyu la ⑦107—77

mngon sbyor ba/ /pha rol po smra de mi 'thad/ /shing las yal ga 'gro min la/ /brag ces 'jig rten pa blo 'byung / /mi 'gror brjod las lhag yan lag /bar mtshams med par mthong ba'i phyir/ /de dag la yang 'di yi blo/ /'jig rten dang 'gal smras pa ①yin/ /bum pa'i gzugs dang sgra la sogs/ /de yi bdag nyid du shes bya/ /gzugs dang bum sogs gnas skabs kun/ /sgra yi brjod pa ②nyid yin te/ /de yi bye brag brjod pa'i phyir/ /de rnams de bzhin 'jug pa yin/ /de la brten pa'i blo 'di rnams/ /de rnams rnam pas 'jug pa ste/ /'du bas ma yin tha dad pa/ /kun kyang mthong ba min phyir ro/ /gal te dngos po thams cad la/ /dngos po gcig gyur yod gyur na/ /'jim gong sogs la'ang snam bu ①la/ /sogs pa'i shes pa'ang thal bar 'gyur/ /glang po sogs la'ang ba lang nyid/ /la sogs yod par thal 'gyur te/ /des na ba lang sogs gzugs nyid/ /'di 'gyur ba lang ④khra bo bzhin/ /snal ma rnams la snam bu des/ /yod par 'du ba las shes na/ /'jim gong rnams la de bzhin du/ /de yod ces par cis mi shes/ /'jim gong la de brten pa min/ /zhe ⑤na 'du bas snal ma yang / /brten par rjo'adod pa ma yin nam/ /'jim gong la de ci phyir min/ /'du bas snal ma la snam bu/ /zhes byar sgrub par byed na de/ /'jim gong rnams la bum pa yi/ /blo de rgyu mtshan med par 'gyur/ /de ltar glang po sogs gang la/ /'du bas glang po nyid sogs yin/ /de nyid rang gnas la rigs kyi/ /dbye bas ba lang nyid sogs 'gyur/ /de ni gcig nyid du yod kyi/ /rten dang brten par dbye ba yis—/ /rdzas rnams la ni de rigs nyid/ /las rnams la yang las nyid de/ /107—78

'du las byung 'di las⑥zhes pa'i/ /shes pa rjes 'gror bstan pa'i phyir/ /thams cad la yang 'du ba nyid②/ /gcig pu ①kho na yin zhes bya/ /rdzas nyid la sogs rgyu mtshan rnams/ /tha dad par ni bstan pa'i phyir/ /rdzas sogs rigs kyi blo rnams kyi/ /nges pa nyid du nges pa yin/ /rten dang brten pa'i nges pa yis/ /dper na snod dang zho dag kyang / /'azel pa gcig tu'ang snang ba yin/ /de bzhin 'di la'ang nges par 'dod/ /'du ba gcig pu yin na yang / /gsal bya gsal byed nus pa yang / /dbye bas rdzas sogs rigs rnams la/ /de ni 'gal ba min zhe na/ /gcig nyid rten dang brten par ni/ /nges par bsgrub dka' ma yin nam/ /'du ba las ni rdzas nyid du/ /rdzas rnams kho na 'dod pa yi④/ /'du ba de ni yon tan la/ /sogs la'ang yod par ji ltar 'gyur/ /yon tan rdzas sogs de dag gi/ /'brel pa ⑤'di ni gcig nyid dam/ /gzhan du 'di ni yon tan dang / /rigs sogs tha dad nyid du 'gyur/ /gsal ba so so'i dusbyor dbye bas/ /sbyor ba ji bzhin tha dad 'gyur—/ /rdzas nyid la ⑦sogs rgyu rnams dang / /tha dad par ni mi rigs te/ /rgyu mtshan yod na blo yin la/ /de phyir de yi nges pa'ang min/ /der brten pa nyid sogs pa nyid/ /'du ba las yin de nyid la⑧/ /nges pa can ⑨du rigs ma yin/ /gsal bya gsal byed nus pa yi/ /dbye ba'i 'du ba las yin pa'ang ⑩/ /gzhan min pa de rtag pa rnams/ /skyed par byed pa rigs pa min//mar me la sogs yod pa las/ /skyes pa'i bum sogs 'di rnams kyis⑩/ /shes pa ji ltar skyed rung ba/ /de bzhin rigs la sogs pa min/ / kuṇ+ḍi dang zho ⑫phrad pa yi/ /gcig tu gong du bsal ⑫ba yin/ /de yi phyir yang nges pa 107—79

'di / /mi rigs shin tu thal 'gyur phyir/ /'di ni rtag pa nyid yin na/ /bum sogs kun kyang rtag 'gyur te/ /'du ba'i dbang gis de rnams kyi①/ /rang rten la rtag gnas phyir ro/ /rang gi rtsom byed bye ba 'am/ /yang na de zhig pa las sam/ /phrad pa sogs las bya ba yang / /de rnams zhig pa yin zhe na / /de lta min te de rnams kyang / /rang rten la rtag 'dur 'dod pa'am/ /de rnams rnam par 'jig 'gyur na/ /'di la nges par 'jig par 'gyur/ /'brel pa can ni 'jug min na/ /'byel pa yod par bsgrub par 'dogs/ /phrad pa med na'ang sbyor ba ni/ /rnam par gnas pa ma yin te/ /dper na sbyor ba yod gyur na/ /phrad pa rnam par gnas pa bzhin/ /de bzhin 'du ba yod pa na/ /'du ba can rnams gnas pa yin/ /'byel pa can gcig zhig na yang / /'brel pa can gzhan yod pa las/ /'du ba rnam par gnas yin kyi / /sbyor min tha dad phyir zhe na/ /gal te de ltar bum pa sogs/ /'du ba can rnams zhig na yang / /de rnams gnas pa'i bdag nyid gang / /de ni rtog pa de dang ni/ /de phyir 'brel pa can gzhan la/ /brten — pas rnam par gnas pa 'am/ /'on te phrad pa'am bye ba ni/ /'du ri ba bzhin du gzhan nyid yin / /de la brten pa'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /'du ba kun du gnas yin na/ /snga ma bzhin du bum pa sogs/ /de rnams gnas pa nyid thob 'gyur/ /de rnams de ltar gnas pa minaje / /de rnams brten pa'i bdag nyid kyi/ /'du ba ji ltar gnas par 'gyur/ /ming tsam yin na'ang de bzhin no/ /de phyir snang mul yod na 'ang / /de rnams gyen la gnas min te/ /phyis bzhin 'di ni de rnams la/ /de bzhin dngos su gnas ma yin/ /'on te gzhan nyid 107—80

phrad pa 'am/ /bye ba du ma bzhin yin na/ /'brel pa can gzhan yod pa la/ /'du ba rnam par gnas 'gyur na/ /de ltar phrad pa la sogs ①bzhin/ /'di ni mi 'gyur ma yin nam/ /de la sogs pa 'di yod pa/ /du ma'ang 'brel pa med pa ②yin/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa las 'du ba'i tshig gi don brtag pa ste bcu dgu ①pa'o// //gal te dam pa'i don du na/ /bye brag cung zad yod min na/ /dbyibs ④bcas dkar g.yo yod bdag nyid/ /ba lang 'di la sogs blos sgra/ /'di dag ⑤rgyu med 'dod min na/ /'di dag yod pa'i yul gang yin/ /kun la bye brag med par ni/ /de dag 'jug mi srid phyir ro/ /smras pa blo sgra 'di dag la/ /yul ni gang yang yod min dhite/ /nang tsam la ni nges gnas pa'i/ /sa bon 'di rnams rgyu mtshan yin/ /sgra rnams gang dang gang dag gis/ /yul du gang dang gang brjod pa/ /de de kun du sbyor ba ni/ /dngos su med de chos nyid yin/ /gang phyir rang gi mtshan nyid dang / /rigs dang de 'byel dze+erigs ldan dang / /blo yi rnam pa'i sgra don du/ /de kho na nyid du mi 'thad/ /de la re zhig sgra rnams kyi⑧/ /rang gi mtshan nyid rjod byed min/ /brda dang tha snyad thob pa yi/ /dus su khyab dang bral phyir ro/ /yul dus bya ba nus pa dang / /snang ba la sogs dbye ba las/ /gcig la gcig dngos de rnams kyi/ /gsal ba'i bdag nyid rjes 'jug min/ /de phyir brda la mthong ba'i don/ /tha snyad la ni mthong ba ⑨yin/ /brda yi dus su ma bzung ba/ /rtogs ⑩pa ma yin sgra gzhan bzhin/ /gangs can la sogs gang yin pa/ /yul dus tshogs 107—81

kyis mi dbye bar/ /'dod pa rdul phran dbye ba yis/ /skad cig pa nyid du bsgrubs zin/ /rang gi mtshan nyid 'di dag kun/ /brdar bya bar ni nus min te/ /skye med dngos su brdar bya ba/ /mi rigs rta yi rwa bzhin no/ /skyes pa'i dus su bzung ba yang / /gang tshe tshig de rjes dran nas/ /bya byed de la brda med de/ /'das nas yun ring lon phyir ro/ /gang yang skyes pa'i skad cig de'i/ /stobs kyis yin na phyi ma'i tshe/ /de la brda 'jug yod ma yin / /'dra ba nyid kyang brtags pa yin/ /dro ba la sogs par snang blo①/ /de la dbang po'i ②shes pa ni/ /rnam par gsal bar rig pa bzhin/ /dro ba sogs las byung rnams kyi/ /don gang yin pa des bskyed blo'i/ /don de snang ba min pa'i phyir/ /sgra de'i yul du mi rigs te/ /gzugs kyi sgra yi ro bzhin no / /rnam pa de dag nyid kyis ni/ /gsal ba dang ni rnam pa dag /gang gis rang gi mtshan nyid du/ /pha rol pos btags ①dag kyang gsalarjo/ /rdzas la sogs dang phrad pa dag /dgag pa gong du bstan pa'i phyir/ /de dag sgra yi don nyid du/ /de nyid don du gnas mi rigs/ /rigs dang de bzhin 'byel pa dag /gong du rgyas par bkag pa'i phyir/ /de 'og sgra don rnam gsum po/ /gzhan yang brtag par bya ba min/ /de la gsal ba rnam pa dang //rigs kyi sgra don gang smras pa/ /gang de kun kyang dngos med par/ /mtshungs phyir de rnams yod ma yin/ /blo ru gnas pa'i blo'i rnam pa/ /don dang blo gzhan la 'jug min/ /mngon 'dod don yang byed min te/ /de nyid don du brjod bya min/ /gzhan dag sgra yi don gzhan du/ /don yod can sogs par smra ba/ /de rnams kyang ni gsal ba nyid/ /yin yang de lta'ang brjod bya ste/ /107—82

sgra rnams gzhan bcad don yod can/ /zhes byar brjod bya'i mtshan nyid do/ /ba lang sogs la'ang sngar ma mthong / /lha dang mtho ris la mtshungs zer/ /sdud dang rnam grangs pa med pa'i/ /bsdus pa'ang brjod par bya ba 'am/ /yod pa min pa dang 'dra ba'ang / /sgra yi don du 'ga' 'dod pa'am/ /yod min bye brag yod gang dag /sgra ①yi rgyu mtshan yin pa 'am/ /brjod pa nyid las 'ongs pa'i sgra/ /brjod bya nyid ni thob pa ni/ /de 'di'i zhes byar mngon 'brel phyir/ /gang tshe sgra la don gyis ni/ /gcig gi ngo bor byas gyur te / /mngon par brjod pa sgra ru 'dod/ /gang yang rung don blo yi yul/ /phyi yi dngos po'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /phyi yi dngos po zhes 'dzin te/ /sgra yi don du kha cig 'dod/ /dper na byis pa rnams dang ni/ /dud 'gro rnams kyang goms pa las/ /so sor snang ba rgyu yin te/ /de la don yod ces brjod 'di//rang gi mtshan nyid 'dod dam ci/ /'on te rigs dang 'byel dang ldan/ /blo nyid kyi ni gzugs brnyan na/ /don gcig la yang sngar bstan pa'i/ /skyon de rnams dang ldan pa yi/ /rtogs par bya ba'i dbye ba yis/ /tha snyad du ni rnam rtog byed/ /ba lang nyid sgra'i dbye bas don/ /yod tsam rtogs de ②yin zhe na//rwa dang dbyibs dang sngo la sogs/ /bye brag mi rtogs de 'dod na/ /de dang ldan 'dod bye brag rnams/ /brjod par gyur pa sneyin na ni/ /der 'byung skyon dag yod min nam/ /yod don can gzhan mthong ④min no/ /bsdus par brjod pa yin na yang / /dka' thub bya ba rigs sogs rnams/ /ma lus mngon par brjod pa'i phyir/ /rigs kyi dbye bar gsal brjod yin/ /nges par ma bzung gzugs rnams kyi/ /rdzas sogs rnams su gang 'dod dang //107—83

gang zhig 'brel pa yod pa yi/ /spyi dang slar yang gsal ba yin/ /bye brag rigs sogs ngo bo yi/ /sgra yi don ni mi 'thad phyir/ /don dang gcig par bya ba yi/ /ngo bo'i sgra 'di mi rigs te/ /blo gnas brjod pa 'di nyid ni/ /phyi rol dag las tha dad phyir/ /de phyir blo la phyogs gzhan las/ /'di la bye brag ci zhig yod/ /blo yi rnam pa'i sgra don yang / /gong du gsal ba nyid kyis ①na| /shes la sdetha dad min pa yi/ /khyab byed nyid ni med pas so/ /so sor snang ba'i sgra don yang / /gal te phyi don yul yin na/ /gang phyir gcig bdag min phyi yi/ /ji ltar sna tshogs so sor snesnang / /'on te bag chags tsam dngos phyir/ /de ni yul med yin na yang / /phyi don rnams la shes pa yang / /ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur ba yin/ /gal te phyi don du nges pas /rang dngos la de rnams su 'dod/ /de ltar 'khrul pas 'jug pa'i phyir/ /sgra don de kho na nyid min/ /thams cad nyid la thal 'gyur phyir/ /sa bon med pa'ang mi rigs so/ /'di rnams phan tshun tha dad pa/ /sa bon zhe na phyogs bdag nyid/ /gal te'ang 'di rnams thams cad nyid/ /skad cig pa na rjes 'gro med/ /gzhan na shes pa rim gyis ④min/ /'di nyid kyis ⑤ni brjod 'dod pa'ang / /sgra las rtogs pa bsal ba ste/ /'di ltar sgra med med 'di la| /gang zhig brjod 'di rjogang zhig thob/ /phyi yi don la sgra 'jug pa/ /ji ltar sgra min pas brjod 'gyur/ /ming sogs de rnams kyis brjod yin/ /brjod 'dod rjes dpog rnam pa dang / / 'dres pa ⑦phyi yi dngos por ni/ /zhen pas 'di la 'jug ce na/ /de nyid kho bo 'dod pa'ang yin⑧/ /gzhan sel ba ni byed pa'i ⑨sgra/ /khyed kyi phyogs brjod ⑩ma yin nam/ /dgag pa 107—84

tsam yin snang 'di la/ /go bar byed pa ma yin gyi①/ /'on kyang ba lang ba men pa②/ /glang po shing sogs sgrub ⑧pa yang / /yang dag ngo bor nges pa yis//sgra can blo ni 'jug pa yin/ /gal te ba lang zhes bya'i sgra/ /gzhan gsal ④don ni byed pa ste/ /ba lang gsal ba'i sgra phyi ma/ /skyed byed sgra ni btsal dgos so/ /shes pa sgra 'bras ma yin nam/ /gcig la 'bras bu gnyis nyid ⑤de| /dgag dang sgrub pa'i shes pa dag /ji ltar gcig gi 'bras bu yin/ /ba lang sgra ni thos pa na/ /sngon du ba lang min zhes 'gyur/ /gang gis ba lang min dgag phyir/ /ba lang zhes bya'i sgra la 'jug /ba lang min las ldog pa'i spyi| /gang phyir brjod byar yongs brtags rjopas/ /de yis ba lang nyid dngos nyid/ /gzhan sel sgra yis gsal bar bstan/ /gang gis med pa thams cad ni/ /gzhan pa'i dngos po bdag nyid gnas/ /de las rta sogs ⑦las ldog pa'i/ /bdag nyid med pa gang yin pa/ /re zhig thun mong min bye brag /rtog min yin phyir mi 'dod na/ /khra bo sogs la'ang spyi min par/ /thal bar 'gyur phyir de bzhin no/ /de phyir dngos kun gang yin pa/ /so sor yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ /ba lang blo de'i rgyur 'gyur te/ /ba lang nyid las gzhan yod min/ /dgag pa tsam gyi ⑧ngo bo yang / /sgra yi don du rtog byed na/ /stong nyid gzhan gyi rnam pa can/ /med pa'i sgra yi brjod byar 'gyur//de la'ang rta sogs blo rnams kyi/ /bdag nyid cha shas 'dzin par 'gyur/ /der ni gzhan sel brjod bya nyid/ /brdzun pa nyid du khas len pa'o/ /ngo bo spyi ru 'gyur yin ⑨na/ /sgra don dag la mi ltos par/ /sel bar brtag ⑩pa brdzun pa min⑪/ /blo de'ang dngos po'i ngo bo ste/ /sgra'i don rnams la skye bas 107—85

na—/ /brjod bya dngos po nyid du brtag /blo ni sel ba min pa can/ /yod pa min pa phyi don la/ /so sor snang ba'i tshig don bzhin/ /de bzhin tshig don yang 'gyur na/ /ci phyir sel bar rtog par byed/ /blo gzhan pa la rnam gcod pas/ /blor rtogs pa ni ma yin te/ /rang gi ngo bor grub tsam las/ /gzhan pa'i cha ni 'dzin de min/ /gal te gzhan sel brjod bya na/ /tha dad spyi yi tshig rnams kyang / /thams cad rnam grangs pa ru gyur①/ /'dres dang gcig nyid sna tshogs nyid/ /rnam rtog dang bral bdag nyid can/ /dngos po min phyir sel rnams kyi/ /dbye ba yod na min pa nyid/ /gal te dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ /thun mong min dngos cha shas bzhin/ /dngos min sna tshogs min nyid phyir/ /rnam grangs pa las thar pa yin/ /gsal ②bar bya ba'i bye brag gis| /gal te tha dad par 'dod na/ /'di ni rang las bye brag min/ /gzhan las kyang ni brtags pa yin/ /'dres can rten tha dad pa yi/ /ngo bos phyi rol gnas pa yi/ /gsal bya gang yin de 'byed pa/ /de ni cher yang rtog pa yin/ /de bzhin rten ni tha dad pas/ /'di yang tha dad rigs ma yin / /'brel pa can ni tha dad pas/ /dngos po tha dad 'dod ma yin/ /'on kyang dngos dang ma 'dres pa/ /gang yin gzhan las sdog pa min①/ /bye brag cha ni ma thob par/ /ci yi phyir na nges pa min/ /'dra ba nyid du ma grub pa—/ /sel ba'i lus kyi bdag nyid du/ /shes par lus kyang nus min te/ /ba lang sogs su dbyer med phyir/ /rta sogs gsal bya med par yang / /chos gcig rjes 'jug dang bral ba④/ /nges par bya bar mi nus pa/ /des na sel ba mi grub ⑤po/ /rjes su 'jug pa dang bral na/ /sgra dang rtags dag 107—86

'jug ①ma yin/ /de dag med na sel ba'ang min/ /thun mong min pa'ang rjes 'jug min/ /sel ba yang ni ma grub na/ /lhan cig spyod pa gang na gsungs| /de la ma mthong ba de dag /tshad ma nyid du 'gyur ma yin/ /ma mthong ba tsam gyis de dag /rtogs par byed par 'gyur ba min/ /thams cad nyid la ma mthong phyir/ /rtogs byar bye brag 'gyur ma yin/ /'on te 'dra ba nyid med kyang / /sel bar rtog pa yin na ni/ /'di ni ba lang rta dag la/ /sel bar ci phyir rtog mi byed/ /khra bo las ni gzhan nyid du/ /ser skya dang ni rta dag mtshungs/ /spyi ni gzhan min 'dod ce na/ /ba min gang la sel ba 'jug /ba min sel ba'ang dbang po yis/ /dang por nges pa ma yin na / /gzhan la sgra ni 'jug min na/ /ci zhig mthong nas ②de sbyor byed/ /sngar bstan pa yi rnam pa yis/ /'di la rjes dpag kyang yod min/ /'di dang de ni 'byel pa dag /nyams myong bar yang rigs pa dag /ba lang min sgra brjod bya ba/ /nyid du ji ltar go bar bya/ /gang la ba lang sgras 'brel ba/ /nyams myong tshe na mthong ba min/ /ba lang ril ①po gcig nyid las/ /gang gzhan yin pa de thams cad/ /de bzhin gsal ba zhes byar brjod/ /spyi yi brjod byar mi 'gyur ro/ /grub kyang gsal bya blang dumin pa/ /ba lang dgag bdag nyid kyang de/ /dgag pa'i tshig gis gang 'gegs pa'i/ /ba lang de nyid 'dir smra dgos/ /ba lang min las log bdag de/ /zhe na gcig la gcig brten 'gyur/ /ba lang grub pas ⑤sel 'dod yin/ /zhe na sel bar rtog pa brdzun| /ba lang ma grub ba lang min/ /de med ba lang ga la yod/ /rten dang brten par gnas la sogs/ /'byel pa'ang med pa dag la min/ /thun 107—87

mong min pa ①dngos po ni/ /sel ba yis ni go bya min/ /dngos po dang ni dngos med la/ /'byel pa ji ltar brtag bya yin/ /rang gi ngo bo med tsam gyis / /cung zad bye brag byed 'gyur min/ /rang blo gang gis bye brag tu/ /gsal bar bya ste bye brag ste/ /rta ①sogs sgra rnams las byung ba'i/ /sel ba rtog ①byed ma yin no/ /'dir ni bye brag tu bya'i blo/ /bye brag ma gtogs la mi 'dod/ /gzhan gyi dngos las gzhan 'dra ba/ /byed min shes pa'i bye brag gi / /gzhan 'dra ba yi shes pa de/ /ji ltar bye brag tu brjod pa/ /'on te bye brag tu bya ba'ang / /gzhan la bye brag tu rtog na/ /de lta yin na gang cung zad / /thams cad bye brag tu thal 'gyur/ /med pa go bya'i ④ngo bo yis/ /dngos su bye brag bya ba med/ /de phyir sel bas bye brag tu/ /byas dngos khyed la brjod bya min/ /gal te sel ba ma gtogs par/ /sgra dang rtags dag 'jug rigs na/ /de bzhin shes pa po'i blo yang / /dngos po la ni dmigs par 'gyur/ /thun mong ma yin dngos po la/ /blo ni rnam gnas ma yin te/ /rnam rtog med pa nyid kyi phyir⑤/ /de ni go byar rigs ma yin/ /sgra yi go bya'ang bye brag tu/ /bya ba yin zhes bsgrub par dka'/ /des ni sgra dang blo dag nirjo/ /yul ni spyi yin par 'dod bya/ /gang tshe bsal ⑦ba rnams sgra yis//brjod bya min phyir bsal ⑧bya min/ /de tshe spyi ni gsal ⑨bya de/ /de na dngos nyid sel ba yang / /med pa rnams ni bsal bya min/ /med pa dor las med yin na/ /sel ba gzhan las sel ba ni/ /bsal phyir spyi ni dngos po yin/ / gal te ⑩med pa gang yin pa/ / med pa ⑪de dang mi 'dra na/ /dngos po nyid 'gyur min zhe na/ /ba lang ba lang min ⑫thal 'gyur/ /gal te'ang sgra 107—88

gzhan rnams la yang / /dngos su gsal ①bya nyid 'gyur na/ /yod sgra med par brjod pa las/ /tha dad bsal byar ②'dod pa min/ /de la med pa dngos nyid du/ /'gyur phyir ngal ba chen por 'gyur/ /de ma grub na yod mi 'grub| /grub na'ang rab tu 'grub dze+epar 'gyur/ /bag chags dbye bas phye ba yis| /yod pa'i dngos dang sel rnams su/ /rtog pa'i rigs pa ma yin te//dngos med nyid la bag chags med/ /khyed kyi sgra yi dbye ba yang / /de yi rgyu mtshan ma mthong ste/ /thun mong min sgra rjod ④byed nyid/ /ma yin sngar ma mthong phyir ro/ /de la sgra gzhan sel ba la/ /spyir ni kun du rtog byed na/ /de bzhin dngos med ngo bo'i phyir/ /sgra yi dbye ba brtag pa min/ /tshig rnams ji lta de bzhin du/ /brjod bya rjod byed dag kyang ngo / /gsal ⑤bya'i dbye ba tha dad pa/ /yod par ston pa'ang ma yin zhing / /sel ba go bya go byed du/ /khyed kyi phyogs la mi 'gyur te/ /dngos po min phyir nam mkha' yi/ /me tog ri bong rwa bzhin no/ /gal te char dang sprin med par/ /mthong bas ma nges par ༷smra na/ /kho bo'i phyogs la dngos yod nyid/ /khyed phyogs gal te'ang ga la yod/ /'ga' zhig sgra yi don sgrub pa'i/ /ngo bor khas len mi byed pa/ /de la ldog pa'ang grub min te/ /de ni de sngon 'gro phyir ro/ /gal te yang ni sel ba tsam/ /brjod bya nyid du khas len ni⑦/ /smra ba rnams la ut+pal sngo/ /sogs sgras sogs ⑧pa'i don du 'gyur/ /bye brag byed dang bye brag dag /gzhi mthun pa dag mi 'grub ste/ /sngon po nyid min zhig pa na/ /ut+pal min pa zhig pa min/ /cig shos kyang min de yi phyir/ /brjod bya la ni ltos min pa'i/ /sgra dag bye brag bya ba dang / /bye brag byed par 'gyur 107—89

ba'ang min/ /sel ba dag ni gzhi mthun las/ /ma yin tha dad yin phyir ro/ /don de las 'dod min zhe na/ /brten pa de dag ji lta bur/ /thun mong min pa'i dngos po ni/ /go bya min gzhan khyed la med/ /go bya min pa'i don gcig nyid/ /gang du sgra dag sbyor bar ①byed/ /'on te'ang gzhan sel ldan dngos po/ /brjod bya yin par smra ba na/ /de la'ang gzhan dbang yin pa'i phyir—/ /sgra yis khyab pa rnyed par dka'/ /rtags dang grangs sogs 'brel pa ni/ /sel ba la ni yod ma yin/ /gsal ba'ang brdar sdebya ma yin phyir/ /de'i sgo nas kyang de yod min/ /ak+ṣa ta yang gzhan las ni/ /log par kun tu shes pa med/ /ma yin par ni dgag bya ba'i/ /ngo bo de la yod ma yin//min pa min zhes smra ba yang / /dgag pa yang ni 'gegs pa ste/ /'tshod byed ces pa mi dgag pa'ang / /rang dngos nyid kyis gnas pa yin/ /bsgrub bya nyid du shes pa dang / /de bzhin byung gyur sogs mthong ba'ang sel ba grub 'dir yin pa'i phyir/ /rgyu mtshan med par thal bar 'gyur/ /sgrub pa la sogs don sogs kyang / /gzhan sel ba la mthong ①min pa/ /dgag ④pa la yang dgag yod na/ /sel ba ci 'drar 'gyur ba yin/ /dang la sogs pa'ang dgag pa dang / /sbyor ba med phyir sel ba yin⑤/ /ngag don las gzhan sel ba yang / /smra bar nus pa ma yin no/ /gzhan sel min pa sgra la sogs/ /brjod byar mthong ba ma yin no/ /gzhal bya shes bya sogs las rjoni/ /bsal bya nyid ni gang la yin/ /bsal bar ⑦bya 'di brtag 'di yang / /dngos po nyid brtag ④yin na bzang / /shes pa'i rnam pa bkag pas kyang / /nang gi don ni brjod bya min/ /sel ba'ang min phyir de rnams la/ /sel ba yang mi ⑨107—90

grub pa min/ /de ltar sgra rnams la sogs ni/ /bsal bya la ni mthong min no//thams cad sgra ni don gang gis/ /rnam par gcad ①byar rtog par byed/ /thams cad min par ②cung zad kyang / /med pas gang zhig bsal byar 'gyur/ /gcig sogs thams cad min zhe na/ /rang don sel bar thal bar 'gyur/ /cha shas rnams ni bkag phyir yang / /logs su cha shas can min 'dod/ /de bzhin bsdus pa'i sgra de rnams/ /bsdus pa can ni rnam bsal bas/ /gzhan rnams kun kyang mi 'dod pas/ /don med pa can thob par 'gyur/ /gnyis sogs sgra 'dir 'dod na yang / /yang dag bsdus nga/'i spyod yul can/ /gcig la sogs pa bkag pa na/ /de lta'i rnam pa der mi 'gyur/ /ba lang min min sel ba gang / /ba lang sgra yi ①don du brjod/ /de ci yod pa'am yang na med/ /yod na'ang ba 'am ba yin minarjo/ /ba lang zhe na ming rtsod min⑤//don du bsgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /go bya'i brjod bya'i a go nyid/ /yin na sgra'i dhidon shin tu mtshan⑦/ /med la 'di yang mi rigs te/ /don la sbyor ba ⑧sogs med phyir⑨/ /ba lang sgra las su zhig kyang ⑩/ /med par go ba ma yin no/ /ba lang sgra don ba min pa/ /min na ci ⑪phyir sel bar 'dod/ /gang gis ba lang ba min pa/ /bzhed cing gang gis gsal ⑫byar byed/ /ba lang sgra ni ba min pa'i/ /gang 'di'i sel don du smra na/ /de ci ba lang las gzhan pa'am/ /gzhan pa min par khas len byed/ /tha dad na'ang 'dir rten par ⑫ni/ /'gyur ba'am yang na mi rten 'gyur/ /rten ④pa yin na yon tan nyid/ /thob kyi rdzas kyi tshig ⑫yin no/ /de phyir ba lang zhes bya'i sgras/ /yon tan tsam zhig rjod byed pas/ /ba lang 'gro dang 'dug ces pa'i/ /gzhi 107—91

mthun pa nyid du mi 'gyur/ /gang gis ba min dgag 'di la/ /ba lang zhes bya'i sgra rjod ①byed/ /'on te 'di ni tha dad par/ /min las gzhan sel bar khyed 'dod/ /de phyir 'dis ni ba lang nyid/ /thob phyir lhag pa ci zhig smras/ /dngos po re re'i sel ba 'di/ /gcig pa'am yang na du mar 'gyur/ /gcig pa ba lang mang yod na/ /'di ni ba lang nyid du 'gyur/ /du ma nyid na'ang gong bu bzhin/ /mtha' yas par ni thal bar 'gyur/ /des na bye brag bzhin du 'di/ /brjod bya nyid du rigs pa min/ /gzhan sel ba 'am brjod bya'am ci / /brjod bya min par 'dod pa yin/ /brjod bya'ang bsgrub ①pa'i ngo bos sam—/ /yang na gzhan ni 'gegs pa yin/ /sgrub pa'i bdag nyid brjod bya na—/ /gcig tu lta ba btang ba yin/ /thams cad du yang gzhan sel 'di/ /sgra yi don ces smra ba na/ /gzhan sel min pa 'jig pa yis/ /gal ste gzhan sel brjod bya na/ /de la de bzhin du 'dod pas/ /thug pa med par khyed la 'gyur—/ /'on te gzhan sel ba 'di nyid/ /brjod bya min par khyed 'dod narka/ /des na khyed kyi gzhan sel byed/ /sgra yi tshig la gnod byed yin/ /gzhan yang gcig nyid rtag pa nyid/ /so so la ni 'du ba nyid/ /dngos med par brjod sel rnams la/ /smra ba snal med snam bu bzhin/ /de phyir sgra gang kho na la/ /dgag sbyor de la gzhan las ni/ /ldog pa'i cha ni 'ba' zhig 'gyur—/ /rang nyid gzhan du go byed yin/ /gzhan sel yongs su ma shes phyir / /de dag de lta'i lta ngan 'chang / /ngan pa'i bdag nyid rang nyid 'joms / /gzhan rnams kyang ni 'jigs ⑦par byed/ /'di ltar sel ba rnam gnyis te/ /ma yin dgag dang med pa'o/ /ma yin dgag pa'ang rnam 107—92

gnyis te/ /blo dang don gyi dbye bas so/ /gcig tu sre ①bar byed pa yinasde/ /gtan tshigs sngar smras gang yin rnams/ /'jigs med la sogs don mtshungs pa//rang bzhin gyis snegazhan las tha dad/ /der rten shes pa'i snang ba gang / /don gyi gzugs brnyan rtog pa can/ /don gyi bdag nyid min pa la/ /don zhes bya bar nges pa yin/ /snang ba gzhan las tha dad phyir/ /gzhan las log pa'i dngos po ni/ /thob pa'i rgyu las ma 'dres pa/ /dngos po'i sgo nas 'ongs pa ste/ /rigs mi mthun pa las sdog pa/ /de 'bras gang yin rang mtshan nyid/ /de la de yi bdag nyid du/ /nges phyir 'di ni 'khrul pa yin④/ /de la 'di ni gzhan sel zhes⑤/ /ming du bstan pa rgyur bcas pa'o/ /gzhan dang ma 'dres par yod rjopas/ /rang gi mtshan nyid kyang de'i rgyu/ /ba lang 'di la ba min med/ /med par dgag pa nyid yin zhes/ /gzhan sel ba 'di rab gsal ⑦ba/ /kho nar shes par bya ba yin/ /de la 'di ni dang po yin| /sel bar sgra las rtogs ⑧pa ste/ /sgra las yang dag byung ba'i blo/ /phyi yi don du zhen pa 'o/ /de yi ngo bo gzugs brnyan rmi/ /sgo ⑨ni sgra las skyes pa ⑩ste/ /brjod bya rjod byed dngos 'di ni/ /rgyu 'bras bdag nyid can grub pa'o/ /dngos kyi rnam pa gcig nyid la/ /de ltar rab tu bsgrubs pa yi/ /shugs kyis med par dgag pa yang / /rab tu rtogs par 'gyur ba yin⑩/ /de yi bdag nyid gzhan bdag nyid/ /min ⑫zhing 'byel yod dngos rnams ni/ /ldog pa'i dngos po rtogs pa yang / /don gyis go 'gyur de yi phyir/ /de nyid kyis na sgra 'di yang / /rang gi don du brtags pa yin/ /sgra 'di rnams kyis dngos su min/ /sel ba rnam pa gnyis brtan ⑫na/ /don gzhan rnam par 107—93

gcod par ni/ /byed pa sgrar ni brjod pa yin/ /rang don mngon par rjod byed pa/ /zhes bya de ni 'gal ba yin/ /phyi yi don du zhen pa yis/ /'jug pa gang las rnam rtog gi/ /gzugs brnyan 'di ni skyed byed pa/ /de yis brjod ces bstan pa yin/ /rang gi mtshan nyid kyi bdag nyid/ /dbyer med pa la 'di reg min/ /de tsam cha la sogs ①pa las/ /gzhan ni brjod par bya ba min/ /gzugs brnyan de ni rtogs pa yi/ /shugs kyis gzhan dang ma 'dres pa/ /'di ni rtogs 'gyur gang gi phyir/ /'di gzhan bdag ni min phyir ro/ /nyin mo'i bza' ba'i tshig sogs bzhin/ /'di yi 'bras bu'ang gnyis yin te/ /dngos su ba dang shugs kyis te/ /gang phyir rjes 'gro ldog par ldan/ /de phyir sgra ni dngos po rnams/ /rang don rjod par byed pa dang //gzhan las kyang ni ldog pa yang / /gnyis ka gtso bor byed ma yin/ /so sor snang ba'ang de 'dra ba/ /spyi de ba lang nyid du 'dod/ /ba lang khra bo sogs kun la/ /mtshungs pa nyid du nges phyir ro/ /dngos po'i snyam pa'i zhen pa las//de la dngos po zhes kyang brjod/ /shes pa de ni glo bur du/ /rang sa bon las 'khrul ba skye/ /de yi rnam pa de nyid kyi/ /sgra yi don khas len par brjod/ /spyi yi dngos po ngo bor yang / /de ltar 'khrul pas nges pa yin/ /spyi yi sdedangos po dngos nyid du/ /dam pa'i don du rigs ma yin/ /blo las tha dad min ngo bo/ /ji ltar don gzhan las 'ongs yin/ /gal te'ang tha dad min pa 'di/ /blo yi rnam pa'i ngo bo yin/ /de ltar phyi yi dngos nyid du/ /'khrul pas de ni nges pa yin/ /de ni don min mi ltos nyid/ /de ni brgyud pas 'ongs pa yin/ /des na bdag nyid dngos po nyid/ /yod nyid min par 107—94

bstan pa yin/ /gzugs brnyan bdag nyid can sel ba/ /tshig las kyang ni skyes pa ste/ /so sor snang brjod glo bur bzhin/ /kho bo cag la tshig don 'di//rang gi ngo bor grub tsam las/ /gzhan gyi cha ni de 'dzin yin/ /blo gzhan rnam par gcod byed pa/ /des na blo ni shes byas te/ /ji ltar yod pa min pa nyid—/ /dam pa'i don du tha dad min/ /tha dad min pa'ang de bzhin zhes/ /gang gis rnam grangs nyid du 'gyur/ /tha dad min pa'ang gcig dngos nyid/ /dngos med la de ga la yod/ /don gcig nyid du rjod byed pas/ /rnam grangs pa ni thob par 'gyur/ /med pa'i ngo bo'ang gcig nyid du/ /rtog pas sprul ①pa ji bzhin du/ /tha dad pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de las rnam grangs ga la yin/ /rjod byed la ni dngos su ba'i/ /rnam grangs gnyis min pa 'ang med//brjod bya'ang de rnams la med par/ /rnam pa du mar bstan pa yin/ /'on kyang du ma'ang bya ba gcig /gal te byed par mthong ba na/ /de la chos gcig tu sgo btags/ /sna gcig kyang ni 'jug pa yin/ /dper na mig sogs 'ga' zhig tu/ /gzugs kyi rnam shes gcig 'bras byed/ /gcig pa'i dngos nyid med na yang / /'ga' dag tsha sogs ②sgra gcig byed/ /bum sogs chu sogs 'dzin la sogs/ /bya ba gang yin byed pa na/ /yul de'i shes pa gang yin pa/ /gal te'ang tha dad pa de gnyis/ /gcig tu sre bar byed pa yi/ /chu nyid yin phyir gcig ces brjod/ /shes pa bzhin du'ang de yi rgyu/ /yin phyir don la dbye ba med/ /de la spyi yi tshig gis ni/ /bum pa la sogs brjod pa'i sgra/ /rigs mi 'dra ba rnams ①gcod pa/ /gzugs brnyan gcig gi rgyu rnams so/ /de bzhin gcig nyid don du ma'i/ /byed phyir 107—95

du ma zhes ①brjod de/ /de 'bras min pa las ldog pas/ /mang po nyid du yongs brtag ②pa'o/ /dper na thogs pa dang bcas gzugs/ /bstan du yod pa yin na yang / /dper na sgra ni brtsal ma thag /'byung ba'i shes dang mnyan bya yin/ /de rgyu min pa'i dbye ba yis/ /kha cig la sgra 'jug pa yin/ /dper na brtsal las 'byung sgra dang / /dper na sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi yang de 'bras rgyu dang bral ba las/ /kha cig la 'dir sgra zhes brjod/ /mnyan bya min dper gzugs bzhin dang / /ma brtsal bar 'byung glog bzhin no/ /de lta bu sogs dbye ba yis/ /tha dad don gyi rgyu mtshan ni/ /ldog pa rnams las brtag bya ste/ /de bzhin de la brten pa'i sgra/ /de bzhin brda nyid de yi phyir//ma 'dres don du brjod bya yin/ /sgra rnams tha dad par 'jug la/ /nga la rnam grangs 'gyur ma yin/ /mang dang nyung ba'i yul rnams kyisne/ /brda de yi ni rjes 'brangs nas/ /spyi dang bye brag gis brjod bya/ /de rnams la yang 'gal ba med/ /don de rnams kyi ldog pa rnams/ /rnam rtog bzo yis sprul pa ste④/ /rten dang bsal bya'i dbye ba yis/ /bye ba don dam par yod min/ /phyi yi dngos nyid de rnams ni/ /brtags ⑤pa yin gyi dngos su min/ /dbye dang dbye min dngos po la/ /de kho na nyid kyis gnas min/ /rang sa bon gyi du ma las/ /bral ba'i dngos po'i brda rnams kyis/ /nus pa'i rnam rtog gis dbye ba/ /de yi ngo bor nges pa yin/ /rang gi mtshan nyid bdag nyid don/ /gcig gi bdag nyid du min zhing / /dum bur byed pa'ang ma yin gyi/ /'di ni rnam rtog 'khrul pa 'o/ /chos gcig rjes 'gro med par yang bsal bya dang ni sel ba'i yul/ /mtshan nyid mi 'drar rtogs min pa/ /dbye ba med 107—96

par bsre bas so/ /gcig tu bsre ba shes pa ni/ /rang bzhin byis kyang tha dad pa'ang / /kha cig la ni sbyor ba yin/ /gzhan pa min zhes bsgrubs pa yin| /de min ngo bo las bzlog pa'i/ /dngos po tsam gyi rang mtshan nyid/ /gang yin des ni byas pa yi/ /rjes su 'gro ba 'gal ba med/ /gang na 'du ①ba min pa las/ /ldog pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid yod/ /de na me med las ldog pa| /rang gi mtshan nyid yod pa 'o/ /dper na tshang bang bzhin 'di la/ /du ba min las log yod pa/ /de phyir me min las ldog pa/ /'di ni yod par ②rang mtshan nyid/ /mi yi rwa sogs med pa las/ /ldog pa gang yin rang mtshan nyid/ /de kun bstan pa las kyang ldog /blo dang mar me lta bu 'o/ /de bzhin sgra sogs rang mtshan nyid/ /med pa'i ngo bo 'di yang snemin/ /de ltar dbye bas ma bstan pa/ /de ltar rjes 'gror 'gyur gnyis ༷yin/ /dbye ba brjod 'dod min pa yang / /de nyid ces ni yongs su bsgrags/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid nyid kyi ⑤ni/ /gzhan min min 'dod phyir yang ngo / /khra mo'i bu las tha dad par/ /ser skya'i bu dang rtar mtshungs na/ /myur rjo'agro yongs su dor nas ni/ /ba lang nyid la ci phyir 'jug /de gsal byed par nus bdag nyid/ /gal te de nyid yin 'dod na/ /bse ⑦bar mtshungs pa yin na yang / /nus pa de ni rta yi min/ /de lta bu yi bsres pa ⑧yang / /dngos po gang la yod gyur pa⑨/ /de la ba lang rigs med kyang / /ba lang min pa sel ba 'jug /ba lang min las ldog dngos gang / /de ni dbang pos nges par byed / /gzugs brnyan du ni nges pa ste/ /rang rig ⑩pas ni rtogs pa'ang yin| /'di mthong bas ni 'jig rten pa/ /de la sgra ni sbyor ⑪bar byed/ /107—97

'byel pa nyams su pyong bar ①la'ang / /des na 'di gsal byed par rigs/ /de lta bu yi bsre ba yang / /dngos po gang la med gyur pas/ /ba lang man ②sgra brjod bya nyid/ /de ni gsal bar rtogs byed yin/ /so so'i bsre ba shes pa yi①ske/ /ba lang ba lang min pa'ang 'grub/ /gcig pur grub pa'i sgra rjonyid ni//ji ltar 'dod bzhin de sbyor byed/ /dngos po'i dbye ba rig pa ni/ /gzhan 'dzin pa la ltos min par/ /de phyir gcig la gcig bstan ⑤pa'i/ /skyon ni 'di la gnas med do/ /phyi yi de nyid ma shes pa'ang / /rang bzhin nyid la rmongs phyir 'di/ /rang rnam pa la phyi'i ngo bor/ /sgra dang blo ni nges par byed//sgras ni de tsam du byed kyi/ /don la sgra ni reg pa'ang min/ /bye brag can gyi don ni 'ga'/ /sel bas brjod par bya ba min/ /don gzhan las ni ldog pa la/ /bye brag can ni yin zhes kyang / /mtshan nyid mdzad pas gang gsungs pa/ /de la brjod 'dod don 'di yin/ /gzhan la ①gzhan pa'i dngos gang yin/ /rgyu yis sam ni byed pa yis/ /bye brag can de tha dad pas//rigs dang ma 'dres par 'dres par/ /shing sogs sgra des brjod pa yis/ /shes ⑦pa de ni skyes pa las/ /rigs la sogs pa de 'gog byed/ /gang zhig blo la rnam gnas pa/ /de rnams 'dir brjod ⑧skyed byed phyir/ /ldog pa yi ni bye brag can/ /de rnams 'das ma thag bstan pa'o/ /don ⑨gzhan las ni ⑩ldog pa yis/ /dngos po de yi cha 'ga' ni/ /rtog ⑪pa yin zhes gang gsungs paske/ /de ni gzugs brnyan nyid yin te/ /don gzhan las ni ldog pa yi/ /dngos po mthong ba la brten nas/ /'ongs pa de la sgro btags nas/ /de yi cha zhes bstan pa yin/ /rgyu yi don dang byed pa'i don/ /des na sngar bzhin 107—98

bdag nyid kyang / /gal te dngos rigs mi 'dra las/ /ldog dang de dang de bzhin du/ /ba lang min las ldog gzhan nyid/ /de yang bdag nyid la yod de'o| /ldog par brjod pa'ang med pa nyid/ /'ba' zhig las ni ldog min te| /de ni bye brag dngos las kyang / /yin phyir dngos po'i blo mi nyams/ /dbye bar bye brag byed 'di yang / /rnam par rtog pas sprul pa ste/ /de phyir chos 'di nyer 'dzin pas/ /bye brag ldan zhing gzhag ①pa yin/ /des na de ni dbyeg sogs bzhin/ /bye brag byed par skye ba ste/ /so sor snang ba'i sgra yi donaske/ /de nyid sems pa pos bstan no④/ /mthong dang rnam rtog dbye mi shes/ /'jig rten phyi'o snyam du sems/ /de phyir 'di ni zhen pa las/ /gsal ba rnams ni brjod byar byed/ /de nyid don du sgra rnams kyi①/ /brjod bya min par bsgrubs zin to/ /'dis sgra'i brjod bya yin pa'i phyir/ /gsal ba rnams kyang bsal ④bya nyid/ /spyi ni sel ba ma ⑤yin te/ /sel ba nyid kyang dngos po min/ /med la med nyid bsal kyang zhes/ /de ltar byed min 'di dngos phyir/ /dngos ni de bdag min pa'i phyir/ /de ni bsal bya nyid 'dod gang / /gang zhig de yi bdag nyid min/ /de ni de yi bsal byar brjod/ /yod pa med pa'i dngos yin pas/ /de yi sel dngos duyod ma yin/ /rang bzhin dbang phyug sogs rnams kyi/ /dngos rnams bskyed bya min smra ba/ /rang bzhin dbang phyug sogs bskyed byar/ /dngos po grub pa ma yin no/ /de phyir med pa'ang dngos po nyid/ /min phyir ngal ba ga la yin/ /de grub na yang yod pa yod/ /des kyang med pa grub pa yin/ /ba lang min las ldog pa yi⑦/ /ba lang mtshan nyid mi 'drar 'dod/ /de phyir dngos nyid ba lang 'di/ /nga 107—99

la ba min thal 'gyur min/ /dngos med yul la'ang sems tsam gyis/ /sprul pa'i rnam rtog sna tshogs pa'i/ /dbye bas sbyar ba rnams la bzhin/ /bag chags yod pa nyid yin no/ /des na'ang bag chags dbye ba yis/ /bye ba'am yod pa'i dngos nyid du'ang / /rtog par byed cing sel ba rnams/ /rtogs ①pas sbyar ba rnams bzhin no/ /don gzhan sel ba'i brjod bya 'di/ /ji 'dra ba ni bstan zin cing / /sgra gzhan gyi ni sel ba yang / /de 'dra nyid du rtog ②bya min/ /dngos po nyid du nges pa'i phyir/ /sel ba dag ni dngos nyid min/ /kun rdzob lam du rab 'grub snephyir/ /de nyid don du 'dod bsgrub yin/ /dam pa'i don du brjod bya dang / /rjod byed cung zad kyang yod min/ /skad cig gis 'jig dngos rnams la/ /khyab par byed pa sbyor ba min/ /de la go bya go byed nyid/ /de nyid don la brten nas ni/ /sel ba dag gi dngos nyid min—/ /kun rdzob pa ni 'gegs she na/ /de lta na yang 'khrul pa nyid/ /bzlog par dka' ba thal bar 'gyur/ /rtogs ④pas sbyar ba'i don dang ni/ /de rjod byed pa'i sgra dag kyang / /de rnams la spyi brjod bya ⑤dang / /de yi rjod byed yod ma yin/ /sgra yi rang gi mtshan nyid ni/ /skad cig gis 'jig rjod byed min/ /de phyir de gnyis gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /kun rdzob par ni 'dod par bya/ /gsal bar dga' ba gnas pa yin/ /bsgrub pa'i ngo bo dhisgra yi don/ /gang gis khas len par mi byed/ /gang tshe sgra las shes pa ni/ /skyes pa'i don du zhen pa ste/ /sgra rnams rang brjod ⑦byed pa yidze+e/ /shugs kyis gzhan las ldog pa yin/ /de sngon 'gro ba can gyi ni/ /ldog pa 'di yang rigs pa yin/ /sgrub pa yod min gang gsungs pa/ /spyi la sogs pa med 107—100

phyir te/ /sgra rnams dang ni rnam rtog rnams/ /dngos su yul med nyid phyir ro//ut+pal sngon po sogs sgra las/ /gcig nyid kun du snang ba ste/ /sngo ①min ut+pal min sogs las/ /ldog pa yi ni gzugs brnyan no/ /gzhan sel ba dang ldan dngos po②/ /brjod byar kho bo cag 'dod de/ /gzhan las ldog pa'i dngos po las/ /gzhan pa'i ldog pa'i nga la med/ /de phyir rigs la ①sogs bzhin pa'i/ /gzhan dbang skyon dang 'azel pa med/ /blo gros bzang pos gsungs pa ni/ /sgra don log ④pa min pas ni/ /bye brag byed dang bye brag tu/ /bya ba bzhin mthun pa nyid de/ /de phyir sel ba sgra yi don/ /rnam par gnas pa 'gal ba med/ /sngon po'i sgra sogs 'ba' zhig kyang / /gzugs brnyan bye brag can yin te/ /khu byug ut+pal bung ba sogs/ /yid gnyis bcas bzhin 'jug pa ste/ /pi ⑤ka stang zil sogs sel bas bye brag can gyi yul la yang / /de ni ut+pa la yi sgrasaX/ /rnam par gzhag par nges pa dang / /gnas gzhi mthun pa la sogs pa/ /de ltar 'dir ni bsgrubs pas na/ /rnam gzhag de kun pha rol po'i/ /phyogs la bsgrub par dka' ba yin/ /'di ltar sgra gcig gis rang gis⑦/ /mtshan nyid thams cad du bstan la/ /de skad bstan pa de la yang / /ci phyir bye brag gzhan blo med| /gang gi don du phyi ma'i sgra/ /sbyor byed dngos po de la ni/ /thams cad du brjod min zhe na/ /de ni du mar thal bar 'gyur/ /sngon po'i rigs sam yon tan nam/ /sngon po'i sgra yis rtogs she na/ /gzhan la ut+pa la yi rigs/ /ut+pal sgra yis skenges pa yin/ /de ltar de dag dbye ba yis/ /ba kul ut+pal sgra bzhin du/ /gzhi mthun pa la sogs pa rnams/ /shin tu 'thad 107—101

pa ma yin no/ /yon tan de rigs dang 'byel pa'i/ /rdzas ni sngon po'i sgra rtogs pa/ /yin no zhe na de lta na/ /ut+pa la'i sgra don med 'gyur/ /de dag gang kho na dang 'brel/ /de nyid ut+pal rigs ldan na/ /sngon po'i sgra nyid kyis de ①bstan/ /ut+pa la'i sgra don med 'gyur/ /yon tan de'i rigs 'byel las gzhan/ /ut+pal rigs ldan yin zhe na/ /ut+pa la dang sngon po'i sgra/ /gnas ④gzhi tha dad par 'gyur ro/ /'on te ut+pa la nyid dang / /'azel pa'i ngo bo nyid dang ni/ /yon tan de'i rigs dang 'byel rdzas/ /sngon po'i sgra yis mi ston na'o/ /ut+pal dang 'byel ngo bo nyid/ /de bdag min par 'gyur na yang / /gang zhig ut+pal nyid 'brel ba/ /de gnyis dang 'brel kho na ste/ /sngon po'i sgra yis de brjod pa'i/ /sgra yi shes pa'i yul du ni/ /bdag nyid kun de cha shas min/ /ut+pal sgra de don med yin/ /cha shas las ni grol ba la/ /zad dang cha shas rnam rtog med/ /ngag don yongs su ma shes phyir/ /'dir ni 'di dag brjod 'dod yin/ /dang po'i sgra nyid kho na yis/ /de ni thams cad du gsal snebyas/ /bdag nyid ci yang ma dor bar/ /ji 'dra de 'drar de bstan te/ /rnam grangs de dag nyid kyis ni/ /de la sgra gzhan dag gis yang //brjod pa ④'bras bu yod min la/ /brjod na 'bras bu nyid du nges/ /kho bo cag ni sgra rnams kyis/ /phyi'i don rtogs byar mi 'dod de/ /sgra dang rnam ⑤shes dag gi yang / /yul ni phyi yi don min no/ /gang phyir de dag thams cad kyi / /bdag nyid yul byed las gzhan pa'i/ /sgra dang shes pa gzhan der ni//rnam grangs pa nyid thob par 'gyur/ /sgra las rnam rtog gzugs brnyan nyid/ /rim gyis skyed par byed pa yin/ /gcig nyid de ltar snang ba la/ /phyi yi nyid 107—102

du'ang 'khrul phyir ro/ /gzugs brnyan la ni brten nas su/ /gzhi mthun pa nyid sogs yin gyi/ /dam pa'i don du sgra 'di ni/ /yul dang bral bar 'dod pa yin/ /rtags dang grangs sogs sbyor ba 'di/ /gsal ①ba rnams la'ang yod ma yin/ /'dod pas sbyar ba'i brda dag gis/ /sprul pa yin gyi dngos la min/ /mo dang pho dang ma ning gi/ /rtags gsum dngos po la yod min—/ /de la sems de thams cad kyi/ /sna tshogs par snang nyid du 'gyur/ /brjod 'dod rjes 'jug nyid de rnams/ /de yi dbang gis gcig dngos ni/ /gcig dngos nyid du'ang dngos su min/ /gal te gnas pa dang skye dang / /'jig la brten nas rtags rnams ni/ /gnas pa yin na rtags gsum nyid/ /dbyer ②med par ni thal 'gyur zhing / /yod pa min la'ang med pa dang / /rang bzhin ①med dang gsob nyid ces/ /gang smra de la gnas pa sogs/ /'brel par ci phyir rtog par byed/ /dngos 'di rnams kyi skye ba ni/ /rab tu 'byung yin 'jig pa ni/ /nyams pa nyid de gnas pa ni/ /rang dngos grub par brjod bya ste④/ /de la skye ba 'jig min pa/ /de la ci yi byed par ⑤brjod / /gnas la 'dres pa rjoyod min na/ /de la skye bar ⑦ji ltar brjod/ /'jigs ⑧la gnyis yod brjod min na/ /'jigs ⑨pa'i dngos dang nyams pa dang / /zhig pa'i ngo bo zhes bya ba/ /de la ji ltar ston par byed/ /gnas dang gnas la ⑩rang bzhin du'ang / /rgyu gang gis na smra bar byed/ /'on te 'di rnams dbyer med dngos/ /kho na yin na rtags gcig 'gyur/ /gal te de rnams ba lang nyid/ /sogs bzhin ma gtogs ⑪sogs 'dod na/ /spyi bsal bas ni de 'dra ba/ /de rnams bsal ba kho na yin/ /rigs dang yod 107—103
