byung nyid sogs la'ang / /dngos po ji ltar yin dpyad bya/ /bsal ①las gzhan pa'am gzhan nyid min/ /tha dad tha mi dad gsal dpyad/ /de la thun mong ming ma grub/ /mthun phyogs bsgrub par bya dang bral/ /smra ba po la ltos nas ni/ /rnam par brtags 3pa'i rjes 'brangs brjod/ /brtsal ①ma thag byung shes pa ni/ /byas dang mi rtag sgrub pa gang / /skad cig ma ni ldog pa yis/ /so sor brtags dang ma brtags pa'i/ /'gog dang nam mkha' dang gsum pos//de ni ma nges pa nyid yin/ /blo ni sngon song 'jig pa la/ /so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa'i blo/ /blo ni sngon du ma song ba'i/ /'gog pa so sor ma brtags yin/ /'jig nyid phyir na de dag gnyis/ /ma byas par yang mthong ba yin/ /rang bzhin gyis grub 'jigs jepa yis/ /rgyu med ces ni de dag smra//me dang 'byel pas shing las ni/ /sol ba'i rgyun rngu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin las 'byung 'jig pa ni/ /skyes ma thag pa tsam du gnas/ /phra zhing 'dra ba'i rgyun 'jug phyir/ /nye bar mtshon par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang tshe mi mthun pa yi rgyusabye / /'dra ba'i rgyun la bsnun pa na/ /mi mthun pa yi 'bras bu yis/ /de tshe rags par mngon gsal 'gyur/ /des na rgyu las mi mthun rgyun/ /gang phyir skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de nyid kyis ni ma byas na'ang / /'jig pa nges par gsal bar 'gyur/ /de ni tho bas bsnun sogs pa'i / /brtsal thum thag tu 'byung ba yin/ /gang phyir ma byas par ni snang / /des na gtan tshigs 'khrul pa yin/ /nam mkha' yang ni rtag yin na/ /gang tshe sa dang chus gang ba/ /sa brkos chu ni 'chu sogs kyis/ /de bsal nas rjoni gsal kyibar 'gyur/ /de tshe brtsal ⑫ma thag byung zhes/ /de la yang ni snang 107—208

bar 'gyur/ /de phyir der shes gang brjod pa/ /gtan tshigs ma nges pa nyid yin—/ /'dir mthun phyogs kyang brtags kyibya ste/ /thos pa'i don ni bsgrub bya med/ /gsal ba'i mtshan nyid phyogs yin yang / /rigs dang gzhan nyid gzhan min dpyad/ /gzhan yin byechos can bdag ma grub/ /de nyid chos can gzhan ma grub/ /khyad par med na mi rtag dang / /rtag dngos de dag la mi 'grub/ /'di la rigs zhes kha cig brtag /cig shos 'jig pa ru ni 'dod//'dres pa'i ngo bo gcig yin zhes/ /dngos po sngar ni bstan zin to/ /de ltar mi rtag la dpyad bya/ /'jigs grupa bdag cag bsgrub ④byas stong / /gzhan yin pyekhyed cag bsgrub byas stong / /de ni sun dbyung tshig gi phyogs/ /gal te tshig dang don 'brel na/ /rtag pa nyid du bsgrub byas kyang / /ngag gi don la rig byed ni/ /tshad ma nyid du grub mi 'gyur/ /skyes bu rnams la brda yis ni/ /yon tan 'phel la sogs pa 4/bzhin/ /rgyu med kyang ni mchod sbyin pas / /med pa'i don ni yongs brtags yin/ /gzhan yang tshogs pa can phyir te/ /skyes bu las byung gtam bzhin no/ /'dir ni yid ches skyes bu med//des 3na rig byed tshad ma min bye / /'brel pa byar mi 'dod pa yis/ /rigs las ngag kyang rtag ⑨par brjod/ /gang gis mthong don tha snyad phyir/ /brda las byung ba'i shes pa ni/ /'phel sogs las ni srid pa yin/ /rig byed la ⑩ ni mi 'thad do/ /mtho ris mchod sbyin sogs 'byel ba/ /dbang po las 'das su yis ⑪ mthong / /de yang don byed ⑪ma yin te/ /de yi don shes 'byung ba'i phyir/ /tshogs pa can gyi sgrub pa la11/ /'di 'dra'i mi mthun bsgrub brjod bya/ /rig byed 'don pa thams cad ni/ /bla ma'i 'don pa sngon 707—209

song yin/ /rig byed 'don pa brjod nyid phyir/ /de ltar 'don pa ji bzhin no / /bha ra ta yang de ltar 'gyur/ /byed por ①dran pas gnod par 'gyur/ /rig byed po ni dran med de/ /gang de don gzhan brjod rgyu mtshan/ /'das dang ma 'ongs dus dag ni/ /rig byed byed po dang bral ba/ /dus nyid phyir na 'di ltar de/ /de ltar snang ba'i dus bzhin no/ /rig byed la ni tshangs la sogs / /byed po min par rtogs par gyis/ /skyes bu nyid sogs gtan tshigs kyis/ /dper na tha mal mi bzhin no/ /des na rig byed kyi 3ni tshig /brdzun min par ni shes par gyis/ /rang don smra po ma ltos phyir/ /tshig don la ni tshig blo bzhin/ /de byas shes pa yang dag yin/ /rtag pa'i ngag las byung nyid phyir/ /de yang ngag gis blo bzhin rtag /rtag pa nyid du gyur ④pas so—/ /bskul ba las ni byung ba'i blo/ /tshad ma yin te skyon bral ba'i/ /rgyu rnams kyis ni bskyed byas phyir/ /rtag yid ches sogs dbang blo bzhin/ /de bzhin yid mi ches smras pa'i/ /ngag gis skyes thuphyir yul dus sogs/ /dbye sogs la ni gnod med phyir/ /yid ches ngag byung shes pa bzhin/ /rig byed tshad mar gnas pas rgyan/ /slob dpon slob ma'i brgyud pa yi/ /thog ma med nas brtags pa yang / /skyon med nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /des na 'jig rten kun mig gcig /rig byed 'dra ba snang ⑥ba la/ /gzhan dag 'ug pa bzhin du ni/ /ma mthong chos min las skyes lo/ /gnyis skyes las ni de kun ni / / log pa tsong rgyal kyis spros yin/ /'dir ni srin bu'i ④yig 'drar yang / /de dag legs bshad cung zad med/ /byed po med pa yin na yang / /de ni bden don 'gro ba yin/ /de rgyu yon tan bral ba'i phyir/ /skyon med pa 107—210

yis brdzun don bzhin/ /skyes bu yis ni byas pa la/ /yon tan yod ces dogs par 'gyur/ /rig byed byed po med pa'i phyir/ /bdag la yon tan yod dogs ①med/ /des na bden dang log don nyid/ /rgyu rnams mi la rten ⑤pa'i phyir/ /shes rab snying brtse med la sogs/ /med phyir de gnyis ④yod pa min④—/ /des na don med 'thob khru'agyur te/ /khur ba drug sogs ngag bzhin no/ /gal te bya ba byed dang ldan/ /don rnams rtogs ⑥par 'gyur zhe na / /de ni rang bzhin gyis don dang / /ldan pa min yang khyed la ni/ /rtogs pa der 'gyur skyes bu yi⑦/ /bshad pas lha mi'i bshad sogs bzhin/ /skyon med na yang bden pa'i don/ /grub min gzhan yang yod pa'i phyir/ /gang phyir don med ces bya ba/ /phung po gzhan yang yod pa min/ /'on te rig byed rang nyid kyis/ /mi rnams la ltos med pa can/ /bden don rnam shes skyed nus yin/ /des na 'di yi ④bden don 'dod/ /de ltar lkun ni bar med par/ /shes pa de ni brtag 'byung 'gyur/ /rgyu ni rtag tu gnas nyid phyir/ /dper na mngon 'dod skad cig la/ /yang na rnam shes gcig pu la—/ /de skyes ma lus 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgyu ni nus pa can yod phyir/ /rig byed 'di ni mi rtag 'gyur/ /nus pa slar yang blo 'byung ⑫'gyur/ /'on te lhan cig byed pa ni/ /bshad sogs la ni ltos pa na/ /de dag la ni rim yod pas/ /rnam shes de yang rim ldan 'dod/ /de lta min zhes nus de la/ /ltos pa ci 'dra ba 'byung 'gyur/ /gal te de ldan de nus na/ /khyed la rtag ste 'di gang gis/ /gal te sngar ni nus med pa'ang / /des dag gis ni nus ldan byas/ /khyed la skyes bus byas thal 'gyur/ /shes pa'i yan lag skyes rten 107—211

phyir / /ji nyusrid skyes bu rnams kyis te/ /mar me ④'gyur bas gsal byas min / /de srid rig byed du ṣ+peganas pas/ /khyed la shes pa skyed byed min/ /gang phyir shes pa de yi rgyu/ /skyes bu'i shes pa las 'byung ④'gyur/ /des na skyes bus ma byas nyid/ /yang dag don shes rgyun mi rtag /skyes bus ma byas pa nyid de/ /rig byed la yod kyang don med/ /'di yi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu gang / /de shes skyes bu la brten 'byung / /gal te rtag tu nus na 'dir/ /ci ste gzhan la ltos pa yin/ /des na khyed la nus rgyu gcig /yod kyang shes pa nyid 'byung 'gyur/ /'dir ni rang dgar skyes bu rnams/ /rig byed ji gar 'chad byed na/ /de dag rnams ni dgag pa ru/ /su zhig gis ni nus pa yin / /des na gti mug nga rgyal sogs/ /skyon gyis 'di dag bslad pa yin//thos pa phyin ci log bshad pa/ /byed ces dgos par 'gyur ba yin/ /de dag dbang po las pe'adas pa/ /mthong ba'i mi gcig kyang 'dod min/ /bsgul ba ma ltos mtho ris dang / /mchod sbyin sogs 'byel shes nyid med/ /gang phyir dbang po las 'das don/ /khyed kyis dngos su mthong 'dod min/ /rtag pa'i tshig gis gang mthong ba/ /de ni mthong bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gang gis rig byed mi la ni/ /ma ltos rang nyid don brjod min/ /long ba 'khar ba thogs gyepa ltar/ /skyes bu'i bshad pa la ltos yin/ /de ni de yis drangs gyur na/ /lam log par ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /des na rig byed snang bzhin du//mig gcig 'gyur ba 'thad pa min/ /rang dgar shes pa skyed na yang / /tshad ma nyid du gsal ba ru/ /'di nyid la ni mi srid de/ /skyes bu la ni ltos phyir ro/ /ji bzhin don rtogs rgyu nyid de⑦/ /tshad ma nyid du brtags pa yin/ /107—212

skyes bu'i bshad pa la ltos pas/ /'di la tshad mas brtags legs min/ /rig byed tshad mar mi gnas pas/ /slob dpon slob ma'i brgyud pa 'di/ /thog ma med par brtag ①bya ba'ang / /skyon med nyid du rigs ①pa min/ /gang phyir de na gcig kyang ni/ /dbang po las 'das mthong 'dod min/ /de phyir thog ma med pa yi/ /dmus long brgyud pa bstan pa yin/ /long bas long ba khrid pa na/ /yang dag lam ni nges rtogs min/ /de lta min pas 'di la ni/ /thog med brtags pa 'bras med yin/ /yid dang rgyas pa la sogs kyang / /gzhan las rig byed de nyid shes/ /de dag gis don 'di bkod min//zhes pa 'di la tshad ma'ang med/ /bden don rtag pa'i 'byel can gyis/ /tshad ma nyid ni yin yang bla/ /dbang po las 'das spyor ba de/ /'dir ni 'ga' yis nges pa min/ /gang phyir don de dbang 'das pa/ /der gnas sbyor de'ang dbang po 'das/ /khyed la mi kun de dag gis/ /rang gis dbang po 'das mi mthong / /thos pa de yi bdag gi ni/ /don 'brel 'di yin zhes brjod min/ /skyes bus brtags pas don 'byel nyid/ /skyes bus byas pas tha dad min/ /de phyir ji ltar mis 1 byas pa/ /phyin ci log pa nyid du dogs/ /mi rnams kyis ni nyer btags 5la'ang / /de bzhin dgos ⑤der cis mi 'gyur//rig byed tshad mar gnas na yang / /slob dpon slob ma'i brgyud skyepa ni/ /thog ma med par brtags pa de/ /dmus long brgyud ⑦pa 'dra bar 'gyur/ /me la sbyin sreg sogs tshig gis/ /the tshom sogs med mtho ris la/ /mngon sum gyi ni blo bzhin du/ /mi g.yo blo skyes ma yin nam/ /rig byed kyis de byed pa na/ /ji ltar tshad ma nyid dmigs yin/ /gang phyir tshig des don de ni/ /107—213

'ga' zhig the tshom za rtogs yin/ /phyin ci log gang gzhan bzhin du/ /the tshom skyes phyir de bzhin min/ /rtogs pa dang ldan 'ga' zhig gis/ /de la bye brag mthong ba med/ /dbang po las 'das don la ni/ /yod med nges pa rigs pa min/ /gal te rig byed dag nges na/ /gzhan las gzhan 'dra ci ste min/ /dad pas dbang med blo can ni/ /gtsang sbra can rnams mi g.yo ba'i//blo nyid skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gzhan la ① gzhan dag la de mtshungs/ /'di ltar bde gshegs pa sogs la/ /mchod sbyin srog bcad rngudang ldan pas/ /ngan song sdug bsngal 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /blo ni mi g.yo skye bar 'gyur/ /khro 'di la ni 'ba' rngu zhig kyang / /gnod pa da ltar snang 'gyur min/ /gal te la lar res 'ga' dogs/ /rig ④byed ngag la'ang de dang mtshungs/ /gal te mi 'dod rag las pa/ /brda ni mi rtogs rig byed 'dis/ /rang gi ñtshadon ni gsal byed nirngo / /de tshe tshad ma nyid rigs yin/ /de tshe gti mug nga rgyal sogs / /skyon kyis bslad pa'i blo rnams kyis/ /gzhan du bshad par byas na yang / /rang gi don ni 'dor mi byed/ /gang phyir de yi yul can nyid/ /blo ni myur du skyed par byed/ /skyes bu rnams kyis 'dod pa yi/ /'di ni don gzhan gsal byed min/ /mi ⑦'dod la ni ltos pa na/ /skyes bus byas dang bye brag med/ /de la rag las gsal ba yin/ /de yang phyin ci log par 'byung //gzhan yang skyes bus ma byas la/ /ji ltar rang bzhin kyis bden don/ /'dod yin de bzhin brdzun nyid ni/ /ci ste dogs ①par byed pa min/ /bdag nyid kyis bden don rtogs pa'i/ /rgyu nyid yin pas 'di bden na/ /de ltar bdag nyid kyis log par/ /rtogs pa'i rgyur yang dogs par 'gyur/ /107—214

gzhan yang rig byed tshad ma ni/ /gang tshe khyed la gal che na/ /de tshe skyon med byed po sogs/ /nges par bsgrub ① la 'bad par gyis/ /skyon med pa yi byed pa pos/ /'di byas skyon med gsal byas kyis/ /gsal bar byas na 'jig rten 'dir/ /yang dag don shes sgrub byed yin/ /shes rab snying rje ②sogs ldan pa'i/ /skyes bus byas pa'i tshig dam pa/ /de ltar legs par nges byas na//ji bzhin don shes rgyu ru 'gyur/ /mis ni ma byas pa tsam gyis/ /ji bzhin don shes rgyu min te/ /nags kyi me la sogs pa ni/ /log pa'i shes pa'i rgyur yang mthong / /me yi snang ba yod pa na/ /mtsho skyes sngon po'ang dmar snang 'gyur / /gal te me sogs byas nyid kyis/ /de yi rgyu ru 'thad 'gyur na/ /don rnams kyis ni byas nyid kyis/ /log pa'i shes pa'i rgyu mtshan nam/ /de ltar du ba me la ni/ /ji bzhin gsal bar byed 'gyur min/ /de ltar rig byed ma byas pa/ /de kho na nyid shes pa yi/ /rgyu mtshan gnas pa ma yin pas/ /de phyir 'di brtags don med yin/ /des na skyes bus ma byas nyid/ /gsal dang rtag nyid kyis grub pa/ /sgra don 'byel pa brtag kyepa yang / /don med nyid du brjod pa yin/ /de ni yod pa na yang 'di/ /ji bzhin shes don rgyu nyid du/ /mi 'dod par ni 'das ma thag /rgyas pa ru ni bshad zin to/ /des na de nyid rab spong la/ /kho bo la ni cher mos med/ /gnas skabs nye bar mkho min la/ /su zhig gegs ni byed pa yin/ /thos pa de la ji bzhin don/ /shes pa'i rgyu nyid 'thad pa yin/ /skyes bus ma byas yin na yang / /de ni ma grub ces bsgrubs zin/ /phra ba'i blo yi mig can byi④/ /blo rnams lam gang la dpyod pa'i/ /de yis bdag gis brlabs nas ni/ /'dir spyoni cung zad 107—215

bsdus nas brjod/ /tshad ma rnams ni log na yang / /gzhal bya ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang phyir khyab dang byed 1rgyu nyid/ /de dag la ni der yod min/ /des na thos pa'i byed po ni/ /tshad ma lnga pos ma rtogs kyang / /byed po mi shes rab rju sogs bzhin/ /dngos med nyid kyis rtogs mi 'gyur/ /'on te don bcas nyid kyis sam/ /rnam par dbye don nyid kyis kyang / /de rnams kyi ni byed po dpog /ci ste thos pa'ang de bzhin min/ /sems can kun kyis ma rtogs nyid/ /the tshom za min de res kye'aga'/ /su zhig tshad ma 'ga' yis kyang / /rtog thu pa yin yang the tshom 'gyur/ /srid gsum nang na gnas pa yi/ /srog chags thams cad gsal po ru/ /rnam pa kun gyis yongs shes gang / /des ni nges par byed 'di nus/ /rang nyid kyis ni ma rtogs nyid/ /'khrul pa yin zhes 'di lta bur/ /skyes bu gzhan gyis kun rtog gang / /de med par ni nges pa yin/ /rig byed la gdon khyepar byed na/ /byed po yin zhes mngon sum rtog /de dag gsal byed rigs yin te/ /rtag la gsal ba mi srid phyir/ /dmigs par gyur pa'i rang ngo bo/ /de yi bya bas yang dag byung bya / /de dag sngar yang yod pa na/ /dmigs pa yod par thal bar 'gyur/ /rig byed de yi 'bras bu ni/ /tha snyad sogs su rung bar nges/ /de yi bya bas 'di yod phyir / /sa bon las ni myug sogs bzhin/ /gsal byed yi ge'i dngos yod phyir / /zlos gar gyi ni gtam klusogs bzhin/ /skyes bus byas nyid rig byed la—/ /rjes su dpag pas kyang rtogs 'gyur/ /gzhan du rim dngos nyid min te/ /rtag nyid phyir dang khyab byed phyir/ /gsal bas byas pa'i rim yod min / /rtag las gsal ba mi 'thad phyir/ /lung dang nye bar 'jal ba dag /107—216

don gyis go la tshad nyid de/ /dgag par byas yin de na yang / /'di dag nyer dgod rigs pa ①min/ /tshad ma nyid min pyaldog pa'i phyir/ /rigs rjubyed skyes bus ma byas nyid/ /gang 'dod de yang dngos nyid phyir/ /sgrub pa rnams kyis bsgrub bya min/ /de dag gis thos rang dbang yin/ /skyes bu'i bya ba mi ltos phyir/ /de yang dngos bo la yod chos/ /yang na dngos bdag nyid de bzhin/ /dngos po'i phyogs ni grub don du/ /sgrub pa gang yang brjod pa yin / /khyed la de ni gsal pyabyas kyang / /rang nyid dngos med grub 'gyur min / /de yod sgrub pa gsal byas nas/ /de yod nges par mi 'gyur ro/ /de yod pa ni ldog pa ni5/ /de tsam kyis ni nges yod min/ /tshad ma rnams ni log na yang / /don med par ni mi 'grub bo/ /des phyon gnyis ka la phyogs ni—/ /mi 'grub pa de ⑦tsam du 'gyur/ /lus can min phyir sgra rtag min/ /bde sogs rnams kyis 'khrul phyir ro/ /de ltar brjod kyang ji bzhin sgra/ /'jig nyid rab tu mi 'grub bo/ /des shen snga phyi mtha' dag la/ /gzhan gyis sgrub pa gang brjod yin/ /de ni gsal bar byas na yang / /rig byed smra de'i don rtogs spumin/ /ma byas dang ni mi 'jigs pas/ /gal te rtag nyid 'dod pa ⑪na/ /bkag pa tsam gyi dngos dag gis⑫/ /nus med la yang de mtshungs yin/ /des na nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /des na ji ltar mkha'i pad ma/ /rtag pa nyid ni dngos min te/ /de bzhin rig byed la yang ni/ /des na tshad ma nyid grub min/ /byas pa nyid dang 'jig nyid ni/ /dgag par yang ni mi grub shābyebo/ /sgrub par byed pa sun phyung bas/ /des na rtag nyid smra mi 'grub/ /gal te ma yin dgag bdag nyid/ /de dag gis ni rtag 107—217

nyid 'dod/ /de dag dngos po'i bdag nyid kyis/ /rang gis ①grub pa la ltos yin/ /phyogs snga ma gnyis sun phyung bas/ /dngos po'i ngo bor rtag nyid gang / /de ni ② bsgrub par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid kyis te bsgrub ①'gyur min—/ /tshul gsum ngo bo nges pa ni/ /sgrub pa gang zhig rab gsal bubyas/ /khyod kyi phas kyang nam du yang / /de ni dgag par mi nus so/ /rig byed las ni skyes bu ni/ /mi 'jig par ni gang bshad pa/ /de la rjes su dpag pas gnod—/ /gsal bar bdag med bstan zin to/ /der ni rigs sogs gzhan smras pa'ang / /tshad mar gnod byar bsgrub byas zin/ /rjes su dpag pas skyede yang ni/ /'byel pa nges can sngar bshad zin/ /dngos po'i rjes 'byel pa'i de la/ /sgra tsam snying po med pas sam/ /yang na de las byung blo yis / /rmongs pa su zhig gnod snyam sems/ /skyes bu'i ngag las shes pa yang / /dbang po las 'das 'jug pa yin/ /de yang mngon sum dang mtshungs nyid/ /ci phyir spyod cag mngon 'dod min/ /'byel pa ma mthong ba yi phyir/ /dpe la ma ltos skyon med pa'ang / /de la yang yod kho na yin/ /skyes bu la brtan bye phyir 'di la/ /gnod pa yod par dogs she na/ /de ltar rig byed dag la yang / /dogs pa de yang ldog mi 'gyur/ /de ni log rtog rgyu nyid kyi/ /rang bzhin du ni 'gyur ba yin/ /mi ⑦byas sgra yi don rtogs kyang / /de ni bdag la tshad ma min/ /zhes bya de ltar zhe sdang gis/ /mkhas pas byed pa nus ma yin/ /des na dbang 'das las sgra kun/ /stobs dang stobs min mtshungs yin na/ /gcig nyid la ni rjes chags 'di/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis sbyor bar byed/ /'das ma thag brjod rigs sdepa ni/ /rig byed tshad ma min 107—218

pa'i rgyu/ /shes rab can rnams kyis gsungs pas/ /des na de dag bden smrar 'gyur/ /log par rjes chags las skyes pa'i/ /rig byed bsam pas rmongs byas pas/ /rig byed log pa nyid kyi rgyu/ /mi shes cung zad ngo mtshar med—/ /sog ①po par seg sogs rnams la/ /ma ①ni bag mar legs sogs pa'i—/ /de spyod rtag tu lhur len pa/ /de'i skyon cung zad mthong ba med/ /ngo shes mngon sum yin par ni/ /sngar ni bkag pa kho na yin/ /'khrul pa'i phyir dang rtogs bcas phyir/ /de yis rtag nyid nges 'gyur min/ /de thu ni ṣ+pe ru'i smra ba yin/ /ri skegs tshig tu 'di snang phyir/ /sgra yi shes pa mang du ni/ /ldog par 'gyur ba'i ngo bo yin/ /de ni gsal byed dbye zhe na/ /gsal ba spong ba 'chad par 'gyur/ /rig ④pa 'di nyid kyis khyed la/ /thams cad 'dir ni gcig nyid 'gyur/ /des na khyed la gsal byed dang / /gsal bar bya ba cung zad med/ /rnam dbye dang bral cig la ni/ /dbye bar brtags pa 'gal ba yin/ /sgra 'di dag ni skyes bus byas/ /'di dag skyes bus ma byas zhes/ /de yi rnam par gzhag pa yang / /ngo shes rjes 'brang 3/byed grub min / /gsal byed rim pa gnas pa'i phyir/ /'ga' zhig rim pa nyid du gnas—/ /rim pa nges par sbyor ba can/ /de dag skyes bus ma byas 'dod/ /rkan 3 sogs gsal byed rim pa ni/ /skyes bus byas chos 'di min nam/ /de ni 'dod la rag las phyir/ /phyin ci log tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /me nyid la sogs spyi nyid ni/ /rgyas pa ru ni gsal skyebyas zin/ /des na der ni ngo shes pa'i—/ /spyi nyid rtag par kho bos 'dod/ /skad cig re rer 'jigs khru'agyur bas—/ /yi ge rnams la khyad med phyir/ /ngo shes spyi yis gang nyid ni/ /de 107—219

bzhin du ni yin zad mod/ /myur dang dal sogs cha gang la/ /tha dad blo ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de la ngo shes pa'i shes pa/ /tha dad blos ①ni nges byas min / /sgra gcig nyid ni grub don du/ /gtan tshigs rnams ni smras pa la/ /mi mthun phyogs la 'gal med phyir/ /so sor 'byel grub mi 'gyur ro/ /du ma'i spyi yi byecha yang ni/ /bdag la brtan par grub pa min/ /de min ngo bo las ldog pa/ /dngos po tsam ni bsgrubs pa yin/ /gang sogs gcig nyid thob gyur na/ /rigs rten 'dod pas grub pa sgrub/ /de min ngo bo yongs ldog rngupas/ /dbyer med nyid du brtags pa yin/ /gsal ba gcig tu nyid 'gyur na/ /tshad ma kun gyis gnod par 'gyur/ /dbang po las byung sogs rnams kyis/ /so sor sbyor yig dbye nges phyir/ /yid 'ong yid mi 'ong ④sogs kyi/ /dbye gang mngon sum gyis rtogs 'gyur/ /blo rnams rim par 'byung ba'i phyir/ /tha dad 'grub 'gyur myur sogs bzhin/ /yul dang dus sogs tha dad pa'i/ /ba lang sgra gsal blo rnams kyi/ /don gcig pa min tha dad par/ /snang phyir gzugs ro sogs blo bzhin/ /drug snang la sogs dbye snang bar/ /mngon sum gyis ni nges par 'gyur/ /gsal byed kyi rgyachos 'di min te/ /zhes bya deng ⑥ni brjod par 'gyur/ /snga de phyi re'i thuzhag la ni/ /ba lang sgra zhes kun 'di dag /don gcig pa min rim 'byung phyir/ /sgra dang dri sogs pa'i blo bzhin/ /de lta min na blo kun ni/ /dmigs pa gcig tu 'gyur ba yin/ /nus ldan rgyu ni nyer 'u gnas phyir/ /rim gyis 'byung ba'ang 'gal ba yin/ /dngos po rnams ni tha dad kyang / /rang bzhin nyid kyis gcig rtogs pa'i/ /nus pa nges par yod min te/ /sngar ni rab tu bstan 107—220

zin to①/ /gcig tu rtogs pa de las ④ni/ /sgra ni gcig tu nges byed pa/ /'jig rten pas ni sgra gcig la/ /sbyor ba mang po snyam du sems/ /gsal ba du ma la gnas phyir/ /'byel pa 'thad par 'gyur ba yin/ /de phyir gsal ba rnams la ni/ /'jig rten thams cad pa nyid 'gyur/ /sgra don lhan cig don dam par/ /'byel pa yod min de las ni/ /ma skyes phyir dang tha dad phyir—/ /des na 'khrul pas nye bar brtags/ /khyab min srid phyir sgra don gyi//gnas pa kun ni bslad pa yin/ /'di ltar de ni rgyas pa ru/ /sngar ni bstan par byas zin to/ /ba lang nyid ni rtag pa dang / /'byel par brtags pa'ang spangs pa yin/ /rdul phran mkha' sogs kyang spangs nas3/ /des na gtan tshigs kyi dpe min/ /ngo bo gcig nyid 'khrul pa yi④/ /shes pa rnams kyis nges byas phyir/ /dmigs bkar ba lang 3nyid brjod nyid/ / yun ring bye nas ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /yang dag skad cig ma nyid phyir/ /de hūṃtsam dus 'di brten min yang / /shes bya de yi brten pa ni/ /phyis ni ji ltar yang 'dod yin/ /bum sogs la yang cung zad ni/ /'jig pa'i rgyu ni yod pa min//zhes bya 'di la (snyebastan zin to/ /de ci sgra la 'byung 'gyur yin/ /ngo shes pa ni bslad ⑨pa ru/ /sngar ni rab tu bstan zin pas/ /yul dus sbyor ba po rnams kyi/ /dbye bas yi ge'ang dbye bar 'gyur/ /drug ldan drang srong sa 'dzin dang / /lnga pa la sogs rab dbye bas/ /ga yi gsal ba /⑩gzhan gsal bar—/ /mngon sum gyis ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /gsal bar byed pa'i dbye ba yis/ /dbye ba'i gnas pa 'di rigs min/ /rtag pa la ni gsal yod min//zhes bya 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur/ /ga las tha dad pa yi spyi/ /yang dag 107—221

par ga nyid 'dod min/ /de yi phyir ni sbyor ba la/ /grub pa la sgrub bzlog par dka'/ /gzhan sel bdag nyid can la yang / /ga nyid la ni rten yod min / /rnam pa 'di nyid kyis zhe na/ /de min rten mi 'grub thob 'gyur/ /yi ge ga min las ldog pas/ /ga yig ①rnam pa nyid du 'gyur/ /chos can gang la chos yin no/ /yang dag par ni rjes dpag kun/ /gnyis ka la grub la ltos yin/ /dpe sogs rang nyid la ltos pa/ /des dpe'i chos can ma grub 'gyur/ / khyed kyi ④'bad pa 'di kun gyis④/ /ga yig gcig nyid bsgrub don du/ /de la khyed la mngon sum gyis/ /gnod pa bzlog par dka' ba'ang smras/ /snga de phyi de la sogs pa'i/ /yi ge ga zhes 'di dag ni/ /rim gyis 'byung bas don gcig min/ /gzugs dang ro sogs blo bzhin no/ /des na yi ge gcig brtan par/ /gnas pa gnyis ka la mi 'grub/ /de'i phyir nyer btags nyid 'di la/ /rtag pa nyid ni brtags ④ pa yin/ /sgra ni dmigs pa'i dus su ni/ /rna ba legs par byas pa dang / /sna phyebug mtha' la gnas gyur pa'i/ /rlung rnams rtogs par 'gyur ba min/ /sgra tsam legs byas rna ba yis/ /gang tshe sgra ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /de dang nyer bsres de yis ni/ /rtogs la mngon sum gyis gnod 'gyur/ /mngar ba la sogs la 'jug pa/ /kha dang ser po'i ngo bo ④yis/ /ji ltar shes pa yul med pa/ /de bzhin sgra yang shes par 'gyur/ /myur dang dal sogs ngo bo yis/ /gzhan pa'i sgra ni snang mi 'gyur/ /de min ngo bo de dngos nyid/ /shes phyir ji ltar yul med min/ /de ltar min na don de nyid/ /rtogs par byed pa de 'gal 'dod / /rnam pa gzhan ni rig pa na/ /don de nyid ni ji ltar rig /rnam 107—222

pa med pa'i shes pa la/ /khyed la phyi'i don rnams ①de nges/ /de yi bdag nyid phyi rol min/ /de bzhin du de ji bzhin pyarig /shes pa rnam bcas phyogs la yang / /phyi rol rnam pa rjes mthun par/ /shes pa la ni snang gyur pas—/ /don rtogs zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /'dir ni phyi rol rjes mthun par / /shes pa 'jug par mi 'gyur te/ /des na yul med pa yi sems/ /thams cad 'khrul pa yin zhes gdags/ /rtag pa la ni khyad par du/ /gsal byed yod pa rig pa min/ /de yi legs byas rjes mthun pas/ /des sgra la blo tha dad min/ /bum pa la sogs gzung ldudon du/ /ji ltar mig la mar me yirngu//nus pa skyed byed de bzhin du/ /sgra dmigs phyir ni sgra tsam kyis/ /rna ba la ni nus pa bskyed/ /sgra ni rtag tu dmigs rung bar/ /rang bzhin gyis ni gnas she na ⑤/ /rna ba legs par ma byas kyang / /de ni ci yi phyir mi dmigs—/ /de phyir legs byas rna ba ni/ /yod pa'i dus bzhin de yang ni/ /rung ba'i rgyu ni yod pas na/ /dmigs pa kho na yod par 'gyur/ //gal te de dmigs rung min na/ /phyogs kyang de ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /'gyur na rte rung ba nyid ldan pa'i/ /sgra gzhan skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /yang na phyis kyang shes pa ni—/ /de yi stobs las byung ba min/ /legs byas rna ba la sogs las/ /de ni skye bar brjod pa yin/ /de ltar sgra ni shes bya ru/ /mi 'gyur nye bar mkho min phyir/ /ro sogs las ni de la ni/ /khyad par cung zad kyang yod min—/ /legs byas rna ba la sogs las/ /sgra la ltos med de dag gis/ /shes pa 'di ni sgra rtogs pa'i/ /rang bzhin zhes bya bskyed pa yin/ /don shes shes bya'i ngo bo 'di/ /de lta na yang sgra 'jug 'gyur/ /khyed la de yi rnam 107—223

shes kyang / /zhes bya rjes su 'jug par 'gyur/ /de lta min na rnam shes ni/ /rjes 'jug ma yin de shes bya/ /sgra de rjes su 'jug 'gyur zhes/ /khyed la de ltar 'gal bar 'gyur/ /shes dang shes bya'i rang bzhin ni/ /de dag lu gu rgyud bzhin 'byel/ /gcig yod pa na gnyis pa'i ni/ /thob 'gyur ma 'khrul pa yi phyir/ /legs byas rna bas bskyed pa yi/ /shes dang 'brel nyid yin na ni / /rna ba legs par ma byas kyang / /gsal bar shes pa 'phel bar ①'gyur / /gal te de yi shes bya yi/ /bdag nyid sgra — min zhe na/ /de lta na ni rna ba'i shes/ /de rtog rang bzhin 'gyur min te/ /de dag 1nyid min ro sogs bzhin/ /shes pa la ni sgra dang ni/ /'brel pa gang yod gang gis na/ /de ni sgra blo'i ngo bor 'dod/ /de dag snenyid ni dbye ldan min/ /de ni de las byung min te/ /sgra ni skyed byed nyid min phyir/ /de las byung ba'i nges pa'i phyir/ /de ni gtan du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de lta na de'i yul can shes/ /rtag tu 'byung ba'am yang na min/ /de ltar nges par gnas pas bram// //rna ba legs byas rtags don med/ /res 'ga' legs par byas pa ni/ /yod pa nyid na res 'ga' yang / /shes pa 'byung 'gyur zhes bya ba/ /legs byas brtags pa mdzes pa yin/ /legs byas nus pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /shes 'bras nges par byas she na/ /shes pa de yang rtag yod pa'am/ /yang na rtag tu med par 'gyur/ /rnam par shes pa res 'ga' ba⑤/ /de yi legs byas ji ltar ston/ /rna ba legs par byas phyir lan/ /de phyir de ⑥ni legs smras min//gal te tha mi dad pa yilju/ /nus pa rna ba la byed na/ /de tshe nam mkha' phyogs la no/ /rtag nyid nyams 'gyur bskyed pa'i phyir/ /dngos dang tha mi dad nyid 107—224

phyir—/ /legs par byas pa'ang rtag nyid yin/ /dngos po bzhin du de yis ni①—/ /de bskyed rnam shes rtag tu na/ /tha dad na ni de'i zhe na/ /'byel pa 'thad par mi 'gyur ro/ /nus pa las zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ /rna ba'i shes pa nyid kyang med/ /tha dad tha mi dad grol ba'i/ /phyogs ni spangs par byas zin to/ /des na rna ba legs byas phyir/ /lan ni blo dman brjod pa yin—/ /de nyid kyis ni yul dang ni/ /gnyis ka legs par byas pa bkag /de phyir rtag la gsal ba ni/ /thams cad du yang rten med yin/ /des na gsal ba la brten nas/ /ring thung rim pa sogs rnams ni/ /'ga' zhig gang dag snang gyur pa/ /de dag kun kyang rten med 'gyur/ /ma phrad tsam du mtshungs na yang / /thams cad gzung nyid mi 'gyur te/ /nus pa nges par gnas pa'i phyir/ /khab len gyis ni lcags la bzhin/ /gal te khab len 'od phrad 3pas/ /de yang drangs par gyur ce na/ /'o na 'od 'di ma mthong bas/ /ji ltar yod par rtogs hūṃ par 'gyur/ /ci phyir 'od de shing sogs dang / /phrad kyang 'dren par byed pa min/ /de nus nges nyid phyir zhe na/ /ma phrad pa la'ang de mtshungs yin/ /sbyor ba'i de ma thag tu ni/ /ring dang bar mar nyer gnas pas/ /rim pa med pas rtogs par 'gyur/ /thams cad la der shes skyed phyir/ /ring dang nye sogs dbye ba yis/ /gzugs ni gsal dang mi gsal bar/ /ji ltar snang 'gyur de bzhin du/ /sgra yang myur dang dal sogs 'gyur / /tha dad snang ba'i blo rnams ni/ /dmigs pa gcig par ji ltar 'gyur—/ /zhe na phyi rol don smra la/ /gzugs blo la de brgal brtag mtshungs//phrad nas 'dzin pa'i phyogs la yang / /rna ba'i nang du sgra'i sgra bzhin/ /107—225

'brug sgra la sogs shes pa ni/ /tha dad par ni 'gyur ba min/ /des na skyed byed phyir shes pa/ /tha dad min te yid bzhin no/ /gzhan du res byas ①la sogs bzhin/ /rna dang ma phrad byed 'gyur min/ /yid kyang phrad par byed pa yin / /gang brjod skad cig tsam gyis ni/ /shin tu ring ba'i don la ni/ /de dag gi sems 'jug mi 'thad/ /phyi rol dbang po nyid phyir sogs/ /phrad nas 'dzin byed nyid sgrub gang / /bsgrub bya'i chos mi mthun pa la/ /'gal ba med phyir de 'khrul yin/ /ldan pa dang ni rnam dbye ba/ /tha dad pa can sngar spangs zin/ /de nyid kyis ni khyad med phyir/ /'di la rtogs pa mi 'thad do/ /de phyir shugs med pas de ni/ /ji srid shugs ni gnas pa min/ /rna ba'i nam mkhar phyin pa yis/ /de ni rna nus byed ce na/ /ci phyir lcag gis bsnun pa bzhin/ /sgra rigs byepa na de shes min/ /gang tshe sgra'i zushes pas de yi / /rig pa so sor bkag ce na/ /lcag gis bsnun dang rlung gzhan bar/ /de tshe rigs 4pas brjod rigs min/ /rim gyis 'byung yang mgyogs pa na/ /cig car du ni 'khrul zhe na/ /cung zad min rnam pa khyakun du'ang / /rlung 'di ma dmigs pa yi phyir/ /'on kyang dbang po las 'das rlung / /gzegs zan sogs bzhin khyed cag kyang / /brjod na bshad pa las de yis/ /reg bya thob 'gyur ci phyir byas/ /yang na rlung ni kyedabang 'das bla/ /de dang de spyor thob 'gyur la/ /dro dang gang pedang gnyis ka yis/ /reg bya rig 'gyur gzhan gyi bzhin/ /'on kyang rna mchog la de dang / /mi 2 ldan pas na rtogs mi 'dod/ /rna ba'i nam mkhar ma phyin ces/ /de ni ji ltar rtogs par 'gyur//de phyir gtsang sbra can mthong ba'i/ /brtags pa rgyu mtshan med yin te/ /107—226

mkhas pa rnams ni tshim byed min/ /nam mkha' cha med rna gang brjod/ /de la skyon ni sngar bstan gang / /de dag cha rnged phyogs rna bar/ /'dod pa nyid la'ang mtshungs rtogs bya/ /nam mkha' gcig pu khyab phyogs la'ang / /legs byas la brten dang gzhan gyi/ /rnam par dbye ba 'thad pa min/ /gang phyir nam mkha' de gcig yin/ /mkha' gcig bdag nyid rna ba ni/ /rna mchog legs par ma byas med/ /de phyir rten gyi dbye ba yis/ /legs par byas pa nges mi gnas/ /de bas na rten lkugacig la ni/ /dbang po legs par byas thob na/ /dbang po gcig pur smra ba la/ /lus can kun gyes rtogs byed 'gyur/ /skyes bu dzulus kyi phyogs rnams la/ /rnam par shes pa skyed 'dod kyi/ /'on kyang khyed la mkha' gcig phyir/ /gtso bo tha dad par 'gyur min—/ /de phyir bdag phyogs dang bral yang / /ma lus par ni rtogs byed pa/ /lus nyid la gnas 'dzin pas na/ /de ltar smras kyang 'gal ba yin/ /de gnyis na ni rgyu yis ni/ /'on pa nyid sogs lta bur rtogs/ /gzugs ni me long la mngon lta/ /gzugs brnyan de ltar ma yin no/ /chu sogs nang du zhugs pa 'di/ /gzugs ni ring du gnas pa yin/ /rten gye rjes su byed pa yis / /gzugs brnyan che chung dbye ba dang / /ldan gyi gzugs ni ma yin te/ /des na gtan tshigs ma grub min/ /mi mthun par ni snang ba yang / /don shes par ni 'gyur ba na1/ /gzugs dang sgra sogs sems thams cad/ /don kun gyi ni yul can 'gyur/ /sor mos cung zad mnan mig la/ /gcig kyang du mar snang ba gang / /de yang de ltar 'khrul pa ste/ /yul med nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /'dir ni gzugs brnyan 'byung ba ni/ /sngar ni gsal bar 107—227

byas nyid yin/ /gcig la lhan cig gnyis mi rung / /lus can thogs pa dang bcas phyir/ /yul rnams ①du ma la gnas par/ /gzugs brnyan yod pa yin na yang / /che chung sogs rigs ⑤ dbye ba yis/ /gcig nyid yod pa ma yin no/ /skyes bu rnams la nges pa yang / /gang la 'di ltar 'jug par 'gyur / /bdag gi steng na nyi gnas zhes/ /de ni nges par 'khrul pa yin/ /gang phyir srog chags thams cad ni/ /cig car du ni nyi gcig nyid/ /mthong bar 'gyur ba yin pas de/ /gnyis pa nam yang ma yin no/ /des na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gnyis pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /snang ba mi dmigs pa yi phyir/ /des na nyi ma gcig tu nges/ /de ltar sgra ni gcig nyid du/ /ji ltar yang ni nges pa min/ /rim gyis sam ni cig car yang / /de ni du ma nyid mtshon phyir/ /gang tshe rjod par byed mang po/ /ga sogs yi ge cig car du / /sbyor bar byed pa de yi tshe/ /dbye bar gsal bar dmigs par 'gyur//rim gyis kyang ni spyor ba la/ /dbye ba mngon sum 'ba' zhig gis/ /rtogs 'gyur ma yin 'on kyang ni/ /rtags las kyang blo'i rim snang phyir/ /sgra tsam gsal byed rag las pa/ /'di yi dmigs par zad 'gyur mod/ /'on kyang ji ltar dngos gnas pa/ /'di ni 'dzin par 'gyur ba yin/ /de lta min na de 'dzin 'di/ /de dngos mi snang la nges 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i cha ni ma lus pa / /sgras pya ni khyab cing gsal 'gyur min/ /des na sgra tsam yul tha dad/ /thos pa de cis rjes su byed/ /rang bdag nyid ni gsal ba ru/ /gsal bar 'gyur te bum sogs bzhin/ /'di dag khyed gzhung khas blangs na/ /rgyu mtshan med par brjod pa yin/ /gsal ba med phyir gsal byed rnams/ /107—228

nus pa med phyir bsgrubs zin to/ /de 'di yin zhes bshad ①pa ni/ /mngon sum yin par bsal zin to/ /de'i phyir yul dbyes tha dad nyid/ /shes bya de ni gnod med ②yin/ /'ga' zhig yul ni tha dad par/ /rim gyis 'gro bar byed pa ste/ /skad cig 'jig phyir tha dad 'gyur/ /de min 'gro ba dang ldan min/ /snga ma'i yul dang ma bral ba'i/ /rang bzhin rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir—/ /brtan ②pas de ni yul gzhan du/ /phyin pas rig pa ma yin no/ /nam mkha' la ni mngon gsal nabya/ /rigs min nus pa med phyir dang / /dbang 'das phyir ro sa khyang ⑤la/ /snang ba de ni de ltar snang / /gzhan yang sgra ni nam mkha' la'ang / /mngon par gsal ba tha dad min/ /blo ni gsal yin de yang ni/ /rtag 'byung rgyur ni nyer gnas phyir/ /gang tshe sgra la gsal byed pa/ /ji ltar yang ni rigs pa min/ /de tshe gzhan gyi khyad par can/ /sgra blo la ni 'khrul ba med/ /de phyir ri sogs thams cad ni/ /sgra chos min zhes gnas par 'gyur/ /gang phyir sgra tsam gsal byed nyid/ /yod na der 'gyur de yang bstsal/ /shin tu tha dad can de dag /mtshungs par gcig tu rtogs pa la/ /nus pa can yin sgra dang de'i/ /don ces mang du sngar dpyad zin/ /des na don dang 'brel mthong bas/ /kun rdzob tu ni sgra rjod byed / /'gyur zhing yang dag pa ru ni/ /rjod byed de min zhes bsgrubs zin//sgra las byung ba'i shes de dag /log par snang bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rigs dang rang gi mtshan nyid sogs/ /brjod bya rjod 'ubyed mi gnas phyir/ /des 'khrul tha snyad 'don pa po/ /yang dag par ni ba lang sgra/ /tha dad yin yang mtshungs blo can/ /gcig nyid yin pa snyam du zin/ /des na mang du ma 707—229

'byel bar/ /rjod ①par byed pa bram ze yis pya / /sgra yi khyad par mdun byas pas / /gang smras de kun gzhi med yin/ /'di ltar lag brda la sogs pa/ /gcig nyid min te myur bul sogs/ /dbye bas tha dad blo yod phyir/ /de yi gsal ba'ang bstsal byas zin/ /de la spyi gcig rjes 'gro ba/ /nye bar mtshon par mi 'gyur ro/ /brda ni dgag pa la sogs pa'i/ /shes pa'i yan lag tu de 3'gyur/ /sgra rnams dngos su phyi rol gyi/ /don rtogs min te 'brel med phyir / /des na brjod par 'dod pa ni/ /'di dag gis ni bstan par gsungs / /de yi 'bras bu nyid du ni/ /'di dag mngon sum mi dmigs pas / /nges pa yin phyir des na 'dir/ /rgyu 'bras nyid du gsal bar 'gyur / /brda yi rgyu dang 'bras ngo bo/ /gang gis nges par byas pa ni/ /de yis ④brjod 'dod sgra dag gis/ /rtogs par 'gyur te lag bskyod bzhin/ /brjod 'dod la gnas don dang ni/ /sgra rnams la ni rgyu 'bras kyi/ /bdag nyid can kyi 'brel pa de/ /brda yod na ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de rnams kyis cheni 'byel pa ni/ /des na brda las byung zhes brjod/ /de yis ⑥gsal bar byed pa 'di/ /brda yis thubarjod ces dngos su min/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'gyur ba yibye/ /dngos po las ni de gzhan min/ /de dag nyid ni de ltar bshad / /rgyu 'bras nyid kyi 'brel pa yin/ /de dag kyang ni re re yis⑨ / /bdag cag nyid du rmongs pas rtogs/ /des ⑪na brda yi tha dad kyi⑪ / /dus kyi ⑫khyad par 'dod pa yin/ /yang dag par ni gcig pu nyid/ /'brel pa 'dir ni yod rigs min/ /tha dad don rnams ma 'dres phyir/ /'byel med tha mi dad la yang / /gzhan gyi gzhung lugs ma spyoshes pas/ /mi re re la brda 107—230

re 'am/ /yang na bzlas nas brjod pa yin/ /zhes bya ①la sogs gzhan gyis smras —/ /mis ②byas nyid phyir de dag la/ /brda 'brel yang dag par yod min/ /de ni de yis ①gsal byas phyir/ /zhes bya 'byel pa nyid du 'gyur/ /'dir ni bzlas nas brjod pa ste/ /gzhan gyis so sor rtogs pa min⑦/ /dbang phyug la sogs bkag nyid phyir/ /'byin pa'i thog mar des byas min/ /re re la ni 'byel pa gang / /de ni tha dad skad cig gis⑤/ /'jig phyir mtshungs pa'i rtogs pa ni/ /tha dad pa la'ang 'gal ba min/ /de yi yul can blo rnams ni//rim gyis kyang ni skye 'gyur ba/ /de la'ang rim pa gsal bar smras/ /gzhan du de dag rim med 'gyur/ /mang po rnams la cig car du/ /brda byed par ④ni yod pa na/ /brda ni tha dad par 'dod min/ /sngo sogs skad cig ma bzhin no/ /smra ba po yi blo mi ④gnas/ /de nyid gzhan longs spyad bya yin④/ /khyad par med phyir mi 'thad do/ /snga ma'i dngos ni ma spangs shing / /khyad par ma byung ba yod na'ang / /khyed kyi gzhan gyi rna ba ni/ /longs mi spyod par ji ltar 'gyur/ /rtag nyid phyir dang ltos med phyir/ /chos dang chos min dbang byas pa/ /gtan du nam mkha' rna ba ni⑨/ /thams cad longs spyod min par thal/ /nam mkha' la ni nam du yang / /chos min chos kyis ⑩phan mi 'dogs/ /rtag pa nyid phyir bya ba min/ /'di la dbang byas 'di ci zhig /sngags dang sman sogs nus pa yin/ /yang longs spyad byar ji ltar 'gyur/ /rtag ⑩pa nyid phyir de dag las/ /de ni khyad par thob 'gyur min/ /gal te rten min ⑩rtag yin naspyo/ /skad cig mi rtag yin zhe na/ /de tshe bdag la bogs med pas/ /'on pa la sogs mi 'thad do/ /de la bogs ni yod blo ④ste/ /107—231

nam mkha' la ni de yod min/ /rten dang 'brel pa yod min te/ /rtag nyid yin pas ltos med phyir/ /des na de yi sgo nas kyang / /'dir ni 'on pa sogs mi 'thad/ /nam mkha' cha shas med yin la①/ /rtag pa nyid kyis 'di mtshungs yin/ /yul der gnas par 'gyur yang ni/ /gal te de yang skad cig ma/ /nyid min na ni dbang las ni/ /bton par rigs 0pa ma yin no/ /de la phyis kyang yul byung ni/ /ci zhig skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gang gis dbang las bton pa ni/ /des slar longs spyod thob 'gyur min/ /gang tshe rna ba dang sgra ni/ /legs byas de ltar 'thad min te/ /tha dad tha mi dad rtogs 1pas / /legs par bya ba mi 'thad phyir/ /legs par byas pa tha dad na/ /rna ba sgra legs byas mi 'gyur/ /de dag dang ni legs byas la/ /'byel pa cung zad kyang yod min/ /tha dad pa la 'byel pa ni/ /rgyu 'bras nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /de yod na ni 'di rtag tu/ /'byung 'gyur rgyu rtag ④gnas pa'i phyir/ /tha mi dad pa'i phyogs la yang / /de 'drar 'di yang rtag par 'gyur / /de yang bya bar 'dod pa min/ /de las shes pa rtag thal 'gyur/ /de phyir rlung la sogs pa la/ /nus pa nges pa 'thad min te/ /bya ba yi ni yul med pas/ /nus pa dang ni mi ldan phyir/ /des na mngon gsal sbyor med pas/ / bzung ba skyed ⑤par mi 'khrul pa/ /sgra yi du shes pa 'di 'bras 'gyur—/ /bum sogs gsal ba'i blo bzhin no/ /de phyir rtsol dang brjod 'dod pas/ /skyed dang mngon par gsal ba ni/ /nus pa'i bye brag thams cad du/ /'bras bu'i don gyis ④mtshungs nges 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i cha nyid sun dbyung bar/ /rig 'upa 'ga' zhig ji snyed pa/ /phyogs cha la yang ma 107—232

lus par/ /de ni mkhas pas ①shes par bya/ /yul yang legs par byed pa narka/ /de yis gcig la legs byas min/ /spangs nyid phyir dang nus nges phyir—/ /des na yul legs byas pa min/ /shes pa skyed rung nyid min na/ /kun gyis sgra 'di thams cad du/ /nam yang rtogs par mi 'gyur te/ /de shes pa la mi mkho'i phyir/ /shes pa skyed par nus yin na/ /shes rgyu nyid du gnas pa'i phyir/ /kun gyis sgra 'di yul kun dang / /dus kun du ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /de ni nus sam mi nus pa/ /rang bzhin gyes gcig bdag nyid gnas—/ /'gal ba 'am ni lhan cig byed/ /su zhig gis don 'jig byed nus / /'ga' zhig la ni shes skyed par/ /rung ba nyid du 'di 'gyur te/ /de phyir skyed par 'gyur ba na/ /'di ni kun gyis rtogs 'gyur min/ /'on kyang ngag la nyer gnas pa/ /sgra tsam gyis gang legs byas 'gyur/ /de rnams nyid kyis sgra thos la/ /ring na gnas pas ji ltar min/ /nye bar gnas pa'ang bye legs byas ni/ /rgyu ru yongs su brtag zupa yin/ /ring du gnas na'ang de dag la/ /legs par byas la'ang mtshungs pa yin/ /gal te sgra tsam rnams la ni/ /khyad par legs byas skyes rtogs na/ /de tshe sgra ni skyed pa ru/ /sus kyang spong bar ④byed nus min/ /sgra las khyad par can legs byas/ /de tha mi dad can yin te/ /sgra shes bya nyid mi 'gyur phyir/ /des na sgra yang skye bar 'gyur/ /lan cig sgra ni legs byas nas⑤/ /bdag ni de ni nam du yang / /spong bar byed min mi rtag par/ /thal 'gyur phyir te rtag dmigs 'gyur—/ /gnyis ka legs byas phyogs la yang / /nyes pa gnyis tshig bden pa yin/ /gang phyir gang rung ma tshang med/ /snga ma'i rang bzhin rjes 'jug 107—233

phyir—/ /'di ltar sngar ni gsal byed kyis/ /rna ba'i yi ge legs byas gang / /de dag 'jig min 'pho thob phyir/ /des na kun gyis kun thos 'gyur/ /skyes bu 'ga' la thos rung bar/ /rna ba yig legs byas she na/ /de tshe yig gzhan rtogs pa pos/ /rna ba las byung shes 'gyur min/ /de rig mi yi rnam shes ni//rung bar legs par byas she na/ /de dag nyid kyi ①rjes 'jug na/ /de dag kyang ni thos par 'gyur/ /ldog na khyed la yig rna ba/ /'di dag gzhan thob cis rngu mi 'gyur/ /des na de dag rnams la ni/ /rtag pa nyid 'dod rgyu mtshan med / /gang phyir gzugs brnyan blo kun ni/ /dmigs pa med par gnas pas na/ /chu la sogs par nyi ma 'od/ /gcig ni du mar snang ba min/ /ci phyir khyed kyi phyogs la yang / /blo rnams rnam pa med par gnas/ /phyi rol don ni rnam pa dang / /ldan pa zhes ni khas blangs yin/ /gzugs brnyan de yang chu yi ni/ /nang du snang bar 'gyur ba yin/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na snang ba yi/ /nyi ma de ltar gnas min na/ /de ni ci phyir de ltar snang / /'khrul pas she na de nyid kyis rngu/ /de ni gsal bar dmigs med de/ /de yi ngo bo'i don med phyir/ /de nyid gzhan du rtog ce na/ /'di ni legs par smras pa yin/ /'on kyang de nyid gzhan yin na/ /des na kun gyis kun rig 'gyur / /gal te ji ltar gnas snang ④na/ /de ni rtogs par 'gyur ba yin/ /rnam pa gzhan du dmigs pa na/ /de ni mthong bar ji ltar 'gyur/ /gang phyir rnam rgya bcas shes la yang / /de shes don dang mthun pa yi/ /rnam pa yod par snang ba dang / /shes pa de ni 'dzin par rigs/ /brgyud nas bkod par gyur pas na/ /'og na gnas pa rtogs su chud/ /gcig nyid yin 107—234

pas steng gnas pa/ /ci ste 'og na gnas snyam sems/ /gal te ji ltar nyi ma gnas / /de ltar de ni snang 'gyur 1na/ /de rtogs rngupar ni brtag lkubya yin/ /gzhan du min zhes bstan zin to/ /shar du song 'jug pa yis ni/ /nub phyogs song 'jug la bkod pas/ /gdong mthong ba na 'khrul pa yin/ /nub phyogs lta bar rtogs pa min④/ /gzugs brnyan yul can rnam par shes/ /de ni rang bzhin dmigs min rkyete/ /de dang mi mthun snang ba'i phyir/ /ro dang sgra sogs sems bzhin no/ /gang phyir me long chung ngu la/ /gdong ni chung ngur snang bar 'gyur/ /shing sogs thur du gyebaltas nas ni/ /chu gang zhugs pa 'brel gzhan min/ /nyan pa po yang gzhan ma yin/ /ngo bo gcig tu nges pa ni/ /gnyis ka la yang rjes 'jug phyir/ /smra ba po hūṃyi sngar med pa'i—/ /'byel pa nyan pos ji ltar rtogs/ /de yis zusngon du gang dmigs pa/ /de nyid de yis byas pa yin/ /gang phyir rnam pa gcig rtogs pa'i/ /blo ni de la 'jug pa min/ /de phyir sgra sogs tha dad kyang / /gcig pu nyid du de byenges yin/ /bum pa sogs kyi spyi yang ni/ /sngar nyid gsal bar byas zin to/ /'byung po'i mgul chings lta bu shābyeni/ /spyi 'ga' zhig ni snang mi 'gyur/ /'di la spyi yis chu 'dzin sogs/ /nus pa grub pa ma yin no/ /gal te spyi dang dbyer med na/ /de dag kyang ni rtag nyid 'gyur/ /tha dad 'byel med skyon yin te/ /de las byung na mi rtag 'gyur/ /de phyir spyi las chu 'dzin sogs/ /nus pa yod par rigs pa min/ /bum sogs la nus tha dad na'ang / /nyes pa 'di dag nyes par 'gyur/ /chu ⑫'dzin la sogs de'i 'bras bu/ /rtag pa kho nar thal bar 'gyur/ /nus pa nyid ni 'byel yin pas/ /'di tha dad mi 107—235

'dod ce na/ /nus las dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ /sgra dang don dag gcig nyid 'gyur/ /tha dad na yang de la ni/ /de dag dang 'byel 'ga' yang med/ /de las byung na de nyid min/ /dngos las ①gzhan du 'gro sa med/ /gang phyir 'byel pa ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra yod par gsal byas pas/ /de phyir 'byel pa brjod dus su/ /ba lang sogs sgra brjod pa na/ /'ga' zhig gis ni 'byel pa'i blo1/ /don rtogs gzhan gyis de bzhin min/ /dngos ldu kyi 'byel pa yod pa na/ /kun gyi don ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /rtag pa'i nus pa kho na yi/ /'byel pa ru ni khyed ④kyis 'dod/ /de yang tshad med la nges par/ /don rtogs skyed dam yang na ni bye/ /nges par tshad med pa skyed na/ /ci phyir kun gyis don ma rtogs/ /tshad bcas skyed na'ang rgyu mtshan ci/ /ngo bo nyid kyis de lta bur/ /rang bzhin zhe na brda bzung ba'i/ /sngon du'am de ni brjod na yang / /rtogs pa po ni gcig nyid la/ /ci phyir rnam shes 'jug pa min/ /de shes skyed pa'i nges pa can/ /de ni nus pa gnas phyir ro/ /'on te nus pa rtogs byas nyid/ /de la skyed par nges brtags snen/ /rtogs par byas dang ma byas dang / /tha dad ce na rtag pyanyid nyams/ /gcig nyid na ni rgyu mtshan cis / /rnam par dbye ba 'di brjod yin/ /gzhan yang thabs gang zhig gis ni/ /nus pa shes par 3'dod pa yin/ /don gyis go bas shes she na/ /gang phyir rigs pa 'di ltar gnas/ /mngon sum kyi ni sgra dang ni/ /rgan rabs brjod bya mthong ba yin/ /nyan pa po la rtogs pa nyid/ /bya bas rjes su dpag nas shes/ /de la brtan kye/pa'i nus pa ni/ /gzhan du mi 'thad pa yis rtogs/ /don gyis go bas rtogs 'gyur te/ /tshad ma gsum can 'byel 107—236

pa'o—/ /gzhan du 'thad pa kho na'i phyir/ /nus pa rtogs par mi nus te/ /gang phyir brda las byung sgra yis/ /don rtogs 'khrul pa med pa yin/ /nus pa rtag nyid phyogs la ni/ /brda sogs cung zad la ltos med/ /des na sgra don gyis rtogs pa/ /rtag tu 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /brda ni gzhan ma'i ngo bo yis/ /ka li ma ri sogs sgra bzhin/ /sgra la nges pa'i nus yod phyir/ /don gzhan rtogs par mi 'gyur te/ /gal te sna tshogs don gsal phyir/ /nus pa gcig tu 'dod pa na/ /tha dad ce na sgra gcig gis/ /cig car sna tshogs don rig ①'gyur/ /don ni gsal bar byed nus pa/ /rtag pa kho nar gnas pa'i phyir/ /de rgyu don la rtogs pa yang / /thams cad la ni gtan du 'gyur/ /de la brda la ltos pa can/ /nus par brtags pa ④yin zhe na/ /de ni phan 'dogs la ltos min/ /mi g.yo bas de phan gdags med/ /don ni gsal bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /brda ni mi la brten pa'i phyir/ /mis ma byas pa'i nus pa yang / /log pa lcenyid ni srid pa yin/ /sna tshogs don ni gsal byed pa'i/ /nus pa sgra gcig la yod na/ /me la sbyin sreg la sogs don/ /thams cad kun la nyer mkho min/ /de 'dod phyin ci log don ni/ /gsal bar byed pa'ang srid pa'i phyir/ /des na sgra don 'brel brtag par/ /brtags ④pa don med can yin no/ /brda yang ltos par byed pa na/ /brtags par nus pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /rgyu mtshan med pa'i 'byel ba 'di/ /ci phyir yongs su gso ⑤ba yin/ /grub pa nyer gzhag pa la ni/ /brda ni ma rtogs par bya gzhan/ /don rtogs pa ru byed pa ni/ /de la cung zad kyang snang min/ /'di ltar brda ni med pa na/ /tha snyad 'di ni mthong ma yin/ /107—237

de las 'byel pa grub ce na/ /brgyud pa 'di ni don med 'gyur/ /skyes bu 'dod tsam las byung ba'i/ /brda ni 'ba' zhig las kyang ni/ /tha snyad kyang ni tsosnarigs yin te/ /des na 'byel pa mi 'grub bo/ /ga'an du yang ni 'thad par ni/ /tha snyad la ni dogs par 'gyur/ /dbang po las 'das 'byel pa ni//mi rnams kyis ni rtogs ma yin/ /thams cad kyis ni mi shes pas/ /snga ma snga ma ma grags phyir/ /'byel pa ma grub ces bya bas/ /de ltar de cis yongs su brtags / /des na ba lang rta sogs kyis/ /sgra ni rtag pa'i 'byel ldan min//brda la ltos bcas nyid kyi phyir/ /ga bi la sogs sgra bzhin no/ /rung ba'i ba lang sgra yod na/ /de byenus min skyes kyis btsud zhubyas/ /ga bi sogs las ba lang blo/ /rtsa ba'i sgra rjes 'brangs she na/ /de min nya ④pa sogs rnams kyis/ /legs par sbyar ba mi rtogs phyir/ /rtsa ba byesgra yis rjes 'brangs pa'i gye ji ltar dor 7gyi blo 'byung 'gyur/ /de ltar dusgra don gyis 'byel pa/ /rtag par khas blangs par ma byas/ /de ni brda las byung rigs yin/ /rnam pa kun du de srid phyir/ /yang na yul zhig she— rigs rgyud ni/ /chad pa'i ngo bo thim pa yin/ /sangs rgyas pas 'dod 'dod med gang / /tshangs la sogs la'ang yod par dogs / /de yod na ni rig byed la/ /'jig rtsa'i blo ni srid pa yin/ /log pa'i gti mug rgyags sogs pasame/ /phyin ci log rtog gzhan yang srid/ /de dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba yinakye/ /rig byed gzhan nyid du ni 'gyur/ /ji srid gnod pa can ma bstan/ /de srid de ni dogs par 'gyur/ /gzhan du byed pa'i 'dod yod kyang / /sgra ni 'jug par mi 'gyur na/ /de bzhin gal te mi rnams la/ /gzhan du byed 'dod mi skye na/ /de tshe rig byed 'di gzhung 107—238

dang / /don ni gzhan bdag nyid mi rtogs/ /gzhan du byed pa'i don ①'jug na/ /dogs pa ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /skyes bu thams cad dag gis ni//sngar grub rim pa bzung ba ④yin/ /tshig ngag yi ge'i rim pa yis rang dbang gis kyang byed par 'gyur/ /gzhan du khyed la rig byed bzhin/ /gzhung 'ga' byas par mi 'gyur ro/ /des na de bzhin don med pa'i/ /gzhung tsam la yang byas med 'gyuralku/ /ji ltar gzhan dag gis brjod pa/ /des na de ni brjod 'dod ces/ /des ni nges pa ma yin te/ /des na 'byel bzhin thog med yin/ /gzhan gyis brjod pa bdag gis brjod/ /brjod par 'dod pa de 'drar 'gyur/ /mtshungs pa'i rtogs pa'i 'khrul pa yis/ /las kyi bye brag ji bzhin no/ /dbyangs la sogs pa mi mthun phyir/ /gzhan gyes brjod pa brjod bya min/ /yi ge'i bdag nyid du snang phyir/ /gsal byar byed pa'i chos 'di min/ /des na mi re yig tha dad/ /snang ba yin te bum sogs bzhin/ /de phyir tha dad gsal bas na/ /de yi mtshan ma ci ste dgag/rigs kyis bum pa la sogs la/ /tha snyad nye bar mtshon pa ni/ /de med pas na sngar bkag yin/ /gsal ba dang de mi ldan phyir/ /de phyir rkan rtel sogs pa'i rigs/ /skyes bu thams cad la gnas min/ /des na smra po de rnams kyis//sgra tsam nyer mtshon bskul ba min/ /de phyir ji srid yig yod pa/ /sgra tsam gyi rigs tha dad ni/ /sgra sngon byegasal ba'i rgyur 'jug pa'am/ /yang na gsal ba de ldan min/ /des na rkan sogs ldan pa dang / /rnam dbye'i rim pa sngon 'gro can/ /khyed la sgra tsam go rims dang / /rigs kyis gnyis ka'i rtag nyid med/ /ji ltar skor ba sogs rnams kyi/ /cha rigs sogs kyis mtshon 107—239

byas min/ /rim pa'i rjes 'jug 'gyur de ltar/ /rkan sogs sgra tsam yig rten min/ /phra ba nyid phyir gsal rnams la/ /rigs kyi chos ni nges bzung dang / /yang de'i dbang gis don rnams la/ /khyab nyid yin ① yang rim mi 'dzinatre / /des na sgra tsam kyi 1yon tan/ /thams cad rtag nyid du gnas pa//yi ge'i rjes su byed pa na/ /don gyis ④dbye ba rtogs ma yin/ /gzhan yang ji srid yig 'uyod pa/ /sgra tsam rigs tha dad sgra la/ /mngon par gsal ba'i rgyur 'jug pa'am/ /yang na gsal ba de ldan na/ /des na gsal byed yod pa'i phyir/ /sgra ni rtag tu dmigs par 'gyur/ /des na khyod ⑥ la gsal rim gyis / /bdag nyid yi ge'i rim rigs min/ /gsal ba dang 'brel ngo bo ru//rigs rnams gnas par gyur pa na/ /gsal ba rnams la'ang rtag pa nyid/ /bzlog par dka' bar thal bar 'gyur/ /rigs dang 'byel pa'i ngo bo ru/ /gsal ba rnams kyang gnas yin na/ /rigs la'ang mi rtag nyid du ni/ /khyed mi 'dod kyang thal bar 'gyur/ /mngon par gsal bar mi 'thad par/ /sngar ni bstan par byas zin pas/ /de ltar rtogs par byed pa ni/ /khyed kyi yi ge'i rtogs dzabyed min/ /dus gcig khyab cing rtag pa yang / /sngar ni bkag pa kho na yin/ /dngos po kun la yi ge bzhin/ /'ga' zhig gis gsal byas ma yin/ /yi ge rnams ni gsal byas zun/ /'di ni rtogs pa'i yan lag min/ /gzhan las khyad par med phyir dang / /gzhan du med phyir de rtag min/ /des na yi ge'i go rims dang / /thung dang ring dang ches ring dang kye/ /de dag dus kyi rnam dbye bas/ /sgra tsam khyad par can dus kyi/ /rnam dbye de dag rigs ma yin/ /de phyir khyed la rtag pa yi/ /de 'dra'i tshig 707—240

gi chos yod min/ /des na yi ge mi rtag par/ /smra la tshig ni mi rtag grub/ /gal te gsal byed rkyen rnams kyis/ /'dir ni gsal bar rigs 'gyur na/ /gzhan gyi chos kyang yan lag nyid/ /rta yi shugs sogs bzhin du 'gyur/ /sgra kun rtag pa nyid la ni/ /don gyis 1go ba sun phyung zin/ /mi rtag kyang ni don rtogs 1pa'i/ /rgyu nyid du ni bsgrub par byas/ /gang zhig gang gis brjod 'dod las/ /'byung bar brjod 'dod gzhan pa las/ /yi ge skye bar 'gyur ba ni/ /de yi rjes thogs la 5de thos/ /snga ma'i yi ge rtogs byung ba'i/ /yang dag rig pa myur thos min/ /myur du thos pa ma yin pa/ /de ni de dran la ltos nas/ /phyi nas rang nyid dran par byed/ /de dag skye dang 'dzin pa yi//shes pa dag la brten nas ni/ /skyes bus byas pa'i yig go rims/ /'di ni skyed dang rgyu chenyid yin/ /de phyir tshig chornams so so la/ /yig rnams tha dad ces ni gsal/ /'dul bsnyon lcug ma shing ta la/ /zhes sogs rim pa'i bye brag phyir/ /de dag de 'dra'i rim pa yis/ /don tha dad pa ston byed yin/ /de nyid phyir na gsal ba yi/ /de ni don rtogs ched du ni/ /sgra pa rnams kyis /sneyongs su brtags/ /yi ge kho nas rtogs nus pas/ /der ni brtags pa don med yin/ /snang ba ma mthong ba yi phyir/ /'di ni med par 3nges par 'gyur//'di ni mi snang ba yin na/ /rtags ⑤bzhin shes par byed par 'gyur/ /yod pa tsam gyis de shes la/ /rgyu yi ngo bor gnas pa'i phyir/ /de ni shes byed 'dod ce na/ /mi bzhin rtag tu shes byed 'gyur/ /de bzhin brda ni ma gtogs ⑨dang / /yi ge rnams ni ma thos kyang / /de las byung ba'i don shes ni / /'byung 'gyur ⑨nus rgyu nyer gnas phyir/ /'di ltar 'di ni rtag yod pa/ /107—241

'di la ltos pa cung zad med/ /sgra tsam brda yig rnams kyis kyang / /de gsal ma yin ma mthong phyir/ /shes pa gsal ba yin zhes bshad/ /de yi shes pa rig ma yin/ /des na gsal bar byed 'di la/ /brtags stipa nyid kyang don med 'gyur/ /sgra tsam gyis ni legs byas can/ /yongs su smin pa skyed pa na/ /mtha' ma'i sgra dang lhan cig tu/ /sgra ni blo la snang bar 'gyur/ /de ltar de yang de yis 'dir/ /rgyu mtshan med par brtags pa yin/ /de la yang ni sgra gzhan la/ /snang bar 'gyur bar (shematshon ma yin/ /gang dag gis kyang gsal ba la/ /rim gyis 'byung ba sgra tsam kyis/ /skye ba nyid dang gsal ba nyid / /sems pa de dag la rim 'gal/ /cha shas med la rim gyis ni/ /skye ba dang gsal 'thad pa yin/ /ngo bo gcig las phyi med phyiraldu/ /de dag rtag tu 'gyur ba yin/ /cha shas bcas pa nyid yin pas/ /ji ltar yig res don ston min/ /gsal cha'ang cis na de ltar min/ /ma mthong gsal cha ci phyir brtags/ /gal te sgra gcig gis lhan cig /skyed dang gsal bar byas she na/ /shin tu gsal ④grub pa yi phyir/ /yi ge gzhan ni sbyor ba yin/ /gang phyir 'dogs dka' 'di yi ni/ /rang bzhin de ni de ltar byas/ /mtshungs pa'i dus ldan yig gzhan gyis/ /sbar yang mngon par gsal bar byed//de nyid dam ni gzhan gcig gis/ /ci phyir bzlas bhunas yang dang yang / /gsal ba bzlog 6par mi byed de/ /de la khyed med phyir min nam/ /yul dang dbang po legs byas pa'i/ /ngo bo gsal ba 'di la yang / /yi ge bzhin du dgag bya ste/ /de snang sems ni yod na yang / /de yi phyir na mngon sum gyi/ /rim gyis rtogs la phyi kyenas gang / /ma lus yi ge rnam shes pa/ /de yi don 107—242

shes rgyu can yin/ /tha ma'i yi ge rnams rtogs nas1/ /legs byas thams cad kyis byas pas/ /yi ge rnams la cig car du/ /dran pa thams cad skye bar 'gyur/ /rim gyis shes pa yod na yang / /smra ba po ni thams cad kyis//don rnams thams cad dag la ni/ /de ni yid bsdus shes par 'dod/ /rim par snang ba de nyid ni du/ /khas len byed pa min zhe na/ /brgya la sogs pa'i ngo bo ni/ /de bsdus shes pa skye mi 'gyur/ /gal te des na yig rim pa/ /rna tshib yid kyi sngar shes pa/ /skye 'gyur yang na phyi nas ni/ /cig car dran shes 'byung bar 'gyur/ /des na yi ge der gnas min/ /ring na gnas pa rtogs pa'i phyir/ /des na sgra las don gyi ④blo/ /'jig rten pa rnams kyis mchod 'gyur/ /rnam pa dang bcas shes pa ni/ /thams cad de ni rigs pa yin / /de lta min na 'jig 'gyur ba/ /dran pa la ni ji ltar phyesnang / /'on te yi ge mi snang ba'i/ /gsal ba can sngar rtogs 'gyur ba/ /gnas pa kho na dran zhe na/ /de min gsal snang thal 'gyur phyir/ /gnas pa sngar ni bsal ⑥zin te/ /de ni gnas na'ang yi ge yi/ /nyams stsong shes pa'i dus nyid du/ /dran pa skyes gyur snga rgyu gcig phyir/ /ba lang zhes bya'i blo gcig nyid//kho bo cag gis bkag byas min/ /de 'dzin don gcig nyid dag gis/ /sgra la blo gcig 'gyur ba yin/ /ba lang sgra la de yod kyang / /myur phyir bar mtshams chung ba'i phyir/ /lha sbyin la sogs sgra la ni/ /dbye ba gsal bar rtogs par 'gyur/ /yi ge las byung don blo de/ /de shes pa yi rjes las skyes//de 'dra de ni de las byung / /du ba sogs las me blo bzhin/ /yig las tha dad sgra snang ba/ /shes pa rjes thogs 'byung ba can/ /don gyi blo ni rig pa 107—243

min / /des na sgra bzhin rjod byed med/ /'bras bu'i tha snyad kyi yan lag /rjes su 'gro dang ldog pa dag /thams cad du ni nges byas pa/ /des na khyab pa 'dir nges yin/ /yi ge mi rtag nyid la ni/ /rjod byed nyid du bsgrubs zin to/ /rtag pa'i sgrub ⑨pa ngo shes dang / /rjes dpag dag kyang bsal zin to / /mi shes pas rang tshig sogs dang / /'gal bar rtsod par byas pa yin/ /gang phyir rtag pa'i phyogs la ni/ /khyed la de kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag pa'i ngag ni yod pa na/ /gsal byed rigs min dpyad zin te/ /go rims la sogs mi ldan dang / /rtag tu ma dmigs pa yi phyir/ /chos can tha dad ma brtags par/ /gzhi ma grub par /phyigang brjod de/ /rjes dpag mtshan nyid mi shes phyir/ /gang phyir snang 'gyur chos can yin/ /nya ba la sogs rnams la yang / /ma dpyad rab tu grub don gang / /shes pa la ni gang snang ba/ /de tsam chos can nyid du bshad/ /de nyid la ni rtsod pa 'di/ /smra po rnams la 'jug pa yin/ /'dod pas bkod pa'i bye brag la/ /rtsod pa su la'ang zu yod ma yin/ /des na khyad par med bstan pa/ /khyad par du ni rnam rtog pa/ /rjes su dpag pa thams cad kyice/ /'jug pa kho na la gnod 'gyur/ /bskul ba las ni skyes pa'i blo/ /tshad ma yin te skyon bral ba'i/ /rgyu rnams kyis ni skyed nyid phyir/ /zhes bya sogs kyang rnam dpyad bya/ /dag cing rtag pa'i don 'byel pa'i/ /bskul ba'i las ni skyes pa'i blo/ /phyogs yin zhe na gzhan brten nas/ /gzhi ma grub par thal bar 'gyur/ /de yi gnas skabs rtag pa nyid / /de las gzhan pa mi rtag yin/ /de yi gnas skabs nyid log na/ /ci zhig gnas par 'dod pa yin/ /dbang po 'ba' zhig gis bzung ⑤nyid/ /107—244

gtan tshigs su ni 'dir rtog na/ /sngar gnod byas pa'i rigs kyis ni/ /'khrul par rtog ①pa ma yin no/ /rang gi snang ba'i dbang shes la/ /rgyu yin dbang pos bzung bar 'dod/ /rtag pa rgyu nyid ma yin par/ /der ⑤ni rab tu bsgrubs zin to/ /de 'dra'i don la rgyu nyid ni/ /thams cad la yang grub pa yin/ /de lta min zhun du sogs la'ang / /kun la rnam par brtag ④'di mtshungs/ /kho bo cag la kun rdzob pa'i/ /so sor brtags 'gog ⑤la sogs pa/ /brtsal ④ma thag 'byung shes 'bras bu/ /rtsom byed nyid du'ang grub pa min/ /'gog pa dag ni 'jig bdag nyid/ /'dod min gang phyir zag bcas pas/ /so sor brtags pas 'gog pa gang / /bral ba'ang ⑦so so so so yin/ /skye ba drugatan du gegs byed pa/ /'gog gzhan so sor brtags min pas/ /de phyir grub mtha' mi shes pa/ /log pa'i nga rgyal kyis ni babe+edakye //rang bzhin med phyir 'gog dang mkhas/ /brtsal rmye ma thag las byung ba min/ /gyo mo snang ba'i tshogs sogs ni/ /de ltar shes pa'i rgyu mtshan yin/ /don gcig rang gi rang bzhin la/ /ngo bo gnyis nyid gsal bar byas/ /de phyir rigs zhes bya ba'i sgra/ /rtag pa bum 'di la grub min/ /de yi gnas skabs nyid spong tsam/ /mi rtag bsgrub bya nyid du ni/ /'dod pa yin te mar me sogs—/ /de la dpe ni gsal ba ni/ /'bar sogs skad cig re rer yang / /'jig nyid ma grub ma ⑩yin nam/ /der ni cha shas phra mo ni/ /yul gzhan du ni song ba yin/ /sdong bu phyogs la mang rmye du ni/ /'bar ba bsdus nas gnas pa yin/ /de la ji srid gyen song ba/ /de srid 'bar ba zhes rtogs yin/ /de yang 'das nas gang song ba/ /de ni 'od kyi bdag nyid yin/ /de rjes la 707—245

ni gang song ba/ /de ni ①phra phyir nges bzung ②min/ /yan lag phyi snems lam bkag pas/ /nang ma 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar phyi mas go phye ba/ /nang ma de lta rjode ltar 'gro/ /des na 'gro ba yin yang nges/ /rtswa sogs sreg par mi byed do/ /zhe na de di brtags pa tsam/ /tshad ma ma smras pa yi phyir/ /gzhan yang nus ma nyams de dag /rtswa dang ras bal sogs phrad na/ /sreg par byed par ⑤thal 'gyur 'di/ /snga ma bzhin du ldog mi 'gyur/ /gzhan du nus dang mi nus pa'i/ /gang tshe rang bzhin dbye yod na/ /de tshe rtag dngos de dag la/ /de ni ji ltar rjoyod par 'gyur/ /'byel pa la yang rtag pa nyid//sngar ni bkag pa byas pa yin/ /des ni 'brel byar mi 'dod pa'i/ /rigs pas ngag rtag rigs ma yin/ /ji lta bu ⑦yi ngag la ni/ /rtag pa nyid du khas blangs byas/ /yi ge tsam gyis ⑧bdag nyid dam/ /yig rim yang na tha dad yin—/ /rim med yi ge rnams la ni/ /brjod pa nyid med de yis ni/ /de dag de 'dra'i ngag ma yin/ /de dag la ni rim pa'ang med/ /khyab pa'i phyir dang rtag nyid phyir/ /de dag la ni yul dus rim/ /me tog 'bras bu sogs dbye bzhin/ /yig bris bzhin du 'thad ma yin/ /de dag rang bzhin rim yod pa/ /mtsho ro stizhes bya nyid srid na/ /phyi nas ro mtsho sogs mi 'gyur—/ /brtan pa'i rim pa dang 'gal phyir/ /gang phyir yi ge rnam rtag par—/ /brjod par byas pa de yi phyir/ /rim gzhan gnas pa'i ro mtsho sogs—/ /rim pa gzhan la skye mi 'gyur/ /de ltar min khyod kyis smras pa'i/ /ngo shes pa ni rtag pa dang / /gcig nyid sgrub par byed pa po/ /'khrul pa can du 'gyur ba yin/ /tha dad pa la'ang ⑩'jug pa'i phyir/ /gsal ba'i rim 107—246

pa'ang ngag min te/ /rtag ①pa'i bkag pa bsal byas phyirasne/ /ngag ni 'thad pa ma yin pas/ /de phyir rtag pa nyid mi rigs/ /ji ltar 'phel ba la sogs sgra/ /'dod pas bkod pa'i don can rnams/ /mtho ris mchod sbyin la sogs sgra/ /de bzhin du yang bsrings pa yin/ /rang nyid kyis byas gtam ngo bo'i/ /zlos gar gtam rgyud la sogs pa/ /rtag pa'i sgra dang don 'byel pa//brjod 'dod yang dag par yod min/ /de la'ang nus rtag nyid yod de/ /nges sbyor mi rtag nyid yin pas/ /der gnas mi rtag nyid ④kyi phyir/ /nus la ④'khrul 'jug 'gyur zhe na/ /de la sun dbyung phyi rol don/ /med pa nyid ni ma yin nam/ /don gang la ni nus par brtags/ /rnam rtog gzugs brnyan la zhe na/ /de bzhin rig ⑤byed la yang mtshungs/ /dbang po las 'das don 'byel pa'i/ /nus pa su zhig gis rtogs 'gyur/ /de phyir rig byed la nges sbyor/ /mi la rag las pa'ang rigs rjomin/ /rgan po la yang de rtogs min/ /de dag mi shes rang bzhin gnas/ /skyes bu la brten bshad pa las—/ /rtogs pa de ni srid pa yin/ /byas pa'i lung la brgal brtags ⑦pa/ /'di ni mtshungs pa ma yin nam/ /der min de ⑧ni dad pas sam/ /don la dze+e tshom za bas 'jug /mngon sum dang ni rjes dpag pas/ /yul ni rnam par brtags yod pas/ /rig byed sgra ni de lta min/ /gang phyir de ni rang las shes/ /byas pa'i don can gtam gyi ⑨chos/ /ma mthong ngo bo thos las mtshungs| /de ltar rig byed ma 'byel pa/ /gzhan dag gis 'dir smras pa yin| /sgra don thog ⑩med spang byas nas/ /'byel pa thob ⑪med rgyu mtshan nyid| /gzhan yod ma yin des na 'di/ /rig byed la ni 'byel sogs med//107—247

thabs dang bral ba nyid kyis na①/ /'byel pa byar med rjes su dpag /bshad pa byar med rjes dpag ni/ /mthong ba nyid kyis 'gal bar 'gyur/ /rgan po rnams kyi rtogs pa ni/ /yang dang yang du snang 'gyur ba/ /thabs yin zhes par ②rtogs brten nas/ /de nyams pa ni mi 'grub ci/ /gal te rig byed don la nges/ /rgan po rnams las mi slu bar/ /grub par gyur na de dag kun/ /de ltar 'gyur gyi gzhan du nyams/ /thams cad bsdus pa'i khyab pa ni/ /grub phyir 'dus pa can nyid kyi/ /rtags la mi mthun sgrub pa ni/ /cung zad srid pa ma yin no/ /don bcas rnam dbye'i don can gyi/ /khyad par rim pa dang ldan pa/ /tshig dang ngag gi tshogs zhes bya/ /yi ge kho na de ltar bshad/ /don bcas rnam dbye'i don can gyi/ /khyad par rim dang ldan nyid ni/ /skyes bus ma byas la bkag zin/ /des na khyab pa gnod med yin/ /rig byed 'don pa brjod nyid la/ /de ltar khyab pa nges pa med/ /des na sgrub pa 'di la ni/ /ldog la ④the tshom bsal ④bar yod/ /de ltar rim pa byed pa yi/ /mi ni nus med nges byas na/ /'dir ni khyab pa 'di 'grub ste/ /de ni nges par mi nus so/ /ma lus mi yi chos rnams ni/ /mngon sum du ni byas yin na/ /nges pa kho na skye ba yin/ /'di ni thams cad khyed la dad/ /rig byed skyes bus byas nyid du/ /yod par gsal ba srid pa yin/ /'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / /srog chags 'tshe dang brdzun bshad pa/ /brjod dka' nyid dang thung brjod nyid/ /'brel med nyid dang mi snyan sogs/ /rig byed chos rnams tshad smra ba'i/ /tshig la yang ni yod par snang / /dug sel nus pa la sogs pa⑤/ /bden pa cung zad gang snang ba/ /de ni mkha' 107—248

lding bya sogs snang / /gzhan yang rnam pa 'di yis ni/ /skyes bus byas pa cung zad med/ /gang phyir bde gshegs kyis gsungs pa'i/ / gsung la'ang ①de ltar rjes dpag nus/ /de yis mngon gsal ②byas dngos phyir/ /des byas pa zhes brjod par bya/ /byed pa dran pa de la yang / /de ni don brjod rgyu mtshan nyid/ /de ltar gzhan mi 'dod ce na/ /rigs pa mtshungs phyir ces mi 'dod/ /de ltar gzhan mi 'dod par zad/ /rigs pas de bzhin dogs pa yin/ /thams cad du ni skyes bu rnams/ /phal cher brdzun ni smra ba yin/ /ji ltar da ②ltar yid mi ches/ /de bzhin 'das pa'i don bstan la/ /de ltar de yi khyed smras pa'i/ /rigs par gzhung lugs 'ga' la yang / /byed po cung zad grub min te/ /rang nyid byas par brjod na yang / /des na skyes bus ma byas la/ /bden par re ba 'di dor cig /gang phyir rig byed don 'gal ba'i/ /don ni de dag las bstan yin/ /gzhan yang thog med grub na yang / /des kyang mis ma byas mi 'grub/ /de las ma byas par 'grub na/ /lung gzhan rnams kyang ma byas 'gyur/ /'di ltar par seg la sogs pa'i/ /tha snyad rnams ni gzhan brten pa'i/ /chad par smra ba'i grub mtha' yang /gzhan gyis 'dus byas pa las byung / /de 'dra'i ma byas nyid grub kyang / /yod la nan tan ci zhig yod/ /khyed kyi 'bad pa ma lus ni/ /yang dag don grub rgyur bcas yin/ /dus nyid skyes bu nyid sogs la/ /sngar bzhin ldog la the tshom za/ /skyes bu rnams la byed pa yi/ /nus pa med par ma bsgrubs phyir//gsal ④ba bkag par byas nyid phyir/ /smra po byed por shes par gyis/ /de phyir sbyor ba gnyis po yang / /dpe ni bsgrub byas stong par smras/ /mis 107—249

bstan pa la ltos phyir dang / /byas pa nyid du bsgrub ①byas phyir/ /rang don smra po ma ltos nyid/ /chos can dpe dag la ni med/ /ngag la rtag dze+enyid spangs pas na/ /chos can dang ni dpe dag la'ang / /rtag pa'i ngag las byung nyid ni/ /gsal bar ma grub par rtogs min/ /'di ltar bskul ba skyes bu yis/ /ma byas nyid du ma nges pas/ /gtan tshigs phyi ma rnams la yang / /the tshom za bar snegrub skyon 'gyur/ /skad cig mas 'jig gsal bsgrubs pas| /re zhig thos pa brtag ④pa yis/ /rang gi ngo bo la gnod par/ /des na ⑤blo ni gang las 'gyur/ /thos rjopa las kyang skyes bu ni/ /'jig par mi 'gyur zhes bshad pa/ /sngar ni de la gnod bstan pas/ /de ni ma grub par gsal yin/ /lag mthil skyu ru ra bzhin du/ /yul dang dus dang skyes bu bzhin/ /gang gis mngon sum du ni gyur/ /des der ⑦gnod med 'di nges 'gyur/ /mi yis mi shes don ngo bo/ / des na ⑧mun pa'i dngos gnas pa'i—/ /rig byed la ni dman rnams chags/ /rang gi dpyod la par sig bzhin| /de yi don ni mi shes pa'ang / /sdig pa'i rgyu mthun dang ldan phyir/ /srog chags 'tshe sogs sdig pa la/ /de bzhin 'di dag 'jug par 'gyur/ /de phyir chos la brten nas ni/ /bskul ba tshad ma nyid ma grub/ /sgra de dag la bdag gzhan gyis/ /de don nges par rtogs mi 'gyur/ /ye shes snang bas nang gi ni/ /mun pa'i tshogs ni 'joms byed la/ /thos don rnam dben ston byed pa/ /tshad mas ⑨grub pa 'dod par gyis/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa las ⑩thos pa brtag pa ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad ⑪pa'o// //107—250

rig byed skyes bus byas nyid du/ /de ltar bsgrub ①par byas pas na/ /'bad mi dgos par de dag la/ /rang las tshad ma nyid kyang btsalasde rang las tshad ma thams cad kyi/ /tshad ma nyid ni gzung bar gyis/ /de lta bu'i ngag de la ni/ /khyed kyi don ni ji ltar 'dod/ /de dag la ni rang bzhin gyis//gzhal bya rtogs sogs nus gnas yin/ /rang la med pa'i nus pa ni/ /gzhan gyis byed par nus ma yin/ /ltos pa med nyid gcig kho na/ /tshad ma nyid kyi rgyu mtshan nyid①/ /ltos pa dang bcas nyid rten na/ /de ni 'jig pa kho nar 'gyur/ /rigs pa smra ba su zhig ni/ /rtsa ba la gnod phyogs nges med//gang gis ④ngag gi rang tshig gis⑤/ /de grub thabs kyang 'jig par byed/ /ltos pa dang bcas tshad nyid ni/ /la lar yang ni gzhan rjobyas min/ /gtan tshigs thug nga med pa yis/ /bsgrub bya su zhig sgrub ⑦par byed/ /de lta'i don ni 'dod ce na/ /dngos po thams cad dag la ni/ /nus pa tha mi dad pa can//sngar bsgrubs byas zin ma yin nam/ /gang phyir 'dod 'bras nus pa can/ /rang bzhin nus pa med ces brjod/ /de dag dngos bdag nyid min na/ /dngos de byed pa por mi 'gyur/ /rang rgyu'i stobs las byung ba can/ /de yang mi rtag de 'dra ba'i/ /nus pa tshad ma dag la ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni yod pa ru/ /khyed cag ji ltar 'dod pa yin/ /nus pa rang bzhin can yin na / /rtag pa 'am ni rgyu med 'gyur/ /de bdag nyid phyir tshad ma yang / /rtag pa nyid dang rgyu med yin/ /rgyu med gzhan la mi ltos phyir/ /rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur/ /des na der rag las 'bras bu/ /res 'ga' ba ni rigs pa min/ /tshad ma rnams kyi rang bzhin dang / /'bras bu nyid ni res 107—251

'ga' bar/ /snang rung des na nus pa yis/ /rang bzhin can khyed la mi rigs—/ /tshad ma rnams kyi rang dngos ni/ /gsal byed kyis gsal snang bas na①/ /skyon gzhan la ni ltos nas ni/ /de 'bras rtsom par byed ce na/ /rtag dngos la ni gsal ba dang / /rgyu gzhan la ni ltos pa spangs/ /de phyir de yi ngo bo dang / /'bras bu rtag tu dmigs par 'gyur/ /dngos la nus pa tha dad dang / /gnyis bdag nyid na'ang de lta na'ang / /rtag pa'i nus dang 'byel pa can/ /de shes rtag tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de lta ②min na rtag mi 'gyur—/ /dngos gcig rjes 'gro med pa'i phyir/ /gang phyir de shes dang nus pa/ /res 'ga' 'brel zhing ④gzhan du min/ /rang gi rgyu las skye 'gyur brka/ /tshad ma rnams kyi nus pa ni/ /rang gi rgyu las skyes 'gyur te/ /phyis rkyen gzhan byas min zhe na/ /'dir ni bdag cag la rtsol ④med/ /gang phyir rang rgyud ⑤las skyes pa'i/ /cha shas med pa'i dngos po yi/ /nus pa phyi nas su zhig rtogasarjo/ /gzhan gyis phyis kyi dus su ni/ /ngo bo gang zhig byas pa ni/ /de ni dngos gzhan nyid yin pas/ / de ni dze+ebadag nyid du brjod min/ /gang phyir 'gal ba'i chos 'dre ba/ /dngos po'i tha dad nyid du bshad/ /de grub na de mi 'grub phyir/ /nus pa la yang de yod yin/ /dngos kun skad cig 'jig pa ru/ /bsgrub par byas pa ⑧de dag gis⑨/ /nus pa 'ga' zhig rkyen gzhan gyis/ /skyed par byed par mi nus so/ /gang phyir de dag gis gnas pa//dus gzhan du ni yod min te/ /gang gi dus na ⑩rkyen gzhan gyis/ /'bras bu 'ga' zhig la nus job/ /'di ni blo bzangs ⑪sangs rgyas pa/ /de dag ji ltar brjod pa yin/ /shes pa 'ga' la nus gnas kyang / /de ni rang las 107—252

rtogs nus min/ /ji ltar gnas pa'i shes bya yi/ /dngos po rtogs dang thob nus nyid/ /nyams myong bdag nyid gcig pu yis/ /su zhig nges par byed par ①nus/ /gang phyir tshad ma ma yin yang / /skra shad la sogs shes pa ni/ /rnam pa gsal ba snang ba yicha/ /nyams myong bdag nyid de yod yinadze+e/ /des na nges par bya nyid phyir/ /don byed shes pa'am gzhan ltos min/ /de byed phyir ni ma yin te/ /dug la sogs pa la bzhin no/ /ji ltar ④dug dang myos 'gyur sogs/ /de las mtshungs gzhan snang phyir dang / /rjes thogs la ni 'bras med phyir/ /de'i bdag nyid nges gzhan ltos yin/ /brgyal dang dub ⑤dang 'chol sogs pa'i/ /de yi 'bras bu nges bskyed na/ /de'i bdag nyid du rtogs 'gyur te/ /da ltar shes la de nus nges/ /gzhan yang tshad ma'i nus mtshan nyid/ /rtsod pa med pa nyid du 'dod/ /tshad ma gzhan gyis nges byas zhes| /de ltar khyed kyis smras pa yin/ /dngos po rnams kyi rjonus pa rnams/ /'bras bu'i don gyis sgrub par byed/ /des na don gyis go bas grub/ /gzhan las mi 'grub ji ltar yin/ /rang gi rgyu las tshad nyid ni/ /cha shas med par grub yin na/ /de ltar yin dang rtsod med de/ /nges bskyed gzhan la ltos pa'i phyir/ /rang gi ngo bo grub don du/ /tshad ma gzhan la ltos pa min/ /de yi ngo bo nges don du/ /rtogs po de la ltos pa yin/ /gzhan yang tshad ma nyid min yang / /de ltar rang nyid las thal 'gyur/ /rang las tshad ma min med na| /gzhan las kyang ni srid ma yin/ /ltos pa med pa gcig kho na/ /tshad min nyid kyi ⑦rgyu mtshan yin/ /de lta bu sogs 'dir yang ni/ /ma lus brjod par nus ma yin/ /slu bar byed pa'i ⑧nus pa ni/ /ji ltar gzhan las 107—253

nges pa yi/ /de ltar mi slu'i ①nus pa nyid/ /des na rnam kun gyi gnyis mtshungs—/ /bzlog pa de las tshad nyid la/ /phul du byung ba ci zhig snang / /gang gis ②rang las de ④nyid dang / /gzhan las tshad ma min pa 'dod/ /'on te rang las tshad ma kun/ /tshad ma nyid du brjod ④pa'i phyir/ /skyes nas rang gi 'bras bu la/ /rang nyid kyis ni 'jug 'gyur min/ /bdag nyid thob phyir dngos po rnams/ /rgyu la ltos phyir byed pa ni/ /bdag nyid thob nas rang 'bras la/ /rang nyid kyis ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /des na skye tsam shes pa la/ /rang gi rgyu la ltos yod phyir/ /de dag rang gi yon tan la/ /nges pa bskyed phyir ltos pa min/ /gang phyir skyed la rang dbang can/ /tshad ma nyid dang don nges la/ /rang gi rgyu la ma ltos par/ /de dag 'gyur bum la sogs bzhin/ /'jim gong 'khor lo dbyug sogs la/ /bum pa skyed ⑤phyir ltos pa yin/ /'di yi chu 'chu rjob la ni/ /de dag la ni ltos pa med/ /de ltar rang las tshad ma nyid/ /tha mar gdon mi za de yin/ /gzhan la ⑦rag las tshad nyid ni/ /thug pa med par thal bar 'gyur/ /rtsa ba yi ni tshad ma nyidaske/ /tshad ma gzhan gyis grub byas na/ /de dang der ni der ⑧'dod pas/ /mthar thug gnas rnyed mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar dang po'i shes pa de/ /don byed mi slu'i ⑨shes la ltos/ /de ltar mi slu'i ⑩shes pa yang / /mi slu gzhan la ltos pa yin/ /gal te 'ga' zhig rang nyid las/ /tshad ma nyid du 'dod pa na—/ /dang po de ltar 'gyur ba la/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis sdang bar byed/ /gal te de ltar yon tan la/ /rag las mngon sum tshad ma ⑩nyid/ /tshad ma med na yon tan yang / /nam yang yod pa ma yin no/ /des na yon tan 107—254

yongs gcod phyir/ /tshad ma gzhan ni 'dod pa na/ /de la'ang gzhan gyis yongs bcad pa'i/ /yon tan rag las tshad ma nyid/ /dang po'i bzhin no des na yang / /sngar bzhin thug pa med par 'gyur/ /de dang de ①de ltar 'dod na/ /mthar thug rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /'on te yon tan gyis shes pa//yon 'dzin rag las tshad ma nyid/ /mi 'dod dang po'i don shes kyang / /yon tan tshad ma la mi ltos/ /des na ring du dbe+ed byas kyang / /'gal ba ②rang la tshad nyid ni/ /gdon mi za bar khas len na/ /de bas thog mar gnas pa mchog /don byed pa dang yon tan shes/ /gang gis khyad par can du 'dod//gang gi ①stobs kyis dang po ni/ /de dag la ni rag las 'gyur/ /de phyir rag las tshad ma nyid/ /kun la spyir bstan pa can gnas/ /gnod dang rgyu skyon bcas nyid kyis/ /shes pa dag gis de bsal yin/ /de ni gzhan la rag las kyang / /thug pa med par mi 'gyur ro/ /de yi tshad ma la rag las/ /de yang rang la ④gnas pa yin/ /gang phyir tshad ma tshad gzhan gyes/ /ji ltar sgrub par mi byed pa/ /de ltar tshad min nyid kyis ni/ /tshad min gzhan las grub pa min/ /rigs mthun la rten ⑤nyid kyis ni/ /gnas pa 'thad pa ma yin te/ /rigs mi mthun ni rgyu gzhan phyir/ /rtsa ba brtan mepar gnas pa yin| /re zhig gnod pa'i shes pa ni/ /don gzhan nyid du nges gzung yin//de ni ltos med tshad nyid phyir/ /snga ma shes pas sel bar byed/ /de la yang ni gnod pa brtsal⑦/ /slar yang ltos par 'gyur ba yin/ /la lar snga mar dogs skye na/ /de yang 'bad pa nyung ngus ldog /gal te 'di la gnod pa gzhan| /tshol sgebs skye bar 'gyur ba na/ /des na dbus mar gnod gyur 107—255

pas①ske/ /snga ma kho na tshad ma yin/ /'on te rjes mthun 'bad pa yis/ /yang dag tshol bar byed pa na/ /rtsa ba med phyir gnod can la②/ /gnod pa'i shes pas gnod mi 'gyur/ /des na dmigs gsal ③med pa'i phyir/ /stobs bcas de yi dang po ni/ /gnod 'gyur de yis de nyid kyi/ /tshad ma nyid ni bsal ④ba yin/ /de ltar rtog ⑤ldan shes pa ni/ /gsum po spong bar mi byed do—/ /des kyang gnod pa ma skyes na/ /gnod pa slar yang dogs mi bya/ /gang zhig rmongs pas ma skyes pa'ang / /gnod pa can du nye bar rtog /the tshom bdag nyid can de ni/ /tha snyad thams cad nyams par 'gyur/ /'de ltar nor lha'i bu yis ni/ /the tshom bdag nyid la smad yin/ /kun ta'i dubu skyes the tshom can/ /'jig rten 'di dang phyi ma med/ /la lar gang du ji snyed pa'i—/ /mig dze+egasal rnams ni srid pa yin/ /de bdag nyid la de snyed ni/ /brtsal dze+eyang ma skyes pas der med/ /'jal byed don du gnyer rnams kyis/ /slar yang dngos po de dag ni/ /res 'ga' 'di ⑨ltar srid pa yang / /nye bar brtags ⑩shing gnas mi bya/ /gang la yul dus mi'i gnas skabs/ /dbye ba tha dad kyis grub gang / /gnod can don du gnyer ba ni/ /de dag la ni ltos pa yin/ /yul thag ring na gnas pa'i phyir/ /yang dag par ni ma mthong bas/ /la lar gzhan du dogs 'gyur ba/ /der ni nye bar phyin pa tsam//gnod pa'i mtha' ste dus dang ni/ /mi dang gnas skabs gzhan dag la/ /de la ltos pa yod min te/ /smig rgyu la sogs blo bzhin no/ /de ltar dmag dang bcas dus su/ /ba lang rta ⑪sogs the tshom mam/ /'khrul pa gang yin de'i nges pa/ /gsal bar gyur pa mtha' can yin/ /de bzhin zla gnyis phyogs la 107—256

'khrul| /rig ①byed yi ge dbyangs sogs la'ang / /skyes bu gzhan la dris pa na/ /rnam pa gzhan du nges 'dzin skye/ /chags dang zhe sdang rgyags dang bsnyo②| /bkres skom sogs kyis dbang nyams pas/ /shes bya'i don la log shes skye/ /de med yang dag shes pa skye/ /bu lon la sogs tha snyad la'ang / /gnyis ka rtsod par byed pa na/ /gcig ni bu lon chags pa'i tshig /sngar gyi bu lon ded tshig gnyis/ /thug pa med pa'i 'jigs ①pa yis/ /ngag lhag chad rgyar 'bri mi byed/ /des na gtso bo'i thad du ni/ /'dun sa pa sogs kyis nges brjod/ /de ltar shes pa gsum kho na/ /thams cad kyi ni dbang byas 'dod/ /de 'dod phyir ni lha rnams la'ang / /bden pa gnyis gsum yod par brjod/ /des na rang la tshad nyid na/ /gnyis ka la yang thug med med/ /tshad ma nyid dang tshad min nyid/ /des na ji ltar rigs par gnas| /rtag pa'am yid ches pas smras pa/ /ngag gang nges par bzung ④ba yin| /smra ba po dang nyan pa yis/ /de ni cung zad skyon bcas su/ /mi byed de la rig pa yis/ /bla ma gang dag yin pa 'am/ /rtag tu gnod par byed pa pos/ /de 'drar skyo bar nus pa 'am⑤/ /'jig med de ni 'dzin par byed| /des na yon tan gyis bkag pa'i/ /skyon gyis ngag sun 'byen mi byed//yang na byed po med phyir te/ /skyon ni rten med mi 'gyur ro/ /der yid ches smras la skyon med/ /yon tan bdag nyid gnyis su snang / /yon tan gyis kyang tshad ma nyid/ /ji ltar grub min de ltar bstan/ /des na yon tan ldan pa'i phyir| /des bstsal rjosmra po la skyon med/ /skyon med pas ni nyer mtshon pas/ /ngag ni rang las tshad ma yin/ /yid ches ngag las skyon med par/ /yon 107—257

tan ngag gis rtogs she na/ /yon tan ldan nyid rjes 'gro la/ /de nyid thug pa med par 'gyur/ /de ni skyon med shes 'gyur bas/ /yon tan gyi shes de yi tshe/ /ltos par byed pa ma yin te/ /de la yon tan phan 'dogs min/ /yod pa tsam gyis de kun gyi/ /skyon rnams ldog par byed nus yin/ /de dag yod na mi'i skyon gyi①/ /yul can shes pa skye mi 'gyur/ /mi shes nyid phyir skyon rnams kyis/ /tshad ma nyid ni bsal ba yin/ /ma bsal bas ni grub pa yinaske/ /des na 'di yang rang la gnas/ /nyes pa yod dam med pa ni/ /skyes bu'i ngag la the tshom za/ /byed po med phyir thos pa la/ /skyon yod the tshom bdag la med/ /rig byed la yang tshad ma nyid/ /ma ltos nyid phyir gang brjod pa/ /yid ches ma smras pa la yang / /de ni rang las shin tu grub/ /rig byed don la tshad gzhan gyis/ /dus kun du ni ma 'byel gang / /de nyid kyis ni tshad ma nyid/ /gzhan du rjes su zlos ②nyid yin/ /gzhan la yang ni tshad nyid la/ /'brel pa rgyu nyid ma yin te/ /don mtshungs rnams la rtogs ①pa yis/ /mtshungs pa'i don gcig la rtogs ④pas/ /gcig nyid tshad ma nyid du 'gyur/ /gang la yang ni yongs gcod pa/ /tshad ma phyi mas slar yang 'gyur—/ /der yang nges par snga ma yis/ /don de gsal bar nges bzung ⑤min—/ /lan cig skyes nas 'jig pa ni/ /don la tshad min nyid 'gyur min//mig la sogs dang 'brel med pa/ /rna blo'ang tshad mar 'gyur ba min/ /'di la rna ba'i shes gzhan dang / /'byel phyir tshad nyid 'gyur zhe na/ /rig byed la yang de skyed pa'i/ /rnam shes gzhan dang 'brel pa grub/ /sgrub pa gzhan las skyes pa ni/ /blo ni gnyis la'ang yang yod min/ /des na rgyu gzhan gyis 107—258

byas pa'i/ /shes pa mi slu 'dod min te/ /ji ltar dbang po gcig dag las/ /rnam shes gzhan gyis 'byel pa ni/ /mngon sum gyi rgyur brtags pa yin/ /de bzhin rig byed la brtag gis/ /ngag ni gcig pu kho na yis/ /yul dang dus dang mi sogs la/ /don gyi ①mi slu rnyed pa ni/ /rgyu gzhan brtsal sdebar mi bya'o| /de phyir brtan ④par gang skyes pa'i/ /rnam par shes pa ④yul gzhan sogs—/ /rnam shes rnams kyi slu med can/ /de ni tshad mar the tshom med/ /sgra rnams la ni tshad ma nyid/ /rjes su dpag pas bsgrub mi bya/ /mngon sum la yang de bsgrub byas/ /tshad mar mi 'gyur khyad med phyir/ /tshad ma ⑤rnams kyis tshad ma nyid/ /gzhan ma gang gis bsgrub par byas/ /de yang gzhan gyis bsgrubs rjopa'i phyir/ /thug pa med par thal bar 'gyur/ /'on te sgrub par byed pa la/ /gzhan gyis ma bsgrubs tshad 'dod na/ /des na bsgrub bya la yang de⑦/ /ma bsgrubs pa yang de bzhin 'gyur/ /mngon sum la sogs tshad ma ru/ /de ltar gzung byas ma yin nam/ /de ltar gzung bar ma byas pas/ /tha snyad rigs pa ma yin no/ /nges par 'dzin pa'i sngon rol du/ /tshad mar rang nyid ni gnas na/ /de ni ltos med rang gi don/ /'jal bar byed de rang gis des/ /ji ltar rtogs par ma byas nyid/ /mig sogs dbang po rnams kyis ni/ /yul kun 'dzin par byed pa yin/ /de bzhin tshad ma rnams kyis kyang / /des na tshad ma nyid de la/ /rigs ⑧par 'gyur nyid mkho ba min/ /blo ni ma rtogs ⑨'di las kyang / /yul gyi nyams myong dmigs par 'gyur/ /rang gi don la tshad min pa/ /tshad ma bzhin du rang las grub/ /de yi log nyid tshad ma gzhan/ /med na gzung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang phyir don ni 107—259
